text.title: 塔布羊训练：凶残的食人魔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败高里亚驱兽者。
text.description: 在纳格兰居住着德拉诺最强大的野兽，而且那里的食人魔使用一种非常残忍的手段驯养他们。$B$B其中，又数那个叫高里亚驱兽者的尤为凶残。他浑身充满了血腥和恐惧的气息。让我们瞧瞧你的坐骑面对他是否还能面不改色。
text.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Nagrand is home to the mightiest beasts in Draenor, and the ogres of the region have learned to tame them using brutal techniques.$B$BThere is one ogre in particular, the Gorian Beast-Lasher, that smells of blood and fear. Go on and see how your beast reacts to that.
english.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: Talbuk Training: Darkwing Roc
text.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
text.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.$B$BTravel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.
text.completion: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Darkwing Roc
english.objectives: Defeat the Darkwing Roc while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: The windrocs of Nagrand are a smart predator, often swooping down on unwary prey in packs. If your beast doesn't keep an eye on the sky, it's likely to lose both.$B$BTravel to Nagrand and take on the fiercest windroc of the bunch, the Darkwing Roc. It will be a good test for your mount.
english.completion: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：暴怒飞蛾
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败暴怒飞蛾。
text.description: 在纳格兰的森林中有许多善于躲避捕食者的动物。但其中又要属那只名叫暴怒飞蛾的蛾子做的最好，它浑身覆满了充满恶臭的飞蛾之尘。$B$B如果它能让附近的野狼都不得不退避三舍，这对你的塔布羊来说一定是一次非常美妙的试炼。看看你能不能让它保持专注，干掉那只飞蛾吧。
text.completion: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Moth of Wrath
english.objectives: Defeat the Moth of Wrath while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: Deep in the forests of Nagrand are some beasts capable of evading almost any predator. The greatest of them all, the Moth of Wrath, is coated with a foul-smelling dust.$B$BIf the moth dust is enough to keep wolves at bay, it will probably be a pretty good test for your talbuk. See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.
english.completion: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：雷鸣
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败雷鸣。
text.description: 元素生物有时候也会对野兽构成威胁。即使是最强大座狼也常会被远处的雷声所惊吓。$B$B在纳格兰的海岸，有一处迎风而立的峭壁。在那峭壁上有一只由纯粹的雷雨构成的生物，它的名字叫雷鸣。骑上你的坐骑去那儿对付它，让我们瞧瞧结果如何。
text.completion: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: Thundercall
english.objectives: Defeat Thundercall while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: The elements can sometimes pose a problem for some beasts. Even the mightiest wolf will often cower at the sound of thunder in the distance.$B$BIn Nagrand, off on a windswept cliff high above the shore, is a creature made of pure thunderstorms. Hop atop your beast and face off against Thundercall, and we will see how your mount fares.
english.completion: Your mount is bit wet, but seems to be in good spirits. I will dry it off and put it to rest.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: Talbuk Training: Ironbore
text.objectives: Defeat Ironbore while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
text.description: You have defeated foes in the sky and on land, and even in the rain. Next, you face beasts beneath your very feet.$B$BThe rockworm is a cunning predator, striking at prey from below the sands. Many beasts of Nagrand have grown wary of the rumbling of the earth. Take your mount on out to the sandy shores test it against the elder worm Ironbore.
text.completion: You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.$B$BAllow your mount to rest for the night.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: Talbuk Training: Orc Hunters
text.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
text.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. Their beast-killers will aid us in putting this mount to the test.$B$BOut in Nagrand, you will find an orc by the name of Karak, the Great Hunter. He has slain more fierce beasts than any other in the clan. Face him astride your mount, and avenge the slain.
text.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 塔布羊训练：铁颚狼
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的塔布羊去击败残爪。
text.description: 你的坐骑的最后一项挑战将是面对这片大地上最可怕的一种动物。$B$B有一种狼，他们的皮肤像夜晚一样漆黑，他们体型比一般的狼要大上一倍，它们就是铁颚狼。它们转眼间就能把一个兽人撕成两半，野兽们害怕它们不是没有理由的。$B$B现在有一头孤独的铁颚狼跑到了纳格兰定居。骑上你的塔布羊去干掉它，如果你们两个能够生还，你的塔布羊才真正算是准备好了。
text.completion: A powerful and swift companion, and now unafraid of the creatures you may run into. You have done well in your training of the beast, and I am pleased to present you with the reins.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Talbuk Training: The Garn
english.objectives: Defeat Maimclaw while riding your Talbuk-In-Training.
english.description: The last test for your mount will pit it against one of the great terrors of this land.$B$BThe garn. Wolves as black as night, and twice the size of a normal wolf, they can tear an orc apart in mere moments. The beasts here wisely fear them.$B$BThere is a lone garn that calls Nagrand its home. Take your talbuk, mount up, and bring it down. If the two of you survive, your talbuk will truly be ready for war.
english.completion: A powerful and swift companion, and now unafraid of the creatures you may run into. You have done well in your training of the beast, and I am pleased to present you with the reins.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 座狼训练：凶残的食人魔
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的啸狼去击败高里亚驱兽者。
text.description: 这片大地上的野狼是我见过的最凶残的野兽，而且它们也不怕兽人和食人魔。$B$B让我们带它去会一会你在那边的食人魔老熟人吧，那个浑身充满了血腥和恐惧气息的高里亚驱兽者。让我们瞧瞧你的座狼面对他是否还能面不改色。
text.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.title: Wolf Training: Cruel Ogres
english.objectives: Defeat the Gorian Beast-Lasher while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
english.description: The wolves of this land are the most savage beasts I have seen, and surely do not fear orc nor ogre.$B$BBring him to bear against once of the ogres that you are familiar with. The Gorian Beast-Lasher, the one that smells of blood and fear, see how the wolf reacts to him.
english.completion: Those beasts will recover, in time. Let us rest for tonight, you have done well.
english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 座狼训练：暗翼大鹏
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的啸狼去击败暗翼大鹏。
text.description: 纳格兰的风鹏是一种非常聪明的捕食者，它们经常成群结队地突袭猎物。要是你的坐骑不时刻注意着天空的话，就可得跟它这双眼睛说再见了。$B$B去纳格兰干掉那里最凶猛的风鹏——暗翼大鹏。这对你的坐骑来说是个不错的试炼。
text.completion: From now on, your mount will always remember to keep one eye on the skies.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

See if you can keep it focused and defeat the moth.
text.completion: Glad to see you back. I will need some time to brush that dust off of your mount.

text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的啸狼去击败铁钻。
text.description: 你解决掉了陆地和天空的敌人，甚至还有雷雨。接下来你将面对你脚底下的动物。$B$B岩虫是一种狡猾的捕食者，它们喜欢从沙土底下钻出来袭击敌人。在纳格兰，很多野兽都学会了注意脚底下的动静。带你的座狼去那边的沙滩，尝试干掉那里的老岩虫：铁钻。
text.completion: You stand strong, though the ground crumbles. Admirable.$B$BAllow your mount to rest for the night.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

text.title: 座狼训练：兽人猎手
text.objectives: 骑着你的训练中的啸狼去击败狩猎大师卡拉克。
text.description: 纳格兰的战歌氏族可跻身德拉诺最优秀的猎人的行列，他们的狩猎者可以帮我们为这批坐骑提供试炼。$B$B你能在纳格兰找到一位名叫狩猎大师卡拉克的兽人，死在他手上的凶残动物的数量是他们整个氏族里最多的。骑上你的坐骑去干掉他，为那些被杀害的动物报仇。
text.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.
text.completed: Return to Sage Paluna in your garrison.

english.objectives: Defeat Karak the Great Hunter while riding your Snarler-In-Training.
english.description: The Warsong Clan of Nagrand are some of the finest hunters the world of Draenor has ever known. english.completion: Ah, you have hunted the hunter. Many beasts will be pleased tonight.

text.completion: A savage beast, yet you have tamed it. I should learn to never underestimate you. It awaits your command patiently, almost like it knows you wait for it. Here are the reins, may your companion be ever at your side.

text.title: 休息和放松
text.objectives: 和狮王之傲旅店的旅店老板法雷谈一谈。
text.description: 每个冒险家在疲惫的时候都需要休息——而休息和放松的最佳去处就是狮王之傲旅店！$B$B我的好朋友法雷是那里的旅店老板。告诉他是我介绍你去的，也许他还会给你些特别优惠呢。$B$B如果你要去狮王之傲旅店的，沿着大路往南走就没错了！
text.completion: Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold -- that's our motto! Please, take a seat by the fire and rest your weary bones.$B$BWould you like to try a sampling of some of our fine food and drink?

english.title: Rest and Relaxation
english.objectives: Speak with Innkeeper Farley at the Lion's Pride Inn.
english.description: Every adventurer should rest when exhaustion sets in - and there is no finer place to get rest and relaxation than at the Lion's Pride Inn!$B$BMy best friend, Innkeeper Farley, runs the Lion's Pride. If you tell him I sent you, he may give you the special discounted rates on food and drink.$B$BTo find the Lion's Pride Inn, travel south along the road from here -- you can't miss it!
english.completion: Наш девиз – покой и отдых для всех усталых и продрогших! Прошу, садись у огня, отдохни с дороги.$B$BХочешь – отведай, чем у нас кормят, да и выпить чего-нибудь тебе не помешает...

text.title: 猎头的收获
text.objectives: 从坠月旅店的丽萨·塞隆那里招募到一位追随者。
text.description:
旅店是供冒险者在旅途当中养精蓄锐的完美休憩之所。也可以趁此机会请他们喝上几杯，劝他们加入我们的行动。

看看这里的人选，试试能不能招募到一位新成员，我会给你点奖励当作好处费的。
text.completion:
Ahh, I'm glad you were able to find a good hire!

I'll get back to looking for more candidates for you. Check back in every week to see my latest selections.
text.completed: Return to Lysa Serion at Lunarfall Inn in your garrison.

english.title: The Headhunter's Harvest
english.objectives: Recruit a follower from Lysa Serion in the Lunarfall Inn.
english.description:
The inn provides a perfect place for adventurers to take a rest between their travels. It's also a great place to talk them into joining our cause over a few rounds of drinks.

Go through my selection and let's see if we can obtain a new recruit. I'll give you a little something as a finder's fee for your efforts.
english.completion:
Ahh, I'm glad you were able to find a good hire!

I'll get back to looking for more candidates for you. Check back in every week to see my latest selections.
english.completed: Return to Lysa Serion at Lunarfall Inn in your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 从猎头处招募一位追随者

text.title: 黑暗之爪
text.objectives: 向范妮·焰须询问塞泰的黑暗之爪的情况。
text.description: 如你所见，我身后是一只巨大的黑色爪子，它是我们在出门寻找新的受训野兽时发现的。动物们似乎都非常惧怕这玩意儿，或许这爪子的主人曾经捕杀过它们。
text.completion: Like I said, the claw has a strange effect on the mounts we've got here. If ye have it with ye when training a mount-in-training, your mount will be MUCH more vulnerable.$B$BShould ye find the training not rough enough, ye might want to challenge yourself.$B$BI'd have a pretty hefty prize for anyone that could manage that!

english.title: The Black Claw
english.objectives: Ask Fanny Firebeard about the Black Claw of Sethe.
english.description: Behind me, as ye can probably see, is a giant black claw. We found it while we were out hunting new beasts to tame. The animals seem to be quite afraid of it, perhaps the beast it belonged to used to hunt them.
english.completion: Like I said, the claw has a strange effect on the mounts we've got here. If ye have it with ye when training a mount-in-training, your mount will be MUCH more vulnerable.$B$BShould ye find the training not rough enough, ye might want to challenge yourself.$B$BI'd have a pretty hefty prize for anyone that could manage that!

text.title: 掠食者之牙
text.objectives: 向范妮·焰须询问铁颚狼齿项链的情况。
text.description: 我们出去驯服野兽时，从一个兽人猎手身上掉下了这根项链。我从没见过动物们对什么东西会有这么强的反应！
text.completion: I've not seen the beasts go so wild in all of my years, as the day we brought this thing back to the stables.$B$BShould ye find the training still not hard enough, take it along with ye. Your mounts-in-training will be even MORE vulnerable.$B$BBe careful! I'd give a prize to anyone that could best every beast with such an artifact, but I don't want to see you wind up dead!

english.title: Teeth of a Predator
english.objectives: Ask Fanny Firebeard about the Garn-Tooth Necklace.
english.description: This necklace dropped off of one of the orc hunters we found while out taming beasts. I've never seen the animals react so strongly to anything!
english.completion: I've not seen the beasts go so wild in all of my years, as the day we brought this thing back to the stables.$B$BShould ye find the training still not hard enough, take it along with ye. Your mounts-in-training will be even MORE vulnerable.$B$BBe careful! I'd give a prize to anyone that could best every beast with such an artifact, but I don't want to see you wind up dead!

text.title: 黑暗之爪
text.objectives: 向先知帕鲁纳询问塞泰的黑暗之爪的情况。
text.description: 如你所见，我身后是一只巨大的黑色爪子，它是我们在出门寻找新的受训野兽时发现的。动物们似乎都非常惧怕这玩意儿，或许这爪子的主人曾经捕杀过它们。
text.completion: This claw has a strange effect on the mounts we have. If you have it with you when training a mount-in-training, your mount will be MUCH more vulnerable.$B$BShould you find the training not rough enough, you might want to challenge yourself further by carrying it with you.$B$BI think besting the beasts of Draenor with it would certainly be worthy of a reward.

english.title: The Black Claw
english.objectives: Ask Sage Paluna about the Black Claw of Sethe.
english.description: You've probably seen this enormous, black claw in our pile of supplies. We found it while we were out hunting new beasts to tame. The animals seem to be quite afraid of it, perhaps the beast it belonged to used to hunt them.
english.completion: This claw has a strange effect on the mounts we have. If you have it with you when training a mount-in-training, your mount will be MUCH more vulnerable.$B$BShould you find the training not rough enough, you might want to challenge yourself further by carrying it with you.$B$BI think besting the beasts of Draenor with it would certainly be worthy of a reward.

text.title: 掠食者之牙
text.objectives: 向先知帕鲁纳询问铁颚狼齿项链的情况。
text.description: 我们出去驯服野兽时，一个兽人猎手身上掉下了这根项链。我从没见过动物们对什么东西会有这么强的反应。
text.completion: I have not seen the beasts go so mad in all of my years as a sage, as the day we brought this necklace back to the stables.$B$BShould you find the training still not hard enough, take it along with you. Your mounts-in-training will be even MORE vulnerable.$B$BBe careful! I would gladly reward anyone that could best every beast with such an artifact, but I do not want to see you wind up dead!

english.title: Teeth of a Predator
english.objectives: Ask Sage Paluna about the Garn-Tooth Necklace.
english.description: This necklace dropped off of one of the orc hunters we found while out taming beasts. I've never seen the animals react so strongly to anything.
english.completion: I have not seen the beasts go so mad in all of my years as a sage, as the day we brought this necklace back to the stables.$B$BShould you find the training still not hard enough, take it along with you. Your mounts-in-training will be even MORE vulnerable.$B$BBe careful! I would gladly reward anyone that could best every beast with such an artifact, but I do not want to see you wind up dead!

text.title: 稀奇的发现
text.completion: Nice find! This relic is going to be a welcome addition to someone's private collection!

english.title: A Rare Find
english.completion: Nice find! This relic is going to be a welcome addition to someone's private collection!

text.title: 没有佩剑的食人魔……
text.objectives: 从纳格兰破碎悬崖的宰相达古德身上取回托莫克心爱的佩剑。
text.description: 在被发配到戈尔隆德之前，我就驻扎在纳格兰的破碎悬崖，管理那片乱糟糟的挖掘场。达古德宰相不肯让我带上我喜爱的佩剑。他跟我说，我要去的地方用不上它。$B$B我想把它拿回来，指挥官。我想我们的实力足以打倒达古德，并从他血淋淋的尸体上拿回我的剑了。$B$B它对我意义重大。没有佩剑的食人魔根本算不上食人魔。
text.progress: I want my sword more than I can tell you, commander.
text.completion: Yes... this is it.$B$BCommander, I will cleave your foes like never before now that I have my sword.
text.completed: Return to Tormmok at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: An Ogre Without His Sword...
english.objectives: Retrieve Tormmok's Favorite Sword from Vizier Dar'gud at Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
english.description: Before I was shipped off to Gorgrond, I was stationed at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand, maintaining order over the unruly dredges. Vizier Dar'gud refused to let me take my favorite sword; he told me "I wouldn't need it where I was going."$B$BI want it back, commander, and we are powerful enough together to take it from Dar'gud's bloody corpse.$B$BIt would mean a great deal to me. An ogre without his sword isn't an ogre at all.
english.progress: I want my sword more than I can tell you, commander.
english.completion: Yes... this is it.$B$BCommander, I will cleave your foes like never before now that I have my sword.
english.completed: Return to Tormmok at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 埃索达斯之光
text.objectives: 从塔拉多沙塔斯城沙塔尔灯塔那里的赫尔默大使处夺回埃索达斯之光。
text.description: 我祖父经常给我讲有关一块强大水晶的故事。它是圣光凝结而成，能赐予那些心怀善意的人力量。他称它为埃索达斯之光。$B$B我一直都不相信他……直到现在。$B$B你的斥候发现了一块水晶，听起来和它一模一样。它被一个可怕的恶魔夺走了，现在正在沙塔斯的沙塔尔灯塔处腐蚀它。$B$B我们必须赶快行动！
text.progress: If the Light of Exodus is half as powerful as my grandfather told me, we cannot let it fall into the Legion's hands.
text.completion: It's so beautiful...$B$BOh, commander, thank you. A million times thank you!
text.completed: Return to Defender Illona at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: The Light of Exodus
english.objectives: Retrieve the Light of Exodus from Ambassador Hellmaw at Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath City in Talador.
english.description: My grandfather always told me stories of a powerful crystal made of the Light that would grant power to those who intended to use it for good. He called it the Light of Exodus.$B$BI never believed him... until now.$B$BYour scouts have found a crystal that sounds just like it. It has been taken by a terrible demon and is being corrupted at the Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath.$B$BWe have to hurry!
english.progress: If the Light of Exodus is half as powerful as my grandfather told me, we cannot let it fall into the Legion's hands.
english.completion: It's so beautiful...$B$BOh, commander, thank you. A million times thank you!
english.completed: Return to Defender Illona at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 了结恩怨
text.objectives: 从塔拉多沙塔斯城沙塔尔灯塔那里的赫尔默大使处夺回埃索达斯之光。
text.description: 我们的斥候发现了一块强大的德莱尼水晶，就在沙塔斯的沙塔尔灯塔处，德莱尼称它为埃索达斯之光。而现在赫尔默大使正在腐化它。$B$B指挥官，我想和你一起去执行这个任务。赫尔默在外域杀害了我的兄弟……这是私人恩怨。
text.progress: We cannot allow the Legion to gain any advantage.
text.completion: It is done. The Legion have suffered a mighty blow.
text.completed: Return to Aeda Brightdawn at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Settling Grievances
english.objectives: Retrieve the Light of Exodus from Ambassador Hellmaw at Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath City in Talador.
english.description: Our scouts have found a powerful draenei crystal being corrupted by Ambassador Hellmaw at the Beacon of Sha'tar in Shattrath. The draenei call it the Light of Exodus.$B$BCommander, I'd like to accompany you on this mission. Hellmaw slew my brother in Outland... this is personal.
english.progress: We cannot allow the Legion to gain any advantage.
english.completion: It is done. The Legion have suffered a mighty blow.
english.completed: Return to Aeda Brightdawn at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 不堪回首的往事
text.objectives: 从戈尔隆德永茂丛林的阿坎瑟斯身上取得被感染的兽人遗骸。
text.description: 总的来说就是，永茂丛林的木精用某种邪恶的魔法创造了这些植物……呃……僵尸。$B$B我见过由无脑奴隶组成的大军会造成怎样的破坏。巫妖王……$B$B<德尔瓦闭上了眼睛。>$B$B无论如何，我们不能再任由其发展了。我听说他们最近刚刚创造出了一个特别邪恶的存在……让我们去干掉它，并看看木精是怎么驱动它的。
text.progress: No zombies, plant o' otherwise, are goin' ta walk this world if ol' Delvar has anythin' to say about it.
text.completion: I'll be takin' a close look at this... thing. We can't have a repeat o' Northrend.
text.completed: Return to Delvar Ironfist at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Unwelcome Memories
english.objectives: Retrieve Infested Orc Remains from Acanthus at Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
english.description: The botani in the Everbloom Wilds are doin' some sorta foul magic to create these plant... well... zombies, basically.$B$BI've seen what happens with armies o' mindless slaves. The Lich King...$B$B<Delvar's eyes close.>$B$BNo matter. We cannae let this escalate any further. I heard o' a particularly nasty one they've just made... let's kill it and see what makes it tick.
english.progress: No zombies, plant o' otherwise, are goin' ta walk this world if ol' Delvar has anythin' to say about it.
english.completion: I'll be takin' a close look at this... thing. We can't have a repeat o' Northrend.
english.completed: Return to Delvar Ironfist at Lunarfall in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 黑暗女王的忧虑
text.objectives: 从戈尔隆德永茂丛林的阿坎瑟斯身上取得被感染的兽人遗骸。
text.description: 永茂丛林里的木精毫不留情的消灭掉那些接近它们林地的蠢货，然后把他们的尸体变成无脑的士兵。$B$B这一切的一切都跟天灾军团的手段别无二致……黑暗女王也已经注意到了。她派给我们一项特殊的使命，指挥官。$B$B木精在不久前复生了一个极其巨大的被感染生物。我们必须消灭它，然后取得它的遗骸。
text.progress: I assure you, commander, the Dark Lady has the Horde's best interests at heart. We must stop these botani immediately.
text.completion: Thank you, commander. The Dark Lady will appreciate this greatly.
text.completed: Return to Vivianne at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: The Dark Lady's Concern
english.objectives: Retrieve Infested Orc Remains from Acanthus at Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
english.description: The botani in the Everbloom Wilds kill anything foolish enough to wander too close to their blooms and are raising their corpses as mindless soldiers.$B$BThis is all too reminiscent of the Scourge... and the Dark Lady has taken notice. She has a special mission for us, commander.$B$BThere is a particularly large infested creature that was recently raised. We are to destroy it and retrieve its remains.
english.progress: I assure you, commander, the Dark Lady has the Horde's best interests at heart. We must stop these botani immediately.
english.completion: Thank you, commander. The Dark Lady will appreciate this greatly.
english.completed: Return to Vivianne at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 努力测量
text.objectives: 从影月谷影月飞地的乌娜·黑尺身上取得乌娜的测量杖。
text.description: 还有其他一些人在利用暗影实现自己的计划。你知道我说的是谁，指挥官……影月兽人。$B$B他们已经着手精进自己的技艺……召唤异界的暗影……$B$B我渴望他们的力量，他们当中有人有一把法杖是我最为垂涎的……我们必须把那力量据为己有。
text.progress: Taking out our enemies and gaining great power in one motion... my people have a saying for this: Killing two orcs with one stone.
text.completion: Yes... yes... this will do nicely. We can use this to do great things.$B$BThank you, commander.
text.completed: Return to Talonpriest Ishaal at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Scrying Hard or Hardly Scrying
english.objectives: Retrieve Urna's Fathomstaff from Urna Darkfathom at Shadowmoon Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: There are others that harness the shadows to do their bidding. You know of them, commander... the Shadowmoon orcs.$B$BThey have begun to master their craft... they call to the shadows beyond this realm...$B$BI desire their power. They have one who possesses a staff of particular interest... we should claim it as our own.
english.progress: Taking out our enemies and gaining great power in one motion... my people have a saying for this: Killing two orcs with one stone.
english.completion: Yes... yes... this will do nicely. We can use this to do great things.$B$BThank you, commander.
english.completed: Return to Talonpriest Ishaal at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 利奥拉的念珠
text.objectives: 从斯克提斯的风舞者奇洛克斯身上获得利奥拉的念珠。
text.description: 利奥拉当萨满那天，虎王给了利奥拉念珠。念珠帮我听见元素说话。$B$B一天一个鸟人打了来，抢走了念珠，带去了斯克提斯。$B$B主人，你帮利奥拉拿回念珠好吗？
text.progress: Elements don't speak to Leorajh like they used to.
text.completion: Thank you, master! Elements speak to Leorajh again.
text.completed: Return to Leorajh at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
english.objectives: Retrieve Leorajh's Prayer Beads from Kirox the Wind Dancer in Skettis.
english.description: When Leorajh became shaman, pridelord gave prayer beads. Beads help Leorajh hear elements.$B$BOne day bird-men attacked and took prayer beads. Took them to Skettis.$B$BMaster, you help Leorajh get prayer beads back?
english.progress: Elements don't speak to Leorajh like they used to.
english.completion: Thank you, master! Elements speak to Leorajh again.
english.completed: Return to Leorajh at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 食人魔的族谱
text.objectives: 从血槌炉渣矿井里获得一份食人魔家谱。
text.description: 隆克喜欢学习，不喜欢打架。你帮隆克学习好吗？$B$B帮隆克找到祖先，隆克有很多问题要问他们。隆克是从哪里来的？为什么隆克要叫隆克？$B$B隆克待在这里，乖乖的，外面有很多很坏的小食人魔，还有更加坏的大食人魔。
text.progress: How can Lunk Lunk if Lunk not know what Lunk is?
text.completion: Lunk know you kill many ogre for this, and Lunk very upset about this, but Lunk also still grateful.$B$BWait, dis not Lunk family club...

english.title: Ogre Ancestry
english.objectives: Collect an Ogre Family Tree from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
english.description: Lunk no like fight, want to learn. You help Lunk learn?$B$BFind Lunk ancestors. Lunk have many question. Where Lunk come from? Why Lunk Lunk?$B$BLunk stay here. Small ogres mean, big ogres meaner.
english.progress: How can Lunk Lunk if Lunk not know what Lunk is?
english.completion: Lunk know you kill many ogre for this, and Lunk very upset about this, but Lunk also still grateful.$B$BWait, dis not Lunk family club...

text.title: 顺手牵羊的巴德
text.objectives: 从钢铁码头获得闪闪发光的东西。
text.description: 听着，我不知道我怎么来这儿的，不过我百分百确定在距离海岸不远处有一座由闪闪发光的宝藏堆成的岛。$B$B我们只需要一头扎进水里游过去，往口袋里塞满宝藏再游回来！出发前我先去休息一下，再做点伸展运动热热身。$B$B你可千万不要拦我！
text.progress: What?
text.completion: Oh... this is... well that's very shiny isn't it? I think... I'll just sit here for a while.$B$B<Budd smiles contentedly.>

english.title: Budd's Gambit
english.objectives: Collect a Very Shiny Thing from the Iron Docks.
english.description: Listen, I don't know how I got here, but I have it on good authority that there is an entire island made of shiny things and it's just off of the coast a ways.$B$BAll we have to do is hop in the water and swim out there, then we can load up our pockets and swim back! I'm just going to rest up and do some stretching before heading out.$B$BDon't try and stop me!
english.progress: What?
english.completion: Oh... this is... well that's very shiny isn't it? I think... I'll just sit here for a while.$B$B<Budd smiles contentedly.>

text.title: 替我跑腿
text.objectives: 从奥金顿获得一口噩梦钟。
text.description: 这片荒蛮的土地正好配得上我的英勇气魄！$B$B哦，你好啊，我刚没注意到你正站那盯着我看。也许你已经发现了，我身上的每一件装备都是被时光所遗忘的古老遗物。$B$B你肯定猜得到，像我这么伟大的冒险者可没有时间去完成那些卑微的日常任务。我必须把宝贵的时间用来在这里站街，向贸易区喊话，好让其他人也能见识到我的豪杰气概，并受到鼓舞。$B$B今天的日常是噩梦钟，去帮我找来。
text.progress: What do you want?
text.completion: I see you have completed this menial task admirably, almost as if you were intended to experience such a thing. Ah fate, what do you have in store for me next?

english.title: Go Fetch
english.objectives: Collect a Nightmare Bell from Auchindoun.
english.description: Now THIS is a savage land worthy of my level of heroism!$B$BOh, hello, I did not see you standing there, staring at me. Perhaps you have noticed that every piece of my armor is an ancient relic, forgotten by time.$B$BAs you have properly surmised, an adventurer of my stature does not have time to complete the menial requests I am given daily. I must remain here, yelling aloud to the trade district so that others may witness my heroicness and be inspired.$B$BToday I require a Nightmare Bell, do find one.
english.progress: What do you want?
english.completion: I see you have completed this menial task admirably, almost as if you were intended to experience such a thing. Ah fate, what do you have in store for me next?

text.title: 天之舞者
text.objectives: 从通天峰收集一瓶瓶装风暴。
text.description: 您真是好客，$n。$B$B影踪派派了几位战士来协助你们对抗钢铁部落。但我们跟敌人的兵力相差悬殊，很难以寡敌众。$B$B南方的鸦人美丽而有着致命的杀伤力。他们如空气般悄无声息地出现，踩着致命的舞步划破一个又一个敌人的喉咙。$B$B疾风为他们助力，正如四风使我们盟友的脚步变得更加轻快一样。如果有可能的话，请帮我收集一些他们的风。这肯定会对我们有所帮助的。
text.progress: Did you find the fifth wind?
text.completion: I will take this to the Shado-pan right away. Fortune be with you, we will have need of your help again when the winds run quiet.

english.title: Sky Dancers
english.objectives: Collect a Bottled Windstorm from Skyreach.
english.description: Greetings, $n, and I thank you for your hospitality.$B$BThe Shado-pan have sent several warriors to aid against the Iron Horde, however we can. We are few, though, and they are many.$B$BThe arakkoa in the south are both beautiful and deadly. They appear lighter than air, their attacks a deadly dance that flits from opponent to opponent.$B$BThe winds are on their side, as the four winds lighten the steps of my own allies. Bring me a sample of their winds, if you are able. It will surely aid us.
english.progress: Did you find the fifth wind?
english.completion: I will take this to the Shado-pan right away. Fortune be with you, we will have need of your help again when the winds run quiet.

text.title: 奥拉留斯的冒险
text.objectives: 从黑石塔上层获得峰林火焰蜂。
text.description: 我和温奇，我们再一次结伴出来冒险啦！我跟你讲，这才叫人生！再也不需要呼吸灼热的空气，还有无数的食人魔可以砍！$B$B<奥拉留斯摸摸肚子。>不过我们在黑石塔还有一点活没干完。有一帮穿着铁甲的兽人带着些始祖龙从南方过来占领了黑石塔。$B$B老温奇，他放不下。自己一个人跑回去阻止他们了！$B$B也可能是去……加入他们！温奇，你这个背信弃义的兽人崽子。你必须去阻止他！
text.progress: Did ye stop him?
text.completion: Good thinkin'. Winky always loved these flameflies. If we gather enough of them, maybe we can convince hiim to come back!$B$BMaybe, er, you should hold onto this for a while, eh?

english.title: Oralius' Adventure
english.objectives: Collect a Spire Flamefly in Upper Blackrock Spire.
english.description: Me n' Winky, off on adventures again! This is the life, I tell ye. No burning air to breathe, an' plenty of ogres to kill!$B$B<Oralius rubs his belly.>$B$BWe did leave a bit of a mess back there in the Blackrock Spire, though. A whole mess of these iron-plated orcs and some proto-dragons marched right on up from the south and took it over.$B$BOl' Winky, he couldn't take the guilt. Went on back by himself he did, to stop them!$B$BOr... to JOIN them! Winky, ye two-timing son of an orc. Ye've got to stop him!
english.progress: Did ye stop him?
english.completion: Отличная мысль. Миг обожает этих огнежуков. Наловим их побольше и, возможно, сможем убедить его вернуться!$B$BДумаю... Пусть лучше это останется у тебя.

text.title: 虚空之门
text.objectives: 在影月墓地获得一把虚空之门钥匙。
text.description: 我的“主人”根本就是个脑残。而你的脑袋虽然长相古怪，但似乎还是有那么点智商的。$B$B听着，扭曲虚空是一处混乱的深渊，那里的法则和你的世界完全不同。我察觉到了一些扰动，这对你我都不是好事儿。$B$B没错，一定是德拉诺这里发生了什么，撕开了通往扭曲虚空的裂隙。你不用思考这事儿的原理，你的脑子会坏掉的。$B$B你要做的事情很简单：给我找一把虚空之门钥匙。这样我或许就能阻止那些坏事儿。
text.progress: You do know that any time you waste talking to me brings us closer to doom, right?
text.completion: Perfect, here's a prize for your efforts.$B$BI've got to head out and save everyone now. Again.

english.title: The Void-Gate
english.objectives: Find a Void-Gate Key in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
english.description: My 'master' is an idiot, but you look like you've got some smarts in that oddly-shaped head.$B$BListen up, the Twisting Nether is a chaotic abyss, and things work differently there. I've felt some disturbances, and they don't bode well for any of us.$B$BYes, there are things happening here, in Draenor, that are causing ripples in the nether. No, don't try to wrap your head around how that works, you'll only hurt yourself.$B$BIt's simple: bring me a Void-Gate Key, and maybe I can stop the bad things.
english.progress: You do know that any time you waste talking to me brings us closer to doom, right?
english.completion: Отлично. Вот твоя награда.$B$BА мне теперь нужно идти спасать мир. Опять.

text.title: 为了小孔雀
text.objectives: 在永茂林地找到一只孔雀小雏鸟。
text.description: 嗨！你有没有摸过小孔雀啊？$b$b<米露恩突然拉起你的双手，往你手心里塞了一只小鸟。>$b$b是不是毛茸茸的，又小巧又可爱？就像一朵长了鸟喙的小白云！这样可爱的小动物真是让人忍不住想要抱抱它，往它那张小嘴里喂食。$b$b但是啊，$n，永茂林地的那些植物怪却想把这些小孔雀变成大怪物。这些可怜的小家伙原本应该会长成美丽的白天鹅的，哦不对，应该是大孔雀？总之请你快去救救它们！
text.progress: Have you rescued a peachick? We're all they have, and those awful plant creatures are doing terrible things to them!$B$B<Mylune's voice suddenly drops two octaves and sends a chill up your spine.>$B$BTerrible. Things.
text.completion: <Mylune gently lifts the tiny little bird to her face, nuzzling it. It crawls onto her shoulder and disappears into her nest of green hair. A moment later, a beautiful fan of brightly-colored tailfeathers emerges from the top of her head.>$B$B<Mylune's bright blue eyes grow moist with tears and her mouth goes slack with adoration. You've made the dryad VERY happy.>

english.title: For the Birds
english.objectives: Find a Tiny Peachick Hatchling in The Everbloom.
english.description: Hi! Have you ever held a peachick hatchling?$b$b<Without warning, Mylune grabs both of your hands and then stuffs a tiny chirping bird in them.>$b$bIsn't it so small and light and downy? Like you're holding a beaky peepy lil' CLOUD! It's so adorable you can't help but hug it and cuddle it and stuff regurgitated food in its teeny-tiny mouth.$b$b$n, the plantfolk in the Everbloom are turning peachicks into monsters before they can grow into beautiful swans. Or whatever they grow into. Please help them!
english.progress: Have you rescued a peachick? We're all they have, and those awful plant creatures are doing terrible things to them!$B$B<Mylune's voice suddenly drops two octaves and sends a chill up your spine.>$B$BTerrible. Things.
english.completion: <Miluna gently kisses a bird. >> The peacock crawls on her shoulder and then disappears into the "nest" of her green hair. A second later, a beautiful fan of bright tail feathers appears above Miluna's head.$b$b<Miluna's blue eyes are filled with tears, and her mouth is opened with admiration. You've made the diadem VERY happy. >

text.title: 冰冷的钢铁
text.objectives: 从恐轨车站找到一门钢铁自动火炮。
text.description: 你知道我想要的是什么吗？那是每一名穿越了黑暗之门的战士真正想要的东西。我们来自一个不理解我们的世界，一个不需要我们的世界。我只想要让那个世界像我们爱它一样爱我们。$B$B但我们已经再也不属于那个世界了。战争已经成为了我们的一部分，我们再也回不去了。对每一个故乡的人而言，我们都只是可以牺牲的数字。$B$B如今唯一可以让我安心的东西只剩下手中用来瞄准敌人的冰冷铁炮。$B$B<基沙恩一言不发地盯着自己的酒杯。>
text.progress: Leave me alone.
text.completion: Yeah, this will do nicely. I'm going to run out of ammo, but at least I've got something to live for, for a while.$B$BHere, kid, you're gonna need this more than I am.

english.title: Cold Steel
english.objectives: Find an Iron Autocannon in Grimrail Depot.
english.description: Do you know what I want? What everyone who came through that portal wants. Every soldier running from a world that didn't understand us, didn't need us. I want that world to love us as much as we love it.$B$BBut we don't really belong there, not anymore. War is part of us, and we can't go back. To everyone back there, we're expendable.$B$BThe only thing that makes me feel better now is the feel of a cold iron cannon in my hands, pointed at the enemy.$B$B<Keeshan stares into his mug of ale.>
english.progress: Leave me alone.
english.completion: Yes, it does. The ammunition, of course, will end, but at least for a while I will have a goal in life.$B$BNow, you will need it more than me.

text.title: 克鲁的复仇
text.objectives: 从血槌炉渣矿井拿一颗巨大的食人魔脑袋。
text.description: 哈！那个水果贩子真是狡猾，但我克鲁·粗线更加狡猾。我回到了过去来击垮他们打算用来对付我的食人魔军队！$B$B去那个旧炉渣矿井给我带一个大颗的食人魔脑袋来，我要在那水果贩子的第一颗苹果长出来之前碾碎她！$B$B听见没有，水果贩子！我才是胜利者！
text.progress: THE FRUIT VENDOR STANDS NO CHANCE!
text.completion: Revenge has the sweetest taste. Like an apple.$B$BTake this, friend. May all of your fruit be CRUSHED INTO PULP LIKE YOUR ENEMIES.

english.title: Cro's Revenge
english.objectives: Collect a Giant Ogre Head from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
english.description: HA! The fruit vendor was so cunning, but I, Cro Threadstrong, am even MORE cunning. I have come back into the past to defeat the ogre army before that fruit vendor can turn them against me!$B$BBring me the head of a big, strong ogre from the old slag mines, and I will have crushed the fruit vendor before a single apple has even grown!$B$BCAN YOU HEAR ME, FRUIT VENDOR? I WILL HAVE MY VICTORY!
english.progress: THE FRUIT VENDOR STANDS NO CHANCE!
english.completion: Месть сладка, прямо как яблоко.$B$BВозьми это, $gдруг:подруга;. Пусть все твои фрукты ПРЕВРАЩАЮТСЯ В ПЮРЕ, КАК ТВОИ ВРАГИ.

text.title: 迷时的维京人
text.objectives: 从血槌炉渣矿井获得奥拉夫的盾。
text.description: 噢，好不容易才从那里逃出来！$B$B我们穿过了传送门来帮忙，接下来的事儿你都知道了，我们成了血槌炉渣矿井里的囚犯。实在是太残忍了！我们整天被铐着，身上还粘着屎尿。$B$B他们还把我的盾牌给抢走了！
text.progress: <Olaf sobs.>
text.completion: Oi, it's a fair sight dirtier, but that's her! Here, this is for you. You have my thanks.

english.title: Time-Lost Vikings
english.objectives: Collect Olaf's Shield from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
english.description: Oi, barely made it out of that place!$B$BWe came through the portal to help, and the next thing you know, we're prisoners in the Bloodmaul Slag Mine. It was brutal! We were shackled for days, and covered in filth.$B$BAnd they took my SHIELD!
english.progress: <Olaf sobs.>
english.completion: Щит, конечно, здорово запачкался, но это он! Вот, держи – это тебе. Спасибо.

text.title: 治愈死亡
text.objectives: 从奥金顿获得一件织魂容器。
text.description: 幸会，感谢您的好客和这间温暖的旅馆。$B$B如您所见，这死亡的疾病今日仍然在纠缠着我。我在艾泽拉斯和诺森德的研究都遇到了瓶颈。$B$B因此我来到德拉诺，希望能有任何新的收获，好帮助我继续进行研究。我的朝圣之旅的第一站将是奥金顿，德莱尼灵魂们的安息之地。$B$B要是你也打算去那儿，一定要告诉我你在那儿是否有遇到什么有趣的事儿。
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: This... may help me. I will need to return to Light's Hope shortly, you have my thanks.$B$BI will not need these supplies any longer, they are yours.

english.title: The Cure For Death
english.objectives: Collect a Soulweave Vessel from Auchindoun.
english.description: Greetings, and my thanks for the warmth of this inn and your hospitality.$B$BAs you can see, this malady of death continues to plague me. My studies on Azeroth and in Northrend met with little luck, and all of my leads ran dry.$B$BI have come to Draenor in the hope of finding something, anything, to go on. My first pilgrimage will be to Auchindoun, a house where souls are put at ease.$B$BIf you should head there yourself, do let me know if you should happen upon anything of interest.
english.progress: Did you find anything?
english.completion: Это... может пригодиться. Так, мне пора в Часовню Последней Надежды. Спасибо за помощь.$B$BЭти припасы мне больше не понадобятся, они твои.

text.title: 铜罗盘
text.objectives: 在钢铁码头找到铜罗盘。
text.description: 幸会，指挥官。我受船长的直接指派，前来执行一项任务。$B$B在艾泽拉斯的任何一艘船上，只要有兽人在，你一定会听到船工们在传唱一个用来在德拉诺的海洋上指引航向的装置。兽人们用它来在狂风暴雨中校准他们船只的方向。$B$B这或许只是一个古老的海上传说，但若是有机会能找到这样一件宝物，船长愿意花大价钱来买下它。
text.progress: Did you find the compass?
text.completion: This might just be what we were looking for. Here's your booty.

english.title: The Brass Compass
english.objectives: Find the Brass Compass at the Iron Docks.
english.description: Greetings, commander. I have come on a mission directly from the captain.$B$BAboard any vessel on Azeroth that's manned by at least one orc, you'll hear sea shanties sung about a device capable of navigating the broad, rough ocean of Draenor. The orcs used it to keep their heading true in the choppiest of storms.$B$BPerhaps it's just an old sea tale, but this one chance to find that kind of prize has the captain willing to part with some fine treasure.
english.progress: Did you find the compass?
english.completion: Maybe that's exactly what we need. Here's your cut.

text.title: 斩魂者
text.objectives: 从奥金顿获取一把裂魂之刃。
text.description: 不许盯着我看！你以为你算什么东西？$B$B知道吗？你和我是站在同一边的。我们要杀掉这里的通灵师。杀光他们。$B$B你有异议吗？$B$B你当然没意见，而且你可以帮我达成这个目的。这帮通灵师像见不得光的老鼠一样躲藏在那间小屋里，里面有一把裂魂之刃，它有着……非常特殊的功效……能帮助我们对抗那些亡灵。
text.progress: Did you find the blade?
text.completion: Excellent, most excellent.$B$BI will wear it down quickly, and it cannot be repaired due to its unique nature. Expect to hear from me again.

english.title: The Soulcutter
english.objectives: Collect a Soulsever Blade from Auchindoun.
english.description: Don't look at me! Who do you think you are?$B$BYou and I are on the same side, you know. The necromancers here, we have to kill them. All of them.$B$BDon't you agree?$B$BOf course you do, and you can help me accomplish this goal. Find a Soulsever Blade in that hovel where the necromancers have holed up like rats. It has... special properties... that will aid us against the undead.
english.progress: Did you find the blade?
english.completion: Отлично, просто отлично.$B$BУ меня он быстро придет в негодность, ведь чинить его нельзя – такой он уникальный. Так что я к тебе еще обращусь.

text.title: 莫罗斯的标准
text.objectives: 从钢铁码头获得一桶可怕的酸性溶液。
text.description: 这么多年来，身为一名活死人，一次次地被各种未知的力量复生，我如今已经没有了太多的念想——就希望能拥有安宁而永恒的死亡。$B$B但还有一件事放心不下，要是能弄来点溶剂，去除掉指挥官和您那些好伙伴们在卡拉赞餐厅做客时留下的划痕和污渍就好了。好在客人们都停留得不久，没能对那些珍贵的家具造成过无可挽回的损害。
text.progress: Was the commander successful?
text.completion: One is eternally in your debt for what is, one is certain, an entirely selfless act on the part of the commander.$B$BThough more barrels were likely available, one will staunchly make do with the single barrel provided, comforted in the knowledge that the commander must deal with the great pressing issues of this land, and does not have time to clean up the mud that that so dutifully follows the commander's heroic allies.

english.title: Feeling A Bit Morose
english.objectives: Collect a barrel of Horribly Acidic Solution from the Iron Docks.
english.description: So many years of waking up as a spirit, reanimated by some unseen force time and again, has left one with certain desires - the comforting, velvet blackness of death being chief amongst them.$B$BOne will, however, settle for the lesser prize of a solution capable of removing the scuff marks that the commander's wonderful compatriots left behind in the dining hall in their woefully short stay in Karazhan, whereupon they barely had enough time to irreparably damage the priceless furniture.
english.progress: Was the commander successful?
english.completion: Я чрезмерно благодарен за столь бескорыстный жест! Вероятно, сосудов, содержащих нужную жидкость, было больше одного, но я непременно добьюсь прекрасных результатов и со столь малым количеством раствора. Меня радует мысль о том, что командир слишком занят более насущными проблемами, проблемами мира сего... У него просто-напросто нет свободного времени, чтобы тратить его на уборку того бедлама, что имеет обыкновение окружать его доблестных соратников.

text.title: 炽热的光明
text.objectives: 从通天峰获得一颗太阳水晶。
text.description: 我大老远赶来这里，并不是为了和谁战斗，我这辈子见过的死亡已经太多了。我自己也曾亲手杀死过许多的敌人。$B$B我来这里是为了追寻圣光和救赎。$B$B这片大陆上的鸦人和我一样崇拜太阳。但他们整个种族却又是如此地暴力、颓废和孤绝。为什么他们会从太阳那里得到与我们完全不同的结论。这件事情一直困扰着我。$B$B给我带一颗他们的太阳水晶来。我想要亲眼看看它的光芒。
text.progress: Did you find the crystal?
text.completion: The sun, I can see it. It is so bright.$B$BI... wish to be alone. Take this, and my thanks.

english.title: Gloriously Incandescent
english.objectives: Collect a Sun Crystal in Skyreach.
english.description: I did not come here to fight, I have seen too many die already. I have killed so many with my own hands.$B$BI have come to seek the light, and redemption.$B$BThe arakkoa of this land worship the sun as I do. But they are a violent, isolationist, and decadent race, who seem to derive a different message than my own people. This troubles me.$B$BBring me one of their Sun Crystals. I wish to see this light.
english.progress: Did you find the crystal?
english.completion: Я вижу солнце. Оно такое яркое.$B$BЯ... хочу побыть один. Возьми это – в знак моей благодарности.

text.title: 艾维娜的请求
text.objectives: 从通天峰获取完整的羽毛。
text.description: 鸦人是属于天空的生物，因此他们同样归属于艾维娜的领域。$B$B我受命来此取一根羽毛，方便我们使用轻风之语来与他们沟通。我们希望向他们发出和平的邀请，与他们在大树荫会面。$B$B你愿意帮我们完成这项任务吗？我们要的羽毛必须来自一位鸦人贵族。你可以在通天峰找到许多的鸦人贵族。
text.progress: Did you bring a feather?
text.completion: My thanks, $n. Aviana will be pleased, and we may yet be able to aid you.$B$BAviana has sought fit to bless you with this, use it well.

english.title: Aviana's Request
english.objectives: Collect some Pristine Plumage in Skyreach.
english.description: The arakkoa are creatures of the sky, and are thus within the domain of the great Aviana.$B$BI have been sent to procure a feather, that we may parley with them through the language of the winds. We will extend an invitation of peace, and a place on the Great Bough.$B$BWould you aid us in this quest? The feather must come from an arakkoan of nobility. You will find them in the place known as Skyreach.
english.progress: Did you bring a feather?
english.completion: Спасибо, $n. Авиана будет довольна. Вероятно, мы сможем тебе помочь.$B$BАвиана решила, что лучше всего будет одарить тебя этим. Используй с умом.

text.title: 加摩尔无双
text.objectives: 在恐轨车站找到一把钢铁断肢刃。
text.description: 我，加摩尔，穿越了黑暗之门，来这里收割更多的兽人。但我的武器太钝了，而且已经豁了口，完全跟不上我的怒火。$B$B帮我找一把新武器——我要用它来斩断地狱咆哮的四肢！
text.progress: What?
text.completion: I like this blade. It will see me through much removing of limbs. Here, for you, something to remember me by.

english.title: Cleaving Time
english.objectives: Find an Iron Limbcleaver in Grimrail Depot.
english.description: I, Gamon, have come through the dark portal to cleave many orc skulls. Yet my weapon has not kept pace with my rage, and is nicked and dull.$B$BFind me a new weapon - one that is good for removing Hellscream limbs.
english.progress: What?
english.completion: Мне нравится этот топор. Он поможет мне рубить конечности врагу. Вот, держи – кое-что на память обо мне.

text.title: 家族遗传
text.objectives: 在黑石塔找到芬克的改良剥皮刀。
text.description: 他带着它跑了！哦，我该怎办？$B$B我儿子，还有我的剥皮刀，他们都跑到黑石塔去了！哦，确切地说，刀是不会跑的。这细节无关紧要！$B$B你一定要把它带回来！我是说我的刀！你一定要把我的剥皮刀带回来！$B$B快！没时间闲聊了！
text.progress: Where's my knife?
text.completion: You found it! It's safe! I was so worried! Take this, take it!

english.title: Family Traditions
english.objectives: Find Finkle's Improved Skinner in Blackrock Spire.
english.description: He ran off with it! Oh what am I going to do, what am I going to DO?$B$BMy son, and my knife, they ran off to Blackrock Spire! Well, the knife didn't run, I suppose. That doesn't matter!$B$BYou've got to get it back! Yes, the knife! You've got to get me back my knife!$B$BGo! Now! Stop talking!
english.progress: Where's my knife?
english.completion: Ты его $gнашел:нашла;! Я так о нем беспокоился! Вот, бери это, бери!

text.title: 巨龙与丽人
text.objectives: 获得一只脱落的始祖龙爪。
text.description: 喔吼，我的侍从$n！请原谅我，我的双唇将带来悲伤的消息。据说黑石塔神圣的殿堂中出现了巨龙丑恶的身影！$B$B那些恶龙还将一位落难的少女虏到了那个巢穴中。据说她的名字叫扎伊拉。啊，多么美丽的名字！$B$B圣光在上，我的侍从。你的职责就是潜入黑石塔中，寻找那些巨龙存在的证据，以免我白跑一趟，浪费精神。
text.progress: Did you find evidence of dragons?
text.completion: This is dire evidence indeed! I shall head there presently, to slay no less than twenty of the great beasts.$B$BFor Doloria!

english.title: Damsels and Dragons
english.objectives: Collect a Shed Proto-Dragon Claw.
english.description: What ho, squire $n! Forgive my lips, as they bear gravest news. Dragons have taken up stinking residence within the hallowed halls of Blackrock Spire!$B$BThese great wyrms hold a distressed damsel in their scaly graspers. Her name is Zaela, they say. Such a beautiful name!$B$BAs my squire, it is your Light-given duty to adventure yourself into this spire and procure evidence of these dragons, lest I waste my heroism on a dragonless quest.
english.progress: Did you find evidence of dragons?
english.completion: Это действительно жуткое доказательство! Я немедленно отправлюсь туда, чтобы убить не менее двадцати этих монстров.$B$BЗа Долорию!

text.title: 暗影的秘密
text.objectives: 从影月墓地获取暗色羊皮纸。
text.description: 虽然巫妖王已经被击败了，我们对冰封王座的秘密仍未有更彻底的了解。说到底我们之前也只是在银色锦标赛中毫无意义地戳来戳去而已。伯瓦尔还留在那里接受他的命运。$B$B但我们现在所处的这个世界却可能对我们起到一定的帮助。如你所知，耐奥祖并非一直是巫妖王。早年，他也只是一个盲目地涉足他所无法理解的黑暗力量的兽人而已。$B$B帮我找找他的一些早期研究，我们或许可以从中找到想要的答案。
text.progress: Did you find any of Ner'zhul's notes?
text.completion: You have my thanks. I will bring this back to the Ebon Hold immediately.$B$BTake this, I... acquired it... from one of the Shadowmoon.

english.title: Shadowy Secrets
english.objectives: Collect a Dark Parchment from the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
english.description: Though the Lich King has been defeated, we are no closer to unlocking the secrets of the Frozen Throne than we were when jousting pointlessly at the Argent Tournament. Bolvar remains resigned to his fate.$B$BPerhaps there is something here, though, that can aid us. Ner'zhul was not always the Lich King, you know. Once, he was a mere orc dabbling in dark powers beyond his comprehension.$B$BFind whatever you can of his early studies, and we may have our answers.
english.progress: Did you find any of Ner'zhul's notes?
english.completion: Thank you. I'll take this to the Black Bulwark right away.$B$BBozumi this, I... got this... from an orc of the Phantom Moon Clan.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 女猎手
text.objectives: 从影月墓地获取包银箭支。
text.description: 我并不希望从暗影里出来，但我绝无恶意。我来这儿自有我的秘密任务，我只需要一张床和一个温暖的地方过夜。$B$B不过你看来不像那种会被几句话就轻易打发走的人。好吧，也许你能帮我一把。$B$B我在找一个人，这人是谁并不重要。你只要知道，如果你帮我找到任何高等精灵的武器，我会重金酬谢你的。
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: This is... it can't be.$B$BI must be off, here is your reward. I do not part with it lightly...

english.title: The Huntresses
english.objectives: Collect a Silver-Lined Arrow from the Shadowmoon Burial Ground.
english.description: I do not wish to come out of the shadows, but I mean you no harm. My purpose here is my own secret to keep, I simply needed a warm place to bed down for the night.$B$BI can see that you are not the type to be easily swayed into leaving. Very well, perhaps you can aid me in my search.$B$BI am looking for someone, it is not important who. All you need to know is that I will reward you for any sign of high elven weaponry that you should come across.
english.progress: Did you find anything?
english.completion: Этого... Не может быть.$B$BМне пора, вот твоя награда. Мне нелегко с ней расставаться...

text.title: 塞纳里奥的忧虑
text.objectives: 从永茂林地获得一片发光的怪蕨叶。
text.description: 嗨，伙计！$B$B塞纳里奥议会派赞吉吉来这里查探原兽的动向。我本来能早些来的，但不知怎么地，我的飞行形态在这里无法正常使用，伙计。$B$B这地方的植物……我甚至能听到它们在说话。它们一直在凶猛地咆哮着什么“永茂林地”之类的话。$B$B你愿意去那地方给赞吉吉带一片叶子回来吗？这样我也许就能弄清楚它们的目的了。
text.progress: Did ya have much luck, mon?
text.completion: Dis... is no good. Dey want to consume da whole planet. How did dey get so angry? What happened to dem? I'm gonna bring dis back to da Circle, we probably gonna need your help again soon.$B$BOne of dem fronds be a bit magical, you hold onto it for a bit.

english.title: Cenarion Concerns
english.objectives: Collect a Strangely-Glowing Frond from Everbloom.
english.description: Ey mon!$B$BDe Cenarion Circle sent Zen'kiki out here ta check out dem primals. I woulda been here sooner, but I had a little bit o' trouble gettin' my flight form ta work, mon.$B$BDe plants in dis place... I can hear dem talk. Dey be yellin' all the time. Angry an' violent yellin'.$B$BWould ya bring Zen'kiki back a leaf from dis Everbloom place dey be talkin' about? Maybe I can figure out what dey want.
english.progress: Did ya have much luck, mon?
english.completion: Мне это не нравится. Они хотят поглотить всю планету. С чего они так взбеленились? Кто их обидел? Нужно поскорее отнести это в Круг. Твоя помощь наверняка понадобится снова.$B$BОдин из этих листов чутка волшебный, не теряй его.

text.title: 泰坦与世界的演化
text.objectives: 从永茂林地获得一份茂林神器。
text.description: 啊，你好啊！别那么惊讶嘛！还记得我曾经跑到魔古山宝库里去过吗？我可比我外表看上去结实多了！$B$B我曾经在史书上看过许多和这片大陆有关的奇闻。你知道吗？就和我们的艾泽拉斯一样，泰坦曾经也降临过这个世界！$B$B至少，我的观点是如此！即使是现在，在这片大陆上也仍有不少与泰坦有关的痕迹。假如你能帮忙找出来，我一定会好好研究下的！
text.progress: Have you found any signs of the titans here?
text.completion: This is precisely what I was hoping for! I shall begin to study it immediately.$B$BWhile you were away, I collected these pretty flowers for you!

english.title: Titanic Evolution
english.objectives: Collect an Overgrown Artifact from The Everbloom.
english.description: Ah, hello! Do not look so surprised! Did I not also brave the dangers of the Mogu'shan Vaults? I am more sturdy than I look!$B$BI have learned many things of this wonderful place in history already. Did you know that, just like on our world, the titans once came to this place?$B$BAt least, that is what I believe! Surely there are signs of the titans' presence here, even now. Should you find one, I would very much like to see it!
english.progress: Have you found any signs of the titans here?
english.completion: Именно такая находка мне и нужна! Немедленно приступаю к исследованиям.$B$BА ты возьми эти прекрасные цветы. Они сорваны специально для тебя!

text.title: 对了，锤子不要！
text.objectives: 从恐轨车站获得一大箱武器。
text.description: 许多年轻有志的潜行者穿过了传送门来参与这场战争。但我若想要让我的学院东山再起，就显然不能让他们都在这阵亡。$B$B我想来想去，觉得我应该利用这个机会为我的再次开业准备一些资源。要是没有足够的匕首，你根本没法做生意，不是吗？$B$B从恐轨车站帮我弄一箱武器来，那里肯定到处都是这玩意儿。酬劳少不了你的。
text.progress: Did you find me some weapons?
text.completion: Yes, these will do nicely. My thanks, and here is your reward.$B$BTry not to die, I may need you again.

english.title: And No Maces!
english.objectives: Collect a Huge Crate of Weapons in Grimrail Depot.
english.description: There are far too many bright-eyed young rogues being sent through this portal and off to war. If I'm going to start up my academy again, some of them have got to survive this little excursion.$B$BWhile I'm here, I figured I might as well use the opportunity to gather some supplies for my grand opening. You can't start a business without plenty of daggers, after all.$B$BGrab me a crate of weaponry from the Grimrail Depot, there should be plenty lying around. I'll have something nice for you.
english.progress: Did you find me some weapons?
english.completion: Yes, that will do. Thanks. And here is your reward. Try not to die - maybe someday I will need your services again.

text.title: Craig's Test Quest Again!
text.objectives: Get Omar some cloth
text.description: 高尚的人給我衣服

english.title: Craig's Test Quest Again!
english.objectives: Get Omar some cloth
english.description: An honorable person gives me cloth

text.title: 利爪之王的召唤
text.objectives: 在泰罗克鸦巢与泰罗克之影谈一谈。
text.description:
$p，你为我的人民提供了很多帮助。我希望能代他们当面感谢你。

有空的时候，请来泰罗克鸦巢一叙。
text.completion: Thank you for coming.
text.completed: 在泰罗克鸦巢与泰罗克之影谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 利爪之王召你回泰罗克鸦巢。

english.title: Call of the Talon King
english.objectives: Speak with the Shade of Terokk in Veil Terokk.
english.description:
$p, you have done much for my people. I wish to thank you on their behalf.

Please visit Veil Terokk when you can.
english.completion: Спасибо, что $gоткликнулся:откликнулась; на зов.
english.completed: Speak with the Shade of Terokk in Veil Terokk.
english.giverWindow: The Talon King calls you back to Veil Terokk.

text.title: 为了孩子！
text.objectives: 从黑石塔上层获得一颗迷你钢铁之星。
text.description: 等等，等等！别打我！我已经改邪归正了！$B$B真的，我已经改了，甚至有好几个月没说过“末日降临！”之类的台词了！我现在致力于帮助艾泽拉斯那些可怜的战争孤儿们。$B$B所以我才来这儿的！你问为什么？只要有一颗迷你钢铁之星，我就能给艾泽拉斯所有的孤儿们都提供清洁的水和电力！而且没有人可以阻止我了！$B$B你怎么说，小甜心？你愿意帮助老米尔豪斯拯救那些孤儿吗？
text.progress: Did you find the Iron Star?
text.completion: You know, you're quite handy, and awfully powerful. Why don't I just follow you for a while?$B$BLook out Draenor, DOOOOOOOOM is coming!

english.title: For The Children!
english.objectives: Collect a Miniature Iron Star from Upper Blackrock Spire.
english.description: Wait, wait! Don't attack me! I've changed!$B$BReally, I've turned over a new leaf, I promise. I haven't said "DOOOOOOM!" in months! All I care about now is saving the poor little orphans of Azeroth, whose parents have been taken by this tragic war.$B$BThat's why I'm here! Why, with just a single Miniature Iron Star, I could provide clean water and power for all of the orphans of Azeroth! And no one could stop me!$B$BSo, what do you think, sweetcheeks? Want to help ol' Milhouse save the orphans?
english.progress: Did you find the Iron Star?
english.completion: Знаешь, а ты очень $gнаходчивый:находчивая; и ужасно $gмогущественный:могущественная;. Может, я на время примкну к тебе?$B$BБерегись, Дренор, идет твоя ПОГИ-И-БЕЛЬ!

text.title: 没有佩剑的食人魔……
text.objectives: 从纳格兰破碎悬崖的宰相达古德身上取回托莫克心爱的佩剑。
text.description: 在被发配到戈尔隆德之前，我就驻扎在纳格兰的破碎悬崖，管理那片乱糟糟的挖掘场。达古德宰相不肯让我带上我喜爱的佩剑。他跟我说，我要去的地方用不上它。$B$B我想把它拿回来，指挥官。我想我们的实力足以打倒达古德，并从他血淋淋的尸体上拿回我的剑了。$B$B它对我意义重大。没有佩剑的食人魔根本算不上食人魔。
text.progress: I want my sword more than I can tell you, commander.
text.completion: Yes... this is it.$B$BCommander, I will cleave your foes like never before now that I have my sword.
text.completed: Return to Tormmok at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: An Ogre Without His Sword...
english.objectives: Retrieve Tormmok's Favorite Sword from Vizier Dar'gud at Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
english.description: Before I was shipped off to Gorgrond, I was stationed at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand, maintaining order over the unruly dredges. Vizier Dar'gud refused to let me take my favorite sword; he told me "I wouldn't need it where I was going."$B$BI want it back, commander, and we are powerful enough together to take it from Dar'gud's bloody corpse.$B$BIt would mean a great deal to me. An ogre without his sword isn't an ogre at all.
english.progress: I want my sword more than I can tell you, commander.
english.completion: Yes... this is it.$B$BCommander, I will cleave your foes like never before now that I have my sword.
english.completed: Return to Tormmok at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 利奥拉的念珠
text.objectives: 从斯克提斯的风舞者奇洛克斯身上获得利奥拉的念珠。
text.description: 利奥拉当萨满那天，虎王给了利奥拉念珠。念珠帮我听见元素说话。$B$B有一天鸟人打了来，它们抢走了念珠并带去了斯克提斯。$B$B主人，你帮利奥拉拿回念珠好吗？
text.progress: Elements don't speak to Leorajh like they used to.
text.completion: Thank you, master! Elements speak to Leorajh again.
text.completed: Return to Leorajh at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Leorajh's Prayer Beads
english.objectives: Retrieve Leorajh's Prayer Beads from Kirox the Wind Dancer in Skettis.
english.description: When Leorajh became shaman, pridelord gave prayer beads. Beads help Leorajh hear elements.$B$BOne day bird-men attacked and took prayer beads. Took them to Skettis.$B$BMaster, you help Leorajh get prayer beads back?
english.progress: Elements don't speak to Leorajh like they used to.
english.completion: Thank you, master! Elements speak to Leorajh again.
english.completed: Return to Leorajh at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 努力测量
text.objectives: 从影月谷影月飞地的乌娜·黑尺身上取得乌娜的测量杖。
text.description: 还有其他一些人在利用暗影实现自己的计划。你知道我说的是谁，指挥官……影月兽人。$B$B他们已经着手精进自己的技艺……召唤异界的暗影……$B$B我渴望他们的力量，他们当中有人有一把法杖是我最为垂涎的……我们必须把那力量据为己有。
text.progress: Taking out our enemies and gaining great power in one motion... my people have a saying for this: Killing two orcs with one stone.
text.completion: Yes... yes... this will do nicely. We can use this to do great things.$B$BThank you, commander.
text.completed: Return to Talonpriest Ishaal at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

english.title: Scrying Hard or Hardly Scrying
english.objectives: Retrieve Urna's Fathomstaff from Urna Darkfathom at Shadowmoon Enclave in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: There are others that harness the shadows to do their bidding. You know of them, commander... the Shadowmoon orcs.$B$BThey have begun to master their craft... they call to the shadows beyond this realm...$B$BI desire their power. They have one who possesses a staff of particular interest... we should claim it as our own.
english.progress: Taking out our enemies and gaining great power in one motion... my people have a saying for this: Killing two orcs with one stone.
english.completion: Yes... yes... this will do nicely. We can use this to do great things.$B$BThank you, commander.
english.completed: Return to Talonpriest Ishaal at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

text.title: 战略要冲
text.objectives: 与杜加尔·朗德瑞克谈一谈，飞往塔拉多。
text.description: 塔拉多的褐色森林正处于这片大陆上的重要战略位置，指挥官。钢铁部落的舰队已经从戈尔隆德启程，前往位于塔拉多西岸的沙塔斯了。$B$B要是我们不赶去增援，塔拉多必将陷落。我自作主张地派出了监工艾克索斯，他已经开始在钢铁部落的登陆点附近为你的军队建造哨站了。他在等待你的命令，长官。
text.completion: I won't waste any of your time, sir. Let us discuss strategy.

english.title: The Critical Path
english.objectives: Speak to Dungar Longdrink to secure a flight to Talador.
english.description: The auburn forests of Talador sit at a critical crossroads of this continent, commander. The Iron Horde's fleet is already en route from Gorgrond to Shattrath on the west coast.$B$BTalador will fall if we don't reinforce them. I took the liberty of dispatching Foreman Eksos, who has already begun construction on an outpost for your forces not far from the Iron Horde landing point. He awaits your orders sir.
english.completion: Не буду отнимать у тебя время, командир. Перейдем к обсуждению стратегии.

text.title: 纳格兰的战火
text.objectives: 与纳格兰车队的巴弗尔中尉谈一谈。
text.description: 指挥官，很高兴见到你。自从塔拉的游侠基地陷落以后，守备官伊瑞尔就建议我们在纳格兰建立一处新的据点。$B$B我自作主张派了一些我们的人和物资过去。游侠达坎报告说那边的岗哨已经快要建设好了。他让我跟你说一声这事儿。$B$B我准备了一只狮鹫，可以带你追上我们最后一批车队。一旦你准备好了就随时可以出发，$g先生:女士;。
text.completion: They came at us... from... nowhere.$B$B<The lieutenant nearly passes out.>

english.title: Taking the Fight to Nagrand
english.objectives: Speak with Lieutenant Balfor at the caravan in Nagrand.
english.description: Commander, good to see you. With the fall of the rangari base at Telaar, Vindicator Yrel, recommended that we establish a new foothold in Nagrand.$b$bI've taken the liberty of dispatching some of our men and supplies. Rangari D'kaan's already reporting that the outpost is nearly complete. He asked me to let you know they are ready for you.$b$bA gryphon is waiting to catch you up with the latest caravan shipment whenever you're ready, $g sir:ma'am;.
english.completion: They came at us... from... nowhere.$B$B<The lieutenant nearly passes out.>

text.title: 烈焰之刃桑克苏
text.objectives: 把烈焰之刃桑克苏带回你的要塞给索恩中尉看看。
text.description: 这把剑火烫火烫的，剑柄上的珠宝似乎在瞪视着你，看你敢不敢接下它。$B$B或许你要塞里的人会有兴趣看到这件武器。
text.completion: <Lieutenant Thorn handles the weapon, her keen eyes taking note of every line, edge, and scratch. After several moments, she speaks.>$B$BMagnificent.$B$BThis blade was honed by a master craftsman, and imbued with ancient magic.$B$BJust imagine if such a powerful weapon were placed in the hands of a skilled warrior...

english.title: Sanketsu, The Burning Blade
english.objectives: Bring Sanketsu, the Burning Blade, to Lieutenant Thorn at your garrison.
english.description: The blade is searing hot to the touch. The jewel on its hilt stares at you, as if daring you to claim it.$B$BPerhaps someone at your garrison would be interested in seeing this weapon.
english.completion: <Lieutenant Thorn handles the weapon, her keen eyes taking note of every line, edge, and scratch. After several moments, she speaks.>$B$BMagnificent.$B$BThis blade was honed by a master craftsman, and imbued with ancient magic.$B$BJust imagine if such a powerful weapon were placed in the hands of a skilled warrior...

text.title: 烈焰之刃桑克苏
text.objectives: 把烈焰之刃桑克苏带回你的要塞给战争大师佐格看看。
text.description: 这把剑火烫火烫的，剑柄上的珠宝似乎在瞪视着你，看你敢不敢接下它。$B$B或许你要塞里的人会有兴趣看到这件武器。
text.completion: <Warmaster Zog lifts the blade into the air, admiring its balance and heft.>$B$BNever have I seen a weapon such as this. It was clearly made by a master, imbued with ancient magic, and tested in many a battle.$B$BCommander, I will leave the choice to you, but it would be an honor to see this blade placed in service of this garrison.

english.title: Sanketsu, The Burning Blade
english.objectives: Bring Sanketsu, the Burning Blade, to Warmaster Zog at your garrison.
english.description: The blade is searing hot to the touch. The jewel on its hilt stares at you, as if daring you to claim it.$B$BPerhaps someone at your garrison would be interested in seeing this weapon.
english.completion: <Warmaster Zog lifts the blade into the air, admiring its balance and heft.>$B$BNever have I seen a weapon such as this. It was clearly made by a master, imbued with ancient magic, and tested in many a battle.$B$BCommander, I will leave the choice to you, but it would be an honor to see this blade placed in service of this garrison.

text.title: 凯米尔·辉刃
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败凯米尔·辉刃。
text.description: 在最近的一次考古挖掘中，我发现了一些有意思的古物。我很想实地操作一下它们，观察它们在本土文化中的表现。你不会正巧有带着几个小宠物可以让它们来打上一架吧？
text.completion: Thanks for helping me test out these artifacts.

english.title: Cymre Brightblade
english.objectives: Defeat Cymre Brightblade in a pet battle.
english.description: I found some interesting artifacts on a recent dig, and I'd love to put them through their paces to see how they would have performed in their native cultures.  Don't suppose you have anything small and furry that can put up a fight?
english.completion: Thanks for helping me test out these artifacts.

text.title: 阿什雷
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败阿什雷。
text.description: 我其实不太喜欢让宠物去战斗，但我喜欢在它们战斗结束之后照顾它们。
text.completion: That was fun.

english.title: Ashlei
english.objectives: Defeat Ashlei in a pet battle.
english.description: I don't really like when my pets fight, but I love making them feel better when they're done.
english.completion: It was fun.

text.title: 烈火重燃
text.objectives: 把火焰精华交给玛戈纳洛克的法瑞加。
text.description: 我快不行了，$r。我的火焰，即将燃尽……很快，我的光芒就会归于虚无。$b$b你绝不能坐视不理。去帮我把火焰精华拿来，让我能继续生存下去，我发誓一定要将所有破坏者烧成灰烬。$b$b我要为我的兄弟姐妹们报仇。
text.completion: The flames, they burn within me!
text.completed: Return to Firaga in Magnarok.

english.title: Rekindling an Old Flame
english.objectives: Deliver the Essence of Flame to Firaga in Magnarok.
english.description: I am dying, $r. My flame, it smolders... soon my light will flicker and fade into nothing.$b$bYou mustn't allow this. Retrieve for me the Essence of Flame. Allow me to live another day and I will burn every breaker to ash, I swear it.$b$bI will take vengeance for my brothers and sisters.
english.completion: The flames, they burn within me!
english.completed: Return to Firaga in Magnarok.

text.title: 加戈拉
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败加戈拉。
text.description: 你想挑战我吗？我的狼需要通过训练才能变得更强。
text.completion: You have helped my pups train, and for that I give thanks.

english.title: Gargra
english.objectives: Defeat Gargra in a pet battle.
english.description: Do you wish to offer challenge?  My wolves must train to become strong.
english.completion: You have helped my pups train, and for that I give thanks.

text.title: 可怕的塔尔
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败可怕的塔尔。
text.description: 塔尔才是真正的战神！带你的军队来与我一战，我会向你证明这一点。
text.completion: You lucky this time.

english.title: Tarr the Terrible
english.objectives: Defeat Tarr the Terrible in a pet battle.
english.description: Tarr is the true warlord!  Bring your army to fight and I show you.
english.completion: You lucky this time.

text.title: 维沙尔
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败维沙尔。
text.description: 我预见到今天会有一位战斗宠物大师来挑战我。就是你吗？
text.completion: The feathers have fallen and shown us much.

english.title: Vesharr
english.objectives: Defeat Vesharr in a pet battle.
english.description: I had a vision with one who had mastered pets came to challenge me.  Has the vision finally come to pass?
english.completion: The feathers have fallen and shown us much.

text.title: 塔拉鲁恩
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败塔拉鲁恩。
text.description: 我致力于通过非致命性的宠物对战来传授知识。你可愿意来听听？
text.completion: We have learned from each other. Thank you.

english.title: Taralune
english.objectives: Defeat Taralune in a pet battle.
english.description: I strive to teach through non-lethal pet battle.  Are you willing to learn?
english.completion: We have learned from each other. Thank you.

text.title: 冰冷的钢铁，第二季
text.objectives: 从恐轨车站找到一门钢铁自动火炮。
text.description: 嗨，说你哪。$B$B谢谢你上次帮了我。手中的铁炮是唯一能治愈我的东西。但现在……$B$B<基沙恩苦笑着望向远方。>……我的弹药用完了。$B$B看来我只好坐在这里等死了。
text.progress: Leave me alone.
text.completion: Ah, that's the stuff. I'm going to run out of ammo, but at least I've got something to live for, for a while.
text.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Cold Steel Part II
english.objectives: Find an Iron Autocannon in Grimrail Depot.
english.description: Hey, you.$B$BI wanted to thank you for what you did for me. The feel of that cannon in my hands is all the therapy I'll ever need. But now...$B$B<Keeshan stares off into the distance and grimaces.>...I'm all out of bullets.$B$BGuess I'll just sit here and wait to die.
english.progress: Leave me alone.
english.completion: Ah, that's the stuff. I'm going to run out of ammo, but at least I've got something to live for, for a while.
english.completed: Return to John J. Keeshan in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 德考汉的象牙
text.completion: What a find! Great work, $n!$b$bDekorhan's tusk will be the centerpiece of someone's collection!

english.title: Dekorhan's Tusk
english.completion: What a find! Great work, $n!$b$bDekorhan's tusk will be the centerpiece of someone's collection!

text.title: 伽罗格的颅骨
text.completion: I can't believe my eyes... you actually took down Gagrog the Brutal? You're tougher than I thought!$b$bGreat work, $n!

english.title: Gagrog's Skull
english.completion: I can't believe my eyes... you actually took down Gagrog the Brutal? You're tougher than I thought!$b$bGreat work, $n!

text.title: 手心里的小鸟
text.objectives: 在永茂林地找到一只孔雀小雏鸟。
text.description: $n！你有来看过你上次救出来的小孔雀吗？$b$b<米露恩捧起一只孔雀雏鸟，逗弄着它。她指了指你，说了一遍你的名字，然后对着那只小鸟模仿起了鸟鸣。两人完全把你晾在一边，进行了一次长时间的交流，让你感到十分窘迫。最后，树妖终于把她的注意力转移回了你的身上。>$b$b你听见了吗？还有更多的小孔雀被困在永茂林地里！要是你不去救它们的话……啊，你也听到了它刚才是怎么说的！
text.progress: <Mylune stamps her hooves impatiently.>
text.completion: Oh, thank you $n! You've made a lot of wee baby birds very happy.$B$B$B$B$B$BYou're my favorite $R!
text.completed: Return to Mylune in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Put a Bird on It
english.objectives: Find a Tiny Peachick Hatchling in The Everbloom.
english.description: $n! Have you met the peachick you saved the other day?$b$b<Mylune holds up a peachick hatchling, then trills and twitters at it. She gestures to you, says your name, then continues chirping animatedly to the little bird. The two ignore you and engage in a lengthy bird-conversation, long enough to make you feel awkward. Finally the dryad turns her attention back to you.>$b$bDid you hear that? More peachicks are still trapped in the Everbloom! If you don't save them... well, you heard what will happen!
english.progress: <Mylune stamps her hooves impatiently.>
english.completion: Oh, thank you $n! You've made a lot of wee baby birds very happy.$B$B$B$B$B$BYou're my favorite $R!
english.completed: Return to Mylune in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 不要给水果贩子任何机会！
text.objectives: 从血槌炉渣矿井拿一颗巨大的食人魔脑袋。
text.description: 单凭一个食人魔的脑袋阻止不了水果贩子。水果贩子是很聪明的，知道不应该把他们的水果都放到一个篮子里。$B$B再给我带一个食人魔的脑袋！哈！我倒要看看水果贩子现在还能有什么招儿。抱着他们卖不出去的烂香蕉痛哭吧！$B$B水果贩子的绝望，啊，想想就觉得美味啊！
text.progress: THE FRUIT VENDOR STANDS NO CHANCE!
text.completion: We are one step closer to crushing the fruit vendor's grapes into muddy wine.
text.completed: Return to Cro Threadstrong at the Inn in your Garrison.

english.title: A Fruitful Proposition
english.objectives: Collect a Giant Ogre Head from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
english.description: The head of just ONE ogre won't be enough to stop the fruit vendor. No, the fruit vendor is wise, they would not put all of their fruit into one basket.$B$BBring me the head of ANOTHER ogre! Ha! Then what will the fruit vendor do? Cry onto their bananas as they rot and fall to the ground.$B$BDESPAIR, FRUIT VENDOR. SO DELICIOUS!
english.progress: THE FRUIT VENDOR STANDS NO CHANCE!
english.completion: We are one step closer to crushing the fruit vendor's grapes into muddy wine.
english.completed: Return to Cro Threadstrong at the Inn in your Garrison.

text.title: 矮人和矿井
text.objectives: 从血槌炉渣矿井里找到奥拉夫的盾。
text.description: 巴尔洛戈和埃瑞克坚持说那座矿井的底下有宝藏。为什么？因为那是座矿井！而且谁不喜欢发光的石头？$B$B但我们上次去那冒险的时候被巨大的食人魔给赶出来了。当时巴尔洛戈用他的剑负责殿后，而埃瑞克冲在前面寻找出口。$B$B可你不知道，在慌乱中，我的盾又给弄丢了。$B$B<奥拉夫用哀求的眼神看着你。>
text.progress: <Olaf sobs.>
text.completion: By the light, that's her! You've done it again, an' I can't thank you enough! We'll try to be more careful next time.
text.completed: Return to Olaf at the Inn in your Garrison.

english.title: Like A Dwarf In A Mine
english.objectives: Collect Olaf's Shield from the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
english.description: Baelog and Eric swear there's got to be treasure at the bottom of the mine. Why? Because it's a mine! An' we sure do love rocks that sparkle.$B$BOn our last trip, we were beaten back by huge ogres. Baelog held up the rear, swingin' his sword, while Eric rushed on ahead to try and find a quick exit.$B$BWouldn't you know, in all that excitement, I done lost my shield AGAIN?$B$B<Olaf looks at you imploringly.>
english.progress: <Olaf sobs.>
english.completion: By the light, that's her! You've done it again, an' I can't thank you enough! We'll try to be more careful next time.
english.completed: Return to Olaf at the Inn in your Garrison.

text.title: 高昂的维护费
text.objectives: 从钢铁码头获得一桶可怕的酸性溶液。
text.description: 欢迎回来，指挥官。您真是个大忙人啊，就连来卡拉赞做客，进门时都没工夫脱掉靴子和外套，也没时间注意不要把血洒到地板上之类的事情。$B$B指挥官还记得前些阵子的酸性溶液吗？啊，它真是相当的有效，但要抹掉画像上、地摊上、天花板上的所有血迹，还是有点不够用啊。$B$B我看，那里一定是发生了近代史上最惨烈、最英勇的一次战斗吧。
text.progress: Was the commander successful?
text.completion: Again, though more barrels were likely available, one will staunchly make do with the single barrel provided, comforted in the knowledge that the commander must deal with the great pressing issues of this land, and does not have time to clean up the mud that that so dutifully follows the commander's heroic allies.
text.completed: Return to Moroes at the Inn in your Garrison.

english.title: Bloody Expensive
english.objectives: Collect a barrel of Horribly Acidic Solution from the Iron Docks.
english.description: Welcome back, commander. The commander is obviously in a great hurry, and certainly the thought of removing their coat or boots or not dripping all over the floor are much too far beyond consideration.$B$BThe commander remembers the acidic solution, yes? Quite effective it was, though one barrel was not enough to remove ALL of the blood stains from the portraits, or the tapestries, or the ceiling.$B$BSurely this must have been the most heroic and viscous battle in recent history.
english.progress: Was the commander successful?
english.completion: Again, though more barrels were likely available, one will staunchly make do with the single barrel provided, comforted in the knowledge that the commander must deal with the great pressing issues of this land, and does not have time to clean up the mud that that so dutifully follows the commander's heroic allies.
english.completed: Return to Moroes at the Inn in your Garrison.

text.title: 继续搜寻
text.objectives: 在钢铁码头找到铜罗盘。
text.description: 我们请一名老海员鉴定了你之前带给我们的那件东西，他认为那是件仿冒品。看来钢铁部落正试图复制这种装置却不得其法。$B$B当你彻底地了解过那玩意儿以后，会对这些原始人能拥有这样的工具感到奇怪。到头来感觉还是和海上传说差不多，哈！$B$B不过，只要你能帮我们找到那枚真正的罗盘，将会有一大笔财宝转入你的名下。
text.progress: Did you find the compass?
text.completion: Let's hope this is the real thing, every time I go through that portal I feel my fur stand on end.
text.completed: Return to Fleetmaster Seahorn in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: The Search Continues
english.objectives: Find the Brass Compass at the Iron Docks.
english.description: An old deckhand inspected that device you brought us, and thinks it was quite the forgery. This Iron Horde is trying to copy the mechanism, but they don't quite have the technology.$B$BWhen you get right down to it, we're not sure how these primitive beasts got a hold of this kind of tool. Wouldn't be half as good of a sea tale if we knew, ha!$B$BWe've still got a pile of treasure with your name on it, if you can find us the real compass.
english.progress: Did you find the compass?
english.completion: Let's hope this is the real thing, every time I go through that portal I feel my fur stand on end.
english.completed: Return to Fleetmaster Seahorn in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 斩魂者沃斯
text.objectives: 从奥金顿获取一把裂魂之刃。
text.description: 你！上次是你帮我找到了裂魂之刃，对不对？我现在又一次需要你的帮助。$B$B上次那把剑效果很好，我用它斩杀了许多受折磨的亡灵，他们的哀号声简直是最优美的乐章。$B$B只不过，裂魂之刃没办法修理，因为它每次释放一个灵魂都会消耗剑中的灵魂能量，黑暗的力量依然潜伏在这个世界，转化着死者的亡魂，因此我需要一把新的裂魂之刃。
text.progress: Did you find the blade?
text.completion: Yes, yes this is perfect. It is time, little souls, to return to the twisting darkness.$B$B<Lilian cackles madly.>
text.completed: Return to Lilian Voss in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Soulcarver Voss
english.objectives: Collect a Soulsever Blade from Auchindoun.
english.description: You! You're the one that found me the blade, correct? I have need of your services again.$B$BThe blade worked wonderfully, allowing me to sever the tormented undead from this world. Their screams were such beautiful music.$B$BHowever, the Soulsever Blade cannot be repaired, as it is partially woven with spirit energy that is drawn upon each time a soul is released. I need another, as there are still dark forces at work in this place, raising spirits and turning them.
english.progress: Did you find the blade?
english.completion: Yes, yes this is perfect. It is time, little souls, to return to the twisting darkness.$B$B<Lilian cackles madly.>
english.completed: Return to Lilian Voss in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 美德的容器
text.objectives: 从奥金顿获得一件织魂容器。
text.description: 又见面了，指挥官。死之瘟疫依然纠缠着我，但只要圣光指引着我，我便能毅然前行。$B$B你之前找到的那件织魂容器为我们的研究打开了新的路子，让我们能一窥死亡的世界以及生与死的交替。要是能有更多这种容器，我们或许就能发现生与死背后的秘密。或许是什么特殊的原因导致了亡灵天灾没有完全经历生与死的转换。$B$B银色黎明将感谢您的一切帮助。
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: Once again, though I will need to return to Light's Hope shortly, you have my most sincere thanks.
text.completed: Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at the Inn in your Garrison.

english.title: Vessel of Virtue
english.objectives: Collect a Soulweave Vessel from Auchindoun.
english.description: Hello, again, commander. This plague yet vexes me, but I shall remain resolute, with the light as my guide.$B$BThe Soulweave Vessel has aided our investigations into the world beyond and the transition from life to death. With more vessels, we may be able to discover the truth behind the bridge between worlds. Perhaps there is a reason why the scourged do not fully make this transition.$B$BAny additional help would be greatly appreciated by the Argent Dawn.
english.progress: Did you find anything?
english.completion: Once again, though I will need to return to Light's Hope shortly, you have my most sincere thanks.
english.completed: Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered at the Inn in your Garrison.

text.title: 来自内心的黑暗
text.objectives: 从通天峰获得一颗太阳水晶。
text.description: 它的光芒……消逝了。我不明白。$B$B我前来寻找答案，如今却只收获了更多的疑问。日子一天天过去，但我却一天比一天更感受到空虚和黑暗。$B$B拜托你，再帮我找一颗太阳水晶来。它的光芒是如此的温暖，如此地让人满足。
text.progress: Did you find the crystal?
text.completion: The warmth comforts me. I thank you.
text.completed: Return to Sunwalker Dezco in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: The Dark Within
english.objectives: Collect a Sun Crystal in Skyreach.
english.description: The light... has gone out. I know not why.$B$BI am more troubled now than before. I can find little comfort in the everyday. Each day seems darker than the last.$B$BPlease, bring me another one of the Sun Crystals. Its light is so warm, so comforting.
english.progress: Did you find the crystal?
english.completion: The warmth comforts me. I thank you.
english.completed: Return to Sunwalker Dezco in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 天空的祈愿
text.objectives: 从通天峰获取完整的羽毛。
