text.description: 到目前为止，我们与鸦人沟通的尝试并不顺利。每一次尝试都会对羽毛造成损害，如今那根羽毛早已变得破败不堪了。$B$B艾维娜恳求您，指挥官，再为她寻找一根羽毛。我们不忍心继续看着那些同胞沦为自己残暴天性的牺牲品。所有属于天空的生物都能在我们当中占据一席之地，无论是生是死。
text.progress: Did you bring a feather?
text.completion: We will continue to attempt to parlay with the arakkoa.$B$BAviana's blessing upon you.
text.completed: Return to Skylord Omnuron in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: A Plea to the Sky
english.objectives: Collect some Pristine Plumage in Skyreach.
english.description: We have, so far, been unsuccessful in our attempts to contact the arakkoa. Each attempt strips the plumage, and we are left with a feather that is tattered and broken.$B$BAviana implores you, commander, to find another plume for her. We do not wish to see our brethren become victim of their own violent nature. All beings of the sky have a place with us, in life or beyond.
english.progress: Did you bring a feather?
english.completion: We will continue to attempt to parlay with the arakkoa.$B$BAviana's blessing upon you.
english.completed: Return to Skylord Omnuron in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 有其父必有其子
text.objectives: 在黑石塔找到芬克的改良剥皮刀。
text.description: 他又干了一次！他拿了我的剥皮刀还喊着什么“多彩龙鳞”就跑去了黑石塔！就算剥到了他又能拿来做啥？难道做披风？$B$B我这有个不情之请，下次你去黑石塔上层的时候，能不能帮我找找那把剥皮刀？对了，你啥时候去？希望尽快，好不好，最好是马上，立刻。
text.progress: Where's my knife?
text.completion: You've saved it! A little nicked, but that can be fixed. Thanks!
text.completed: Return to Finkle Einhorn in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Like Father, Like Son
english.objectives: Find Finkle's Improved Skinner in Blackrock Spire.
english.description: He's done it again! My son took my knife and yelled something about a 'chromatic hide,' then ran off for the Spire! What would he even do with something like that, wear it around like a cape?$B$BIf it's not too much to ask, would you keep an eye out for the knife? You know, next time you're around Upper Blackrock Spire. Which, hopefully, is soon. VERY soon.
english.progress: Where's my knife?
english.completion: You've saved it! A little nicked, but that can be fixed. Thanks!
english.completed: Return to Finkle Einhorn in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 英雄永远没有休息日
text.objectives: 获得一只脱落的始祖龙爪。
text.description: 喔吼，侍从$n！自从我们上次分别，我又英勇而无私地闯荡了一次黑石塔，打算为乡亲们终结那里巨龙的统治。$B$B不过当我接近那里的时候，多罗莉亚美丽的脸庞浮现在了我的脑海中。$B$B为了她，我只好忍痛放下了手中的宝剑。$B$B所以，我委派你，我的侍从，代替我去搜索黑石塔的上层。我必须查明是否还有残余的巨龙潜伏在那地方的角落里。
text.progress: Did you find evidence of dragons?
text.completion: By the light, they breed like great fiery rabbits! I shall head there presently, to slay no less than THIRTY of the great beasts.$B$BFor Doloria!
text.completed: Return to Maximillian of Northshire in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: A Hero's Quest is Never Complete
english.objectives: Collect a Shed Proto-Dragon Claw.
english.description: What ho, squire $n! Since last we spoke, I have heroically approached the gates of Blackrock Spire and nobly intended to end the toothy reign of its dragons.$B$BYet, as I neared the place, my mind drifted to thoughts of my Doloria's fair face, and to my own painfully unsatisfied desires.$b$bMy sword arm fell limp at my side.$B$BI charge THEE then, squire, to go in my stead and search Upper Blackrock Spire. I must know if the dragons still squirm within its corridors.
english.progress: Did you find evidence of dragons?
english.completion: By the light, they breed like great fiery rabbits! I shall head there presently, to slay no less than THIRTY of the great beasts.$B$BFor Doloria!
english.completed: Return to Maximillian of Northshire in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 缚魂的奥秘
text.objectives: 从影月墓地获取暗色羊皮纸。
text.description: 我们看过你之前带来的耐奥祖的笔记了。尽管我们对这些术士是如何学会缚魂和操纵亡灵的过程有了一定的了解，但我们仍缺了一些线索。$B$B我们需要更多书页才能了解全貌。要是贸然通过不完全的信息来进行试验，很可能会造出一个憎恶来。而现在诺森德最不缺的就是憎恶。
text.progress: Did you find any of Ner'zhul's notes?
text.completion: We are greatful for your aid. I shall retire shortly.
text.completed: Return to Darion Mograine at the Inn in your Garrison.

english.title: Secrets of Soulbinding
english.objectives: Collect a Dark Parchment from the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
english.description: We have reviewed Ner'zhul's notes, which you brought to us previously. Though we are closer to understanding how these warlocks have learned to bind souls and control the undead, the picture is incomplete.$B$BWe will need more pages if we are to see the whole picture. I do not want to experiment with partial information and create an abomination. There are enough of those in Northrend as it is.
english.progress: Did you find any of Ner'zhul's notes?
english.completion: We are greatful for your aid. I shall retire shortly.
english.completed: Return to Darion Mograine at the Inn in your Garrison.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 陨落者的命运
text.objectives: 从影月墓地获取包银箭支。
text.description: 我觉得你或许是个值得信任的人。至少你没有把我的秘密告诉过任何人，对此我非常感谢。$B$B如今我又一次需要你的帮助，作为回报，我愿意和你分享一些情报。我是来这里找一位叫作奥蕾莉亚的精灵的。她已经在德拉诺失踪多年了。我抱着一线希望来这里寻找她，因为我觉得她可能卷入了扭曲虚空中并被丢到了这里。$B$B哈，这事儿是不大可能啦，但希望你在旅途中能多注意一些与高等精灵有关的线索。
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: Another one? How curious.$B$BI may not be much closer to finding her, but these arrows bring some comfort to me, at least.
text.completed: Return to the Coweled Ranger in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Fate of the Fallen
english.objectives: Collect a Silver-Lined Arrow from the Shadowmoon Burial Ground.
english.description: I feel that I can trust you, perhaps. You have, at least, not spoken of my secret to anyone, and for that I thank you.$B$BI have need of your aid again, and in return, I will share some of my own information. I am here, you see, to find an elf by the name of Alleria. She was lost years ago, on Draenor. It is my faint hope that the twisting nether brought her here.$B$BI do not know if such a thing is even possible, but do keep an eye out for any signs of high elves as you travel.
english.progress: Did you find anything?
english.completion: Another one? How curious.$B$BI may not be much closer to finding her, but these arrows bring some comfort to me, at least.
english.completed: Return to the Coweled Ranger in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 读叶者
text.objectives: 从永茂林地获得一片发光的怪蕨叶。
text.description: 又见面啦，伙计！$B$B塞纳里奥议会又派赞吉吉来寻找更多的植物。我们对这附近的植物都不大满意。$B$B你要是能再帮我找来几片树叶就好了。那些植物能看穿赞吉吉的树形伪装，就算赞吉吉扎根在原地也没用。$B$B而且那样想逃跑也不太容易！
text.progress: Did ya have much luck, mon?
text.completion: Thanks, mon. I'm gonna bring this back to the Circle, just as soon as I can figure out how ta fly in da savage winds of dis place.
text.completed: Return to Zen'kiki at the Inn in your Garrison.

english.title: The Leaf-Reader
english.objectives: Collect a Strangely-Glowing Frond from Everbloom.
english.description: Good ta see you again, mon!$B$BDe Cenarion Circle sent Zen'kiki out here ta find some more of dem plants. We not likin' what we be seein' here.$B$BIf ya find any more of dem leaves, bring one on back. Dey can see right through Zen'kiki's tree disguise, even when he plant himself in da ground!$B$BAnd dat make it harder to run!
english.progress: Did ya have much luck, mon?
english.completion: Thanks, mon. I'm gonna bring this back to the Circle, just as soon as I can figure out how ta fly in da savage winds of dis place.
english.completed: Return to Zen'kiki at the Inn in your Garrison.

text.title: 以史为鉴
text.objectives: 从永茂林地获得一份茂林神器。
text.description: 我回来啦！这个充满了历史之谜的世界简直让我流连忘返！$B$B<周卓捂住自己硕大的肚皮笑了笑。>$B$B啊，我可能是吃太多了。锦绣谷如今已经得到了净化，喜宴一家家连着摆，在潘达利亚，我们每天都像过节一样猛吃！$B$B你要是在这个世界的土著物种身上找到更多与泰坦有关的证据，就带来交给我。我会一边享用美味的烧烤裂蹄牛一边等的。
text.progress: Have you found any signs of the titans here?
text.completion: Another excellent find from our most illustrious hero! I will immediately begin transcribing your heroic deeds!
text.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Lessons of the Past
english.objectives: Collect an Overgrown Artifact from The Everbloom.
english.description: I have returned! You must have known that a world so rich in history could not keep me away for long!$B$B<Lorewalker Cho chuckles, holding his enormous belly.>$B$BI have perhaps been taking part in too many celebratory feasts, now that the Vale has been cleansed. There is so much to celebrate in Pandaria!$B$BShould you find any future evidence of titanic influence on the native species, I will be here, heartily enjoying the roast clefthoof.
english.progress: Have you found any signs of the titans here?
english.completion: Another excellent find from our most illustrious hero! I will immediately begin transcribing your heroic deeds!
english.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 学习是一个痛苦的过程
text.objectives: 从恐轨车站获得一大箱武器。
text.description: 我的学院又开起来了。当然，位置保密。也许它根本就不存在？哈哈。$B$B顺便，我的锐器教学用具又快要用光了。$B$B<洛妮卡朝你使几次眼色，最终拔出匕首抵住你的肋骨。>
text.progress: Did you find me some weapons?
text.completion: Once again, you have proven yourself invaluable. Perhaps you would like a teaching job?
text.completed: Return to Lonika Stillblade in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Learning Is Painful
english.objectives: Collect a Huge Crate of Weapons in Grimrail Depot.
english.description: The academy is up and running, in a secret location of course. Maybe it doesn't exist at all?$B$BBy the by, I appear to be running quite dry on sharp, pointy instruments of education.$B$B<Lonika winks at you several times before nudging you sharply in the ribs with her dagger.>
english.progress: Did you find me some weapons?
english.completion: Once again, you have proven yourself invaluable. Perhaps you would like a teaching job?
english.completed: Return to Lonika Stillblade in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 斧头是消耗品
text.objectives: 在恐轨车站找到一把钢铁断肢刃。
text.description: 我加摩尔，已经收割了许许多多的兽人。但仍然还有很多钢铁部落成员，身上有四肢，体内有鲜血。我要帮他们摆脱这些束缚。$B$B可惜的是，我没有斧头可以用了。上一把在我劈砍兽人胸腔的时候断成了两半。$B$B<加摩尔大笑起来。>$B$B再给我找一把来。我要在这片大陆上砍出一条血路来！
text.progress: What?
text.completion: A mighty blade, but I will wear it out quickly. Orc heads are harder than they look.
text.completed: Return to Gamon in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: An Axe to Grind
english.objectives: Find an Iron Limbcleaver in Grimrail Depot.
english.description: I, Gamon, have cleaved many orc skulls. Yet many of the iron horde remain, full of limbs and blood. I will relieve them of these things!$B$BOr I would, if I had an axe. The last one broke in half in the middle of an orc's ribcage.$B$B<Gamon laughs heartily.>$B$BBring me another, so that I may continue cleaving my way through this land!
english.progress: What?
english.completion: A mighty blade, but I will wear it out quickly. Orc heads are harder than they look.
english.completed: Return to Gamon in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 捕捉火焰蜂
text.objectives: 从黑石塔上层获得峰林火焰蜂。
text.description: 老温奇还是没回来！我真是越来越担心了。$B$B帮我个忙，去黑石塔上层再抓一只火焰蜂来。只要我们抓到足够的火焰蜂，温奇肯定会循着它们的光芒找回来的。$B$B这样我们就不会让他乱跑啦！
text.progress: Did ye get another fly?
text.completion: Oi, that's a bright fly! Thank ye, we'll just keep on tryin' until that two-timing ol' Winky comes on home.
text.completed: Return to Oralius in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Flamefly Trap
english.objectives: Collect a Spire Flamefly in Upper Blackrock Spire.
english.description: Ol' Winky still hasn't come back! Now I'm gettin' worried.$B$BDo me a favor and get another one of those flameflies from Upper Blackrock Spire. If we get enough of em,' Winky's sure to see the glimmer and come heading on back.$B$BAn then we'll have him right where we want him!
english.progress: Did ye get another fly?
english.completion: Oi, that's a bright fly! Thank ye, we'll just keep on tryin' until that two-timing ol' Winky comes on home.
english.completed: Return to Oralius in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 黑暗中的低语
text.objectives: 在影月墓地里找到一把虚空之门钥匙。
text.description: 假如你不介意的话，我目前正努力地再次拯救世界。以免它塌陷入虚空之中。$B$B噢对了，你上次帮过我吧？好的，你来的正是时候，我现在还需要一把虚空之门钥匙。$B$B明白了吗？快去！深渊中的无尽恐怖可不会等着你！长触手的家伙耐心都不好。
text.progress: You do know that any time you waste talking to me brings us closer to doom, right?
text.completion: Perfect, here's a prize for your efforts.$B$BI've got to head out and save everyone now. Again.
text.completed: Return to Impsy in the Inn at your Garrison.

english.title: Whispers in the Darkness
english.objectives: Find a Void-Gate Key in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
english.description: If you don't mind, I'm trying VERY hard to prevent all of our worlds from collapsing into the void, AGAIN.$B$BOh, right, you helped me last time, didn't you? Well, you've got great timing. I'm in need of another Gate-Key.$B$BWell? Go on! The infinite horrors of the abyss aren't just going to wait until you've had a nap! Having that many tentacles makes them really antsy.
english.progress: You do know that any time you waste talking to me brings us closer to doom, right?
english.completion: Perfect, here's a prize for your efforts.$B$BI've got to head out and save everyone now. Again.
english.completed: Return to Impsy in the Inn at your Garrison.

text.title: 海底来客
text.objectives: 获得深海指挥官扎林的徽记，并消灭他的$2oa个纳迦部下。
text.description: 你在寻找法罗迪斯王子？$b$b<幽灵般的精灵警惕地眯起了眼睛。>$b$b我可以带你去找法罗迪斯……不过事有轻重缓急。这些纳迦发起了突袭。他们听命于一个名叫扎林的纳迦，他就在西边的矮丘附近。$b$b帮我取得扎林的徽记，我再考虑你的请求。
text.progress: <The nightwatcher looks at you expectantly.>
text.completion: <Idri stares at the ugly head.>$b$bYes, that's him.
text.giverWindow: 消灭他和他手下的纳迦！

english.title: They Came From the Sea
english.objectives: Obtain the Head of Fathom-Commander Zarrin, and slay $2oa of his naga troops.
english.description: You're looking for Prince Farondis?$b$b<The ghostly elf narrows her eyes warily.>$b$bI can take you to Farondis... but first things first. These naga attacked suddenly. They take orders from one called Zarrin, in the low hills to the west.$b$bHelp me take Zarrin's head, and you'll have my ear.
english.progress: <The night guard looks at you expectantly.>
english.completion: <Idri stares at the ugly head.>$b$bYes, that's him.
english.giverWindow: Slay him and the naga he commands!

text.title: 族人遗骨
text.objectives: 获得$1oa块失窃的暗夜精灵遗骨。
text.description: 你要找高戈奈斯潮汐之石？$b$b是的，我知道它在哪儿。那是一个令我不堪回首的地方。$b$b你或许能帮上我的忙。在这次纳迦突袭中，那些恐怖的鱼人侵入了我的土地，并在墓地大肆劫掠。他们偷走了我们祖先的遗骨，那都是我族人的尸骨！$b$b请帮我带回遗骨，以慰藉我的人民。我会告诉你更多关于潮汐之石的事情。
text.progress: My people may not care much for me, but that will not stop me from caring for them.
text.completion: Our bones are all we have left of an existence we left behind a long time ago.$b$b<The prince stares intently into your eyes.>$b$bStay with me, $c. I will help you find your Tidestone.

english.title: Our Very Bones
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Pilfered Night Elf Bones.
english.description: You seek the Tidestone of Golganneth?$b$bYes, I know where it lies. It is in a place to which I prefer not to return.$b$bYou may be of use to me. In the midst of this naga attack, those horrid fish-men flopped their way onto my lands and raided our graveyards. They steal the bones of our ancestors, and indeed, the very bones of my people.$b$bHelp me bring some solace to my people. Then I shall tell you more about the Tidestone.
english.progress: Моим людям до меня особого дела нет, но я все равно буду охранять их покой – это мой долг.
english.completion: Our bones are all we have left of an existence we left behind a long time ago.$b$b<The prince stares intently into your eyes.>$b$bStay with me, $c. I will help you find your Tidestone.

text.objectives: Complete the Auchindoun Challenge Mode.
text.description: $n, I need you to assemble a fearless group and lead them into the depths of Auchindoun. Activate the Challenger's Orb, and cleanse Auchindoun of Teon'gor's evil presence.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge and I shall reward you handsomely.
text.completion: $n, you've done a great service. May the souls of Auchindoun remain at peace with the threat of Teron'gor eliminated.

text.title: 大价钱
text.objectives: 收集肮脏的铁币并把它们交给格里伏塔。
text.description: 我懂，我懂。我把这些东西给你换财宝，但现在我又想把它们拿回来。是有点复杂，伙计。你到底想不想要金币呢？
text.progress: So you've got them?
text.completion: Oh, ya got dem for me? Excellent. Here's ya money.
text.completed: Whistle up Griftah and turn in your Dingy Iron Coins.

english.title: Da Big Score
english.objectives: Obtain Dingy Iron Coins for Griftah.
english.description: I know, I know. I be givin' ya these for ya treasures, but now I be wantin' dem back. It be complicated, mon. Do ya want da gold or not?
english.progress: Ну, все $gнашел:нашла;?
english.completion: О, ты все для меня $gдостал:достала;! Зашибись. Держи деньжата.
english.completed: Whistle up Griftah and turn in your Dingy Iron Coins.

text.title: 假如你确定的话
text.objectives: 把多余的肮脏的铁币交给格里伏塔。
text.description: 你一定收集了大量的财宝。而且下周它们会变得更值钱，但我可以把它们从你手上拿走。
text.progress: Here you go.
text.completion: Here ya go! Instant gratification's da best gratification!
text.completed: Whistle up Griftah and turn in your Dingy Iron Coins (but Griftah's taking a bigger cut).

english.title: If You're Sure
english.objectives: Give surplus Dingy Iron Coins to Griftah.
english.description: You sure be collectin' a lot of treasures. Dey will be worth more next week, but I can take 'em off your hands.
english.progress: Here you go.
english.completion: Here ya go! Instant gratification's da best gratification!
english.completed: Whistle up Griftah and turn in your Dingy Iron Coins (but Griftah's taking a bigger cut).

text.title: 战斗不息
text.objectives: 在悬槌角斗场中干掉100名角斗士。$B$B你可以通过与悬槌堡的卡格对话或在你的角斗士圣殿中与骨渣对话来进入角斗场。
text.description: 不要就此止步，角斗士！继续战斗下去，让所有人都见识到你带来的毁灭和死亡！$B$B马尔高克元首会很高兴看到你再次出现在角斗场中！$B$B老规矩，干掉100个，否则一概不接受！$B$B不胜即亡，角斗士！
text.completion: To the victor go the spoils! All hail $n!
text.completed: Return to Kharg outside the Highmaul Coliseum in Nagrand.

english.title: The Bloodshed Never Ends
english.objectives: Kill 100 Gladiators at the Coliseum in Highmaul.$B$BYou may access the Coliseum by talking to Kharg at Highmaul or Boneslag at your Gladiator's Sanctum.
english.description: You are insatiable, gladiator! Let none doubt your voracious appetite for destruction and death!$B$BImperator Mar'gok will be very pleased to see you battling upon the arena floor of the Coliseum once more!$B$BAs before, I will accept nothing less than 100 lives!$B$BKill or be killed, gladiator!
english.completion: To the victor go the spoils! All hail $n!
english.completed: Return to Kharg outside the Highmaul Coliseum in Nagrand.

text.title: 清理门户
text.objectives: 处置南港的雅各布·安德斯。
text.description: 一个名叫雅各布·安德斯的新兵不久前刚来这里。他一直在这酗酒闹事，简直是个麻烦精。但这次他越界了。$B$B我的一个巡逻兵目击到他在和部落暗中交易情报——他是个叛徒，指挥官！我想你可能会想要亲自处理他。$B$B我之前看到他跑到海边喝酒去了，我敢用我老爸的胡子发誓，他一定还在那呢。
text.completion: I think ye did the right thing, commander.
text.completed: Return to Kolrigg Stoktron in Southport.

english.title: Cleaning House
english.objectives: Deal with Jacob Anders at Southport.
english.description: Not long ago, a new recruit showed up by the name o' Jacob Anders. He's been trouble since he got here, always drinkin' and pickin' fights, but he crossed the line this time.$B$BOne o' our patrols spotted him tradin' intel with the Horde - he's a traitor, commander! I thought ye would want tae deal with him personally.$B$BHe was out drinkin' by the water last time I saw him, and I'd bet me pappy's beard he's still there.
english.completion: I think ye did the right thing, commander.
english.completed: Return to Kolrigg Stoktron in Southport.

text.title: 阿什兰的资源
text.objectives: 在阿什兰的暴风之盾与金凯德·加科布谈一谈。
text.description: 伯德里克跟我提起说你在外头探险时弄到了几本有趣的建筑笔记。是建造指南还是什么组装笔记之类的来着？$b$b你应该去和暴风之盾的金凯德·加科布聊一聊。她会愿意用完整的图纸来和你交换这些东西。
text.completion: Oh you have some blueprint texts for me? That's great!$b$bLet's do some business!

english.title: Resources in Ashran
english.objectives: Speak with Kinkade Jacobs at Stormshield in Ashran.
english.description: Bodrick has mentioned to me that you have acquired some interesting construction notes in your forays out there. A construction guide or assembly notes perhaps?$b$bYou should speak with Kinkade Jacobs in Stormshield. She is willing to exchange finished blueprints for such things.
english.completion: Oh you have some blueprint texts for me? That's great!$b$bLet's do some business!

text.title: 影月入侵！
text.objectives: 击退影月氏族对你要塞的入侵。$B$B（再次与克劳勒中士交谈来开始行动）
text.description: 你回来的正是时候，指挥官。$B$B侦察兵发现一群影月兽人突袭者接近了要塞。$B$B你在特鲁纳观星台阻截了他们的攻击，还在沙兹古尔引发了混乱。$B$B现在，他们要来找你报仇了。他们肯定会倾尽全力来攻击我们。$B$B整个要塞都进入了高度警惕状态，你准备好面对他们了吗？
text.completion: I don't think they were ready for that. The Shadowmoon will think twice before attacking us again.
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Crowler in your garrison.

english.title: Shadowmoon Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the Shadowmoon clan invasion of your garrison.$B$B(Speak with Sergeant Crowler again to begin)
english.description: Your arrival couldn't be more timely, commander.$B$BShadowmoon raiders have been spotted closing in on the garrison.$B$BYou repelled their advances at Teluuna Observatory, and created chaos at Shaz'gul.$B$BNow, they surely seek retribution. They will throw everything they have at us.$B$BI have the entire garrison on high alert. Are you ready to face them?
english.completion: I don't think they were ready for that. The Shadowmoon will think twice before attacking us again.
english.completed: Speak with Sergeant Crowler in your garrison.

text.title: 阿什兰的资源
text.objectives: 在阿什兰的战争之矛与托格·菲力克辛顿谈一谈。
text.description: 你弄到了几本建造指南和组装笔记？这可真是个好消息！$b$b在阿什兰，我认识一个叫托格·菲力克辛顿的家伙。他手头有我们需要的完整图纸！$b$b你要不要去和他谈谈，带点好图纸来让我们开造？
text.completion: Oh YEAH buddy! We can work something out. I got plenty of stuff for you to buy!

english.title: Upgrades in Ashran
english.objectives: Speak with Torgg Flexington at Warspear in Ashran.
english.description: You got some construction guides or assembly notes on ya? Oh man that's good news!$b$bI know this guy in Ashran, goes by Torgg Flexington. He's got finished blueprints we need!$b$bGo talk to this guy and bring back some good stuff for us to build, ok?
english.completion: Oh YEAH buddy! We can work something out. I got plenty of stuff for you to buy!

text.title: 雷神氏族入侵！
text.objectives: 击退雷神氏族的入侵。
text.description: 你回来的正是时候。$b$b你的侦察兵发现有一支雷神氏族的大军接近了要塞。$b$b我的氏族会先出动去切断他们的援军，但你必须在这里守住你的要塞。$b$b格里姆加中士在等待你下达命令。
text.completion: Well fought, commander. Now to strike back before the Thunderlord can recover.
text.completed: Speak with Durotan in your garrison.

english.title: Thunderlord Invasion!
english.objectives: Repel the Thunderlord invasion.
english.description: Your timing could not have been better.$b$bYour scouts have reported the approach of a large Thunderlord army.$b$bMy clan can ride out and assist in severing their reinforcements, but you will need to see to the defense of your fort against the bulk of their forces.$b$BSergeant Grimjaw awaits your command.
english.completion: Well fought, commander. Now to strike back before the Thunderlord can recover.
english.completed: Speak with Durotan in your garrison.

objectiveDetails.description: 与格里姆加中士谈一谈

text.title: 军队中容不下叛徒
text.objectives: 和坠斧营地的洛卡对质。
text.description: 你的人目击到一个新兵在背着你和联盟的人交谈。她是个叛徒，头儿！她威胁到了你建立起来的一切。$B$B我们准备了一头双足飞龙，好带她回你的要塞接受处分。你可能会想和这个叛徒当面对质。$B$B我之前看到她在坠斧营地后面的小路上。
text.completion: You be makin' the right call, commander. There be no room for her kind in your ranks.
text.completed: Return to Lunzul in Axefall.

english.title: Not In Your Army
english.objectives: Deal with Rorka at Axefall.
english.description: Your men caught one of da new recruits,  talking with da alliance behind your back. She be a traitor, boss-mon! She be a danger to everything you've worked so hard for.$B$BWe have a wyvern ready to be takin' her to your garrison for proper punishment. I thought you would be wantin' to deal with da scoundrel personally.$B$BI last be seein' her on the back road out of Axefall.
english.completion: Правильно $gсделал:сделала;, командир. Таким, как она, у нас не место.
english.completed: Return to Lunzul in Axefall.

text.title: 清除迷雾
text.objectives: 消灭8只天蓝龙虾人，并获得过度生长的心脏。
text.description: <这名巨魔的皮肤看起来十分苍白。斗大的汗珠顺着他的眉毛往下流。>$B$B我知道你不欠我什么，但你若愿意帮忙的话，我有一件事想求你。$b$b有一只怪物正在北边制造这种毒雾。$B$B只有那野兽的心脏才能中和我体内的剧毒。$B$B你也许还要干掉几只龙虾人才能靠近那里。$B$B假如你因为中毒而变得虚弱，记得食用那些发光的蘑菇以解除毒性。
text.progress: I ain't feelin' so good.
text.completion: Yes! Dat be da heart! You did it...
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Mok'e at Cerulean Lagoon.

english.title: Clearing the Mist
english.objectives: Kill 8 Cerulean Crawlers and collect the Overgrown Heart.
english.description: <The troll's skin looks pale. Beads of sweat dot his brow.>$B$BI know you owe me nouting, but if you be willin' ta help me, I have a favor to ask.$B$BTa da north, dere be da creature dat is da cause a' dis poisonous mist.$B$BOnly da heart a' dis beast has da power ta neutralize da toxins in my body.$B$BYa may have ta kill some a dose crawlers while you're at it.$B$BIf ya feel weak from da poison, eat some a dose glowing mushrooms ta counter da effects.
english.progress: I ain't feelin' so good.
english.completion: Yes! Heart! You $gbrought him:brought; ...
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Mok'e at Cerulean Lagoon.

text.title: 先除掉毒蜂再说
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa只寡妇毒蜂。
text.description: 那些该死的毒蜂一天到晚来蛰我，弄得我精疲力竭。$b$b除非你把它们都解决掉，否则你送什么来也没用。
text.completion: Perhaps my rituals will be undisturbed for a few nights at least. Your offer is intriguing and I think we can come to an agreement.
text.completed: Return to Dusk-Seer Irizzar in the Spires of Arak.

english.title: A Lack of Wasps
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Widow Wasps.
english.description: The stings! These cursed wasps drone day and night and their constant aggression taxes me so.$b$bI shall do nothing about your offer until these nuisances are dealt with.
english.completion: Perhaps my rituals will be undisturbed for a few nights at least. Your offer is intriguing and I think we can come to an agreement.
english.completed: Return to Dusk-Seer Irizzar in the Spires of Arak.

text.title: 亡者不会遗忘……
text.objectives: 把10个古代啸爪颅骨放进白骨先知的大锅里。
text.description: 很多年前，我和我的家人就是在这里倒下的。$b$b你在周围看见的那些虎人，就是当年屠杀我村庄那些刽子手的后代。我在这个被遗忘之地苦苦等待了好久，希望终有一天能看到那些虎人得到应有的下场。$b$b啸爪族长是位白骨先知，利用亡者的遗骸占卜未来。$b$b从啸爪先祖身上获得古代颅骨，并把它们放进白骨先知的大锅里。$b$b这次，就让它们用自己的骨头来填满他们的大锅吧！
text.progress: <The cauldron bubbles and boils.>
text.completion: <The boiling cauldron gasps and spurts boiling liquid with each skull that is plunged into the pot.>$b$b<As the last of the skulls is submerged within the bubbling cauldron, you feel the sharp nip of a ghostly breeze upon your skin.>

english.title: The Dead Do Not Forget...
english.objectives: Place 10 Ancient Snarlpaw Skulls in the Boneseer's Cauldron.
english.description: Many years ago my family and I were slain in this very spot.$b$bThe saberon you see around you are descended from the tribe that murdered my village. Long have I waited, here in this forgotten place, to see justice brought to the saberon for their crimes.$b$bThe Snarlpaw chief is a boneseer, a saberon who divines the future using the remains of the dead.$b$bCollect the ancient skulls of the Snarlpaw ancestors and place them in the boneseer's cauldron.$b$bLet their own bones fill their cauldron for once!
english.progress: <The cauldron bubbles and boils.>
english.completion: <The boiling cauldron gasps and spurts boiling liquid with each skull that is plunged into the pot.>$b$b<As the last of the skulls is submerged within the bubbling cauldron, you feel the sharp nip of a ghostly breeze upon your skin.>

text.description: 有人跟我们定做了一对结婚戒指。顾客特别指定要你亲自制作。
text.progress: Do you plan to fill the order? We can afford to refuse the work, of course, but it's a good offer.

english.progress: Do you plan to fill the order? We can afford to refuse the work, of course, but it's a good offer.
english.completion: These are beautiful. The bride and groom will be well pleased.

text.objectives: 制作一条钢铁耳语项链。次要属性不重要。
text.description:
有人跟我们定做了一条精致的项链。顾客想把它送给一位宿敌来化解仇恨。她并没有指定款式，但我听她自己嘀咕着要弄成颈圈的式样。

噢，她还要求链条部分要“额外加固”。

text.title: 无尽的渴求
text.objectives: 对一条法力浮龙使用种族特长技能“奥术洪流”，然后向奥术师赫里恩复命。
text.description: 如果说你在逐日岛学到的最重要一课是什么，那无疑就是如何控制你对魔法的渴求了。血精灵对魔法的渴求是一种无止境的渴求，$n，你所吸收的能量必须完全处于你的掌控之中，并且通过奥术洪流将能量释放出去。如果你失败了的话，就将变成一个失心者……变成一个在绝望与疯狂中苟活的瘾君子。$B$B去岛上寻找一条法力浮龙，对它使用奥术洪流技能吧。学会掌握欲望所生成的力量。当你学会如何释放这种力量之后，回来找我。
text.completion: You've done well today, $n.  Your willingness to learn shows that you may very well rise above the unyielding cravings you must endure as a blood elf.$B$BRest not on your laurels, young one, but instead seek to master what you have learned.  Only through diligence will we as a race survive.$B$BTake this - it may be of some use to you.  Go now, and bring glory once more to our people.
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Helion at Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.

english.title: Thirst Unending
english.objectives: Use your Arcane Torrent racial ability on a Mana Wyrm, then return to Arcanist Helion.
english.description: If there is only one lesson you deign to remember from your time on Sunstrider Isle, let it be this - control your thirst for magic.  It is a thirst unending, $n - what you absorb must be controlled and released via Arcane Torrent.  Failure is to become one of the Wretched... hopelessly addicted and insane.$B$BSeek out a mana wyrm and unleash your Arcane Torrent upon it.  Learn to master your power. When you have sufficiently released an Arcane Torrent, return to me.
english.completion: You've done well today, $n.  Your willingness to learn shows that you may very well rise above the unyielding cravings you must endure as a blood elf.$B$BRest not on your laurels, young one, but instead seek to master what you have learned.  Only through diligence will we as a race survive.$B$BTake this - it may be of some use to you.  Go now, and bring glory once more to our people.
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Helion at Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.

text.title: 奥术薄片
text.objectives: 从逐日岛上的任意使用魔法的生物身上收集6块奥术薄片，把它们交给奥术师伊塔纳斯。
text.description: 我们失去了对岛屿上许多生物的控制，这真是太糟糕了。这里曾是一片无比宁静和谐的地方，最适合学习与研究了。可是现在，我们整天都把时间浪费在防备那些原本是被我们圈养的生物上！$B$B我现在将给你一个难得的机会，你只需要帮我做一些收集工作，我就可以帮你施展一个小魔法做为报酬。你可以在逐日岛上所有使用魔法的生物身上找到一种名叫奥术薄片的东西，给我带一打那玩意回来，完成之后，我会在你身上施放一个小法术，这样你就能更好地在岛上冒险了。
text.progress: Many of the creatures here on the isle were at one point bound into non-aggression and complacency by our magical skills.  When the Scourge destroyed the Sunwell, our hold over these creatures shattered.  Arcane slivers are the remnants of the control we once had, and as such might be usable in fashioning a new device to aid us in regaining their control.$B$BBetter still, perhaps the slivers could be used to see what malaise the isle truly suffers under...
text.completion: Splendid - these will do nicely.  I've been doing quite a bit of thinking on the current malaise Sunstrider Isle suffers under.  One possible course of action I had pondered was to collect these arcane slivers from the beasts on the isle.  In doing so, they could be experimented on; this would provide a potential source of culpability.$B$BAnyway, I will tend to the research.  Allow me to place this incantation on you.  I believe you'll make good use of it!
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Ithanas at Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.

english.title: A Fistful of Slivers
english.objectives: Collect 6 Arcane Slivers from any creature on the isle that uses mana, and then return to Arcanist Ithanas on Sunstrider Isle.
english.description: It's a shame that we've lost control of many of the creatures here on the island.  This was once a tranquil place of study and research.  Now it's all we can do to keep from being attacked by our own creations!$B$BI'm going to offer you a chance to receive a magical boon in exchange for some collecting work on your part.  Bring me a stack of arcane slivers that are found on the mana-using creatures of Sunstrider Isle, and I will cast a spell on you that should aid your adventures on the isle.
english.progress: Many of the creatures here on the isle were at one point bound into non-aggression and complacency by our magical skills.  When the Scourge destroyed the Sunwell, our hold over these creatures shattered.  Arcane slivers are the remnants of the control we once had, and as such might be usable in fashioning a new device to aid us in regaining their control.$B$BBetter still, perhaps the slivers could be used to see what malaise the isle truly suffers under...

In doing so, they could be experimented on; this would provide a potential source of culpability.$B$BAnyway, I will tend to the research.  Allow me to place this incantation on you.  I believe you'll make good use of it!
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Ithanas at Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.

text.title: Solanian's Belongings
text.objectives: Collect Well Watcher Solanian's Scrying Orb, his Scroll of Scourge Magic, and his Journal.  They are found on Sunstrider Isle by the pond, the fountain, and one of the Burning Crystals.  Return them to the Well Watcher at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle when you've collected them all.
text.description: With all the chaos happening here at the Sunspire, I haven't had a chance to collect my belongings I've left outside at various places on the isle.  I must maintain my vigil over the Sunwell here, so I'll ask you to collect them in my stead.$B$BI need my scrying orb, my scroll of Scourge magic, and my journal.  Use this satchel for some extra space, as my things are rather bulky.  Return them to me and I'll give you a little something - you know, for the effort; you can keep the satchel as well!
text.completed: Return to Well Watcher Solanian at the Sunspire in Sunstrider Isle.

english.objectives: Collect Well Watcher Solanian's Scrying Orb, his Scroll of Scourge Magic, and his Journal.  They are found on Sunstrider Isle by the pond, the fountain, and one of the Burning Crystals.  Return them to the Well Watcher at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle when you've collected them all.

I must maintain my vigil over the Sunwell here, so I'll ask you to collect them in my stead.$B$BI need my scrying orb, my scroll of Scourge magic, and my journal.  Use this satchel for some extra space, as my things are rather bulky.  Return them to me and I'll give you a little something - you know, for the effort; you can keep the satchel as well!
english.completed: Return to Well Watcher Solanian at the Sunspire in Sunstrider Isle.

text.title: 达斯雷玛的神龛
text.objectives: 阅读达斯雷玛的神龛上的铭文之后，向逐日岛太阳之塔上的护井者索兰尼亚复命。
text.description: 日复一日，我矗立在这里，观察着，思索着，等待着。当我极目远眺着海平线时，有许多人指责我只会缅怀过去的日子，无法自拔。但我仍然坚定地认为，每一位来到这座岛屿的访客都应纪念那些曾为我们的生存而付出并牺牲一切的人。$B$B达斯雷玛·逐日者是我们的第一任国王。他领导着我们穿越了大漩涡，从卡利姆多来到这里。$B$B去西边寻找他的神龛吧，阅读了上面的纪念铭文之后再回来找我。
text.completion: Ah, $n - thank you for sharing your experience at the Shrine of Dath'Remar.  First off, you should be commended for your sense of duty and respect - it will serve you well not only here, but in all of Azeroth as well.$B$BAs for the odd sensation, it is no doubt a contributing part of the taint that has befallen Sunstrider Isle.  We shall keep an eye on it; thank you for alerting us to it!
text.completed: Return to Well Watcher Solanian at Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.

english.title: The Shrine of Dath'Remar
english.objectives: Read the plaque on the Shrine of Dath'Remar and then return to Well Watcher Solanian at the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.
english.description: Day after day I stand here, watching, waiting.  I've been accused of dwelling too much on our past, while my eyes look to the horizon.  But it is my firm belief that each visitor to this island should honor those who have sacrificed all so that they may continue to do so.$B$BDath'Remar Sunstrider was our first king.  He led us here from Kalimdor through the Maelstrom.$B$BSeek out his shrine to the west and do not return to me until you have read the plaque upon it in his honor.
english.completion: Ah, $n - thank you for sharing your experience at the Shrine of Dath'Remar.  First off, you should be commended for your sense of duty and respect - it will serve you well not only here, but in all of Azeroth as well.$B$BAs for the odd sensation, it is no doubt a contributing part of the taint that has befallen Sunstrider Isle.  We shall keep an eye on it; thank you for alerting us to it!
english.completed: Return to Well Watcher Solanian at Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.

objectiveDetails.description: 阅读达斯雷玛的神龛上的铭文

text.title: 索兰尼亚的物品
text.objectives: 收集护井者索兰尼亚的占卜宝珠、天灾魔法卷轴和日记。它们分别位于逐日岛上的池塘边、喷泉附近以及一块燃烧水晶旁。找到所有物品后，将它们归还给太阳之塔上的护井者索兰尼亚。
text.description: 由于逐日岛这段时间以来所发生的混乱和变故，我几乎完全没有时间来收回我散落在岛上的东西。现在我必须守在这里观察太阳之井，所以我想只能拜托你替我收回这些东西了。$B$B我需要我的占卜宝珠，我的天灾魔法卷轴，还有我的日记本。来，拿着这个小背包，我的东西实在是太多了，你可以把它们都装在这里面带回来。请一定要把它们带回来给我，我会给你一点小礼物以表达谢意的——另外，这个小背包你也可以留下！
text.progress: Have you had a chance to find my belongings?  Once we reassert our dominance over Sunstrider Isle, I will need them in my work.  For now though, I must maintain my watch over the Sunwell... or what remains of it.
text.completion: Well done - I knew you'd be perfect for the task.  Once it's safe to make use of our outdoor facilities on the isle, I'll be putting these things to good use.$B$BLike I mentioned, please feel free to keep the satchel.  Also, you may find this piece of armor to be useful.  Consider it ample compensation for a simple task performed dutifully!
text.completed: Return to Well Watcher Solanian at the Sunspire in Sunstrider Isle.

text.title: 注射疫苗
text.objectives: 对6只木巢枭兽使用疫苗水晶，然后向埃门谷坠毁点的守备官奥达尔复命。
text.description: 沙娜安需要我们帮她回收一些埃索达的零件。塔蕾克丝准备了一个接种装置，它可以让生活在附近这片地区的木巢枭兽得到拯救。$B$B你只需靠近那些尚未被辐射影响到的枭兽，然后对它们使用这枚水晶就可以了。而那些已经被辐射影响的枭兽……很遗憾，你只能杀死它们。到东南方的木巢山去，枭兽们就居住在那里的木巢林地中。
text.progress: The more we can do to clear up Nestlewood, the faster Zhanaa can get back to work.
text.completion: With many of the owlkin now inoculated, we can focus on getting out of here and not have to worry about wiping out the owlkin population in the area.$B$BHere, choose from these. You've done good work, and you deserve to be rewarded!
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Inoculation
english.objectives: Use the Inoculating Crystal on 6 Nestlewood Owlkin. Then return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: Zhanaa needs our help to salvage parts from the Exodar.  Taerix prepared an inoculum that can be given to the Nestlewood owlkin that live in the area of a lot of the salvage.$B$BJust get close to the unaffected ones and use the crystal on them.  Unfortunately, you'll have to kill the others.  You'll find the owlkin at Nestlewood Thicket and Nestlewood Hills to the southeast.
english.progress: The more we can do to clear up Nestlewood, the faster Zhanaa can get back to work.
english.completion: With many of the owlkin now inoculated, we can focus on getting out of here and not have to worry about wiping out the owlkin population in the area.$B$BHere, choose from these.  You've done good work, and you deserve to be rewarded!
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Aldar at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 备用零件
text.objectives: 收集4份发射器备用零件，然后向埃门谷坠毁点的技师沙娜安复命。
text.description: 我们最近成功地从坠毁地区回收了一个已经损坏的全息图象发射器。如果我们能把它修好，就有机会找到其他在埃门谷之外的幸存者了。$B$B埃索达坠毁时，有些备用零件也散落出了船外。本来我们可以迅速回收的，可它们现在被这一地区的枭兽全部运走了。$B$B$n，你必须立刻到南方的木巢林地和木巢山去，回收那些备用零件。
text.progress: When we have those spare parts, I know that we'll get this emitter repaired. With any luck there will be someone else out there left to talk to.
text.completion: Let me take a look at those.$B$BYes, I think that these will do nicely; good job, $n. The emitter is rather complex so it may take some time to finish the repairs. I'll let you know when it's ready.$B$BIn the meantime, you might see if Vindicator Aldar has anything he could use you for.
text.completed: Return to Technician Zhanaa at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

english.title: Spare Parts
english.objectives: Collect 4 Emitter Spare Parts and then return to Technician Zhanaa at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
english.description: We managed to recover a damaged holographic emitter from the crash. If we repair it, we'll have a chance to find other survivors outside of Ammen Vale.$B$BThere were devices from the ship that could be salvaged for spare parts in the area, but the local owlkin carried them off before we could get to them. $B$B$n, you must go south to Nestlewood Thicket and Hills to find the spare parts.
english.progress: When we have those spare parts, I know that we'll get this emitter repaired. With any luck there will be someone else out there left to talk to.
english.completion: Let me take a look at those.$B$BYes, I think that these will do nicely; good job, $n. The emitter is rather complex so it may take some time to finish the repairs. I'll let you know when it's ready.$b$bIn the meantime, you might see if Vindicator Aldar has anything he could use you for.
english.completed: Return to Technician Zhanaa at the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

text.title: 懒惰的苦工
text.objectives: 在懒惰的苦工睡觉时，用工头的木棒敲醒4个苦工。
text.description: 该死的苦工！我叫他们在山谷里伐木，但他们总是见缝插针地打盹！我需要找个人帮我去叫醒他们。$B$B你看上去是个挺适合这差事的$r。给你，拿着这根棍子，看到偷懒睡觉的苦工就打醒他。只要狠狠地敲他们一下就能让他们乖乖回去工作了！别忘了把棍子还给我。$B$B到山谷中的树荫下去找他们。这些该死的懒汉……
text.progress: No good lazy...$B$B Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
text.completion: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar.

english.title: Lazy Peons
english.objectives: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on 4 Lazy Peons when they're sleeping.
english.description: Cursed peons!  They work hard gathering lumber from the trees of the valley, but they're always taking naps!  I need someone to help keep the peons in line.$B$BYou look like the right $r for my task.  Here, you take this blackjack and use it on any lazy peons you find sleeping on the job.  A good smack will get them right back to work!  Return the blackjack when you're done.$B$BLook for them underneath the trees in the valley.  Lousy slacking peons...
english.progress: No good lazy...$B$B Eh?  Do you have my blackjack?  Did you catch any peons sleeping on the job?!
english.completion: Good, good.  Maybe they'll think twice before slacking next time!  Thanks for the help!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Thazz'ril in Durotar.

text.title: 恶魔血液
text.objectives: 从破碎群岛的任意恶魔身上取得$1oa份魔血。
text.description:
是时候联络主人的灵魂了。他就在无尽虚空的某个地方。幸运的是，马顿也在扭曲虚空。

虽然已有先例，但即便是在这里进行尝试也有很大的难度。除了主母让大家收集的东西以外，我们还需要大量的恶魔血液。

要超级多的血液才行！
text.progress: Once we have enough demon blood, you can begin the ritual.
text.completion: If this is not enough demon blood, no amount will be. Now, let us see if we can make contact with Illidan's spirit in the Twisting Nether.
text.completed: 前往邪能之槌号的下层。

english.title: The Blood of Demons
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Fel Blood from any demon on the Broken Isles.
english.description:
The time has come to make contact with the Master's soul. It is somewhere in the endless expanse of the Twisting Nether. Luckily, so is Mardum.

Such a thing is not unheard of, but it will be exceedingly difficult, even here. In addition to what the matron mother had us gather, we need a great deal of demon blood.

Like, a lot of it!
english.progress: Когда у нас будет достаточно крови демонов, ты сможешь начать ритуал.
english.completion: Этой крови уж точно должно хватить. Посмотрим, получится ли связаться с духом Иллидана в Круговерти Пустоты.
english.completed: Head downstairs on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: 简单计划
text.objectives: 聆听肖尔的计划，然后表明你的态度。
text.description:
迪瑟洛克跟很多恐惧魔王一样，总是那么洋洋自得。他非常粗心大意，我在被关押时偷听到了他的许多计划。

在你离开之前，我想强调一下暴风城事态的严重性。艾泽拉斯的命运已经岌岌可危。

不过，我有一个简单的计划：解决他们。
text.completion: Then, it's decided. We either expose Detheroc or it's war between the Alliance and Horde, and we lose the world to the Burning Legion.

english.title: A Simple Plan
english.objectives: Hear Mathias Shaw's plan and then cast your vote.
english.description:
Like many dreadlords, Detheroc cannot help but gloat. He was careless and I overheard many of his plans while I was held captive.

With your leave, I would like to underscore the gravity of the situation in Stormwind. The fate of Azeroth hangs in the balance.

But for all of that, I have a simple plan: get 'em.
english.completion: Значит, по рукам. Либо мы разоблачим Детеррока, либо он развяжет войну между Ордой и Альянсом, а Пылающий Легион уничтожит весь мир.

text.title: 黑暗启示
text.objectives: 消灭背叛者夜刃。
text.description:
我不会让科达娜·邪歌逍遥法外的。我不会让那个邪恶的守望者转化我的人民。

至于夜刃……我决不能容忍一个背叛者活着！

你愿意帮我吗，$n？
text.completion:
Grim news indeed. We cannot afford the loss of even one demon hunter, but you and Kor'vas were right to put an end to Nightglaive.

More importantly, you have made a good friend in Stellagosa. The remnant of the Blue Dragonflight could prove to be a powerful ally.

english.title: Dark Revelations
english.objectives: Kill Nightglaive the Traitor.
english.description:
I'm not going to let Cordana Felsong get away with this. There is no way in hell I am going to let that warden witch turn my people.

As for Nightglaive... I will NOT suffer a traitor to live!

Are you with me, $n?
english.completion:
Grim news indeed. We cannot afford the loss of even one demon hunter, but you and Kor'vas were right to put an end to Nightglaive.

More importantly, you have made a good friend in Stellagosa. The remnant of the Blue Dragonflight could prove to be a powerful ally.

objectiveDetails.description: 返回伊利达雷哨所（可选）

text.title: 营救丝黛拉苟萨
text.objectives: 取得里基尔的钥匙并救出丝黛拉苟萨。
text.description:
战斗中发生了一件特别的事情，我看到一条蓝龙俯冲过来，对恶魔展开攻击。我无法相信自己的眼睛。我听说蓝龙军团已经灭绝。

幼龙最后被燃烧军团击落了，可她成功消灭了许多恶魔。那场面十分壮烈。最后我看到恶魔拖着她往南面的营地去了。

我们应该去看看她是不是还活着。巨龙或许可以成为强大的盟友。
text.progress: If there's a remnant of the Blue Dragonflight nearby, we should do whatever we can to ally ourselves with them.
text.completion:
Beautiful creatures... pure, one with the world. I didn't think that I could hate the Legion more.

Thank you, $n.

english.title: Saving Stellagosa
english.objectives: Obtain Lykill's Key and free Stellagosa.
english.description:
During the fighting, of all things, I saw a blue drake swoop in and attack the demons. I couldn't believe my eyes. I'd heard that the Blue Dragonflight had gone extinct.

The Legion managed to bring the drake down, but not until after she'd killed a score of them. She was magnificent. Last I saw, they were dragging her in the direction of the southern camp.

We should see if she's still alive. A dragon could prove a powerful ally.
english.progress: If there are still blue dragons left, we must make every effort to earn their favour and gain their support.
english.completion:
Beautiful creatures... pure, one with the world. I didn't think that I could hate the Legion more.

Thank you, $n.

text.title: See Qiana Moonshadow (Follower Mission Turn in)

english.title: See Qiana Moonshadow (Follower Mission Turn in)

耻辱之行
text.objectives: 护送法罗迪斯王子前往纳萨拉斯的外围。
text.description: 纳萨拉斯的悲惨状况仍在我眼前挥之不去，我没法再忍受这个被诅咒的镇子所遭受的苦难了。不过，我会坚持带你到离潮汐之石更近的地方。$b$b<法罗迪斯眯起双眼，下定了决心。>$b$b我们得从镇子外围绕过去。跟我走。
text.completion: <The prince appears emotionally drained.>$b$bThis is the end of the road for me, $n. I can't bear to look at them. Moreover, my mere presence puts you in danger.$b$bBeyond this point, you must walk alone.

english.title: The Walk of Shame
english.objectives: Escort Prince Farondis around the edge of Nar'thalas.
english.description: The echoes of Nar'thalas still haunt me, and I cannot bear the pain of this accursed town any longer. I may still be able to get you closer to the Tidestone, however.$b$b<Farondis' eyes narrow in newfound determination.>$b$bWe will need to skirt around the edge of town. Follow me.
english.completion: <The prince appears emotionally drained.>$b$bThis is the end of the road for me, $n. I can't bear to look at them. Moreover, my mere presence puts you in danger.$b$bBeyond this point, you must walk alone.

text.title: 进入学院
text.objectives: 进入纳萨拉斯学院大厅。
text.description: 桥的另一边是已经沉入水底的纳萨拉斯学院，那里曾是全艾泽拉斯的魔法研究中心。你真该看看它在全盛时期的模样。$b$b潮汐之石应该就在里面。我不敢进去，但是你——我的勇士——请带着我的祝福进去吧。
text.completion: New student?

english.title: Into the Academy
english.objectives: Enter the halls of the Nar'thalas Academy.
english.description: The sunken structure on the other side of this bridge was once called Nar'thalas Academy: the center of magical studies in all of Azeroth. You should have seen her in her full splendor.$b$bThe Tidestone should be locked up within. I dare not enter, but you - my champion - you go with my blessing.
english.completion: New student?

text.title: 潮汐之石：碎裂
text.objectives: 收集$1oa块潮汐之石碎片。
text.description: 这样的话，那你可以进去。$b$b高戈奈斯潮汐之石的碎片就在学院东翼。我身为馆长，也不了解那些碎片的状况，因为几千年来我从未进去检查过。$b$b噢，年轻的$n，请不要触碰任何东西。
text.progress: <The last remaining piece of the Tidestone lies before you.>
text.completion: <You notice the reflection of something sinister upon the core's surface...>

english.title: The Tidestone: Shattered
english.objectives: Collect the $1oa Tidestone Shards.
english.description: I suppose you can go in, then.$b$bThe shattered pieces of the Tidestone of Golganneth are contained within the academy's eastern wing. Even as curator, I cannot attest to their condition, as I have not been in to inspect them in many millennia.$b$bOh, young $n? Please do not touch anything.
english.progress: <The last fragment of Tidal Stone lies before you.>
english.completion: <You notice the reflection of something sinister upon the core's surface...>

text.title: 打蛇七寸
text.objectives: 消灭阿茜萨。
text.description: 那些纳迦拿到了潮汐之石碎片，$n。他们很快就会把碎片带回自己的水底巢穴，让我们无法触及。$b$b我们最好赶在他们前面，先除掉他们的首领。
text.completion: You killed Athissa, $n.$b$bThat is to say, you and... and my people...$b$bMy people... they fought for us...$b$bBut, Warlord Parjesh has escaped through the portal with the Tidestone. You must pursue him and retrieve the Pillar of Creation.

english.title: The Head of the Snake
english.objectives: Defeat Athissa.
english.description: Those naga have the Tidestone shards, $n. They will soon be dragging them into their watery holes, away from our reach.$b$bIt would be wise to take out their leaders before that happens.
english.completion: You killed Athissa, $n.$b$bThat is to say, you and... and my people...$b$bMy people... they fought for us...$b$bBut, Warlord Parjesh has escaped through the portal with the Tidestone. You must pursue him and retrieve the Pillar of Creation.

text.title: 夯实基本功
text.objectives: 与暴风城的奥黛丽·伯恩赫普交谈。
text.description: 不错的气势，$n，但你在宠物对战这块可得从头学起。去暴风城找奥黛丽·伯恩赫普吧，她会将基本功传授给你的。
text.completed: 与暴风城的奥黛丽·伯恩赫普交谈。

english.title: Basics First
english.objectives: Speak with Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind City.
english.description: Great spirit, $n, but you have to learn the basics of pet battles first.  Visit Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind City, and she'll get you started.
english.completed: Speak with Audrey Burnhep in Stormwind City.

text.title: Captain's Whistle
text.objectives: Bring Anne Dunworthy 100 Artifact Fragments for a Captian's Whistle.

english.title: Captain's Whistle
english.objectives: Bring Anne Dunworthy 100 Artifact Fragments for a Captian's Whistle.

text.title: 纳萨拉斯苦难未平
text.objectives: 消灭阿茜萨。
text.description: 他们还没有原谅我，这不怪他们。$b$b抛开我的罪过不谈，我依然是他们的王子。就算死了，我还是会尽我所能保护我的人民。$b$b$n，为我而战。找到并消灭那个指挥纳迦屠戮纳萨拉斯的人。这么多年过去了，你——如此特别的$r$c——或许是我获得救赎的机会。
text.completion: She spoke of the Tidestone? That sea witch must not realize how close she truly is to finding it.$b$bWe should move quickly. We are close to your prize, and the naga are circling in.

english.title: Nar'thalas Still Suffers
english.objectives: Defeat Athissa.
english.description: They have not forgiven me. I cannot blame them.$b$bPast crimes aside, I am still their prince. Even in death, I will do what I can to protect my people.$b$b$n. Act as my champion. Find and defeat the creature that leads this naga attack against the people of Nar'thalas. After all these years, you - |5$r $c, of all things - may be the instrument of my redemption.
english.completion: She spoke of the Tidestone? That sea witch must not realize how close she truly is to finding it.$b$bWe should move quickly. We are close to your prize, and the naga are circling in.

text.title: 漫长的散步
text.objectives: 找到艾德斯长老。
text.description: 我很担心艾德斯长老。他在一万年以前外出散步，到现在还没回来。$b$b现在纳迦发动了进攻，我怕他会有危险！$b$b如果你不怕战斗，就请你去找回我们的宫廷长老吧。
text.progress: Ты $gнашел:нашла; старейшину?
text.completion: I can't tell you how relieved I am that Elder Aldryth has returned.$b$bHonestly, life here in the palace hasn't been the same without him. Everything seemed to have... lost its color. Perhaps now we can get back to our normal lives.

english.title: A Rather Long Walk
english.objectives: Find Elder Aldryth.
english.description: I'm concerned for Elder Aldryth. He went out for a walk about ten thousand years ago, and he has not returned.$b$bWith these naga attacking, I fear he may be in danger!$b$bIf you dare venture out into the fray, do look out for our court elder.
english.progress: Ты $gнашел:нашла; старейшину?
english.completion: I can't tell you how relieved I am that Elder Aldryth has returned.$b$bHonestly, life here in the palace hasn't been the same without him. Everything seemed to have... lost its color. Perhaps now we can get back to our normal lives.

text.title: 夜幕之下
text.objectives: 舰队上将特塞斯会安排你潜入暴风城，等你准备好以后就告诉陶矢。
text.description:
我们准备前往暴风城。特塞斯会帮我们在夜色的掩护下从旧兵营下方的水路溜进去。

剩下的就靠你、我，还有马迪亚斯三个人了。我们必须悄悄进入暴风城，在军情七处解决迪瑟洛克。

$n，你准备好了吗？
text.completion: We made it. Now all we have to do is get up there, sneak through my city -- which, mind you, is being watched by everyone -- then reveal and kill a dreadlord inside the headquarters of SI:7, Azeroth's most elite spy organization.$B$BPiece of cake. Ready to save the world, $n?

english.title: Under Cover of Darkness
english.objectives: Speak with Taoshi when you're ready for Fleet Admiral Tethys to arrange your transport to Stormwind City.
english.description:
We are off to Stormwind. Tethys will sneak us by water beneath the old barracks under cover of darkness tonight.

The rest will be up to you, Mathias, and myself. We will have to stealth through Stormwind and confront Detheroc at SI:7.

Are you ready to do this, $n?
english.completion:
У нас получилось! Осталось только подняться наверх, прокрасться через весь город – который, хочу заметить, тщательно охраняется, а потом разоблачить и убить повелителя ужаса в главном штабе ШРУ, лучшей разведслужбы Азерота.

Пара пустяков. $gГотов:Готова; спасать мир, $n?

objectiveDetails.description: 使用舰队上将的小船潜入暴风城

text.title: 混入沉船竞技场
text.objectives: 混入沉船竞技场并找到欧库纳·长牙。
text.description:
沉船竞技场的巨人喜欢击沉那些太靠近海岸的船只。他们会把水手囚禁起来，当做消遣的玩具。

我猜你可以轻易混进那里，但要逃出来才是难事。
text.completion: Did you get my bottle? Are you here to help us escape?

english.title: Infiltrating Shipwreck Arena
english.objectives: Infiltrate Shipwreck Arena and find Okuna Longtusk.
english.description:
The giants at Shipwreck Arena are very fond of smashing ships that sail too close to shore. They take the sailors prisoner and use them for their own amusement.

I suppose it will be easy for you to infiltrate the place. It's breaking out that will be the difficult part.
english.completion: Did you get my bottle? Are you here to help us escape?

text.title: 寻找潮汐之石
text.objectives: 护送法罗迪斯王子前往纳萨拉斯废墟。
text.description: 你要找潮汐之石……有意思。更重要的是，这很符合我自己的利益。长久以来，我一直在寻找一位勇士。$b$b那就这么决定了，我跟你一起走。$b$b我们得往东边走，穿过纳萨拉斯。$b$b可以出发了吗？
text.completion: Perhaps this was a mistake.

english.title: Trailing the Tidestone
english.objectives: Escort Prince Farondis to the Ruins of Nar'thalas.
english.description: Your quest for the Tidestone... it intrigues me. More than that, it suits my needs quite well. I have been in need of a champion for a very, very long time.$b$bIt is decided, then. I shall join you.$b$bWe will have to head east, through Nar'thalas.$b$bShall we depart?
english.completion: Perhaps this was a mistake.

text.title: 鲸腹才是老板
text.objectives: 与鲸腹老板交谈。
text.description:
很好，我们开始行动吧！想让所有人都逃出去的话，你必须伪装成和我们一样的角斗士。他们可不会允许外人在这里闲逛。

首先，你得见见鲸腹老板。虽说这里是巨人的地盘，但伪装成角斗士以后你就归鲸腹管。

他就在南边，和他的喽啰们说话呢。
text.progress: Ну давай же. Поговори с ним.
text.completion:
That could have gone better. Sounds like you've already made an enemy.

Still, that'll work to our advantage. You versus Boss Whalebelly. The fight of the century... or at least, the day.

Now to set everything up.

english.title: Boss Whalebelly's in Charge
english.objectives: Speak with Boss Whalebelly.
english.description:
Great, let's get started! If we're going to break everyone out of here, you need to pose as a pit fighter like the rest of us. They won't just let you run around anywhere you want in here.

First thing you need to do is present yourself to Boss Whalebelly. The giants may run this place, but as far as posing as one of us, Whalebelly's in charge.

He's speaking with his goons just to the south.
english.progress: Ну давай же. Поговори с ним.
english.completion:
That could have gone better. Sounds like you've already made an enemy.

Still, that'll work to our advantage. You versus Boss Whalebelly. The fight of the century... or at least, the day.

Now to set everything up.

text.title: 尾锚的勇士
text.objectives: 向尾锚报到，成为他的新角斗士勇士。
text.description:
你打败了乌克都克，尾锚那里就空出一个角斗士的位置。你应该去加入他的队伍，成为尾锚的勇士。这么一来，巨人就不会觉得你是到处乱窜的外人了。

与此同时，我会制造一些乱子，方便我们袭击欧逊努斯王子。
text.completion:
Hello, what can I do for you, little $r?

Ahahaha... it's you!  I like how you came in and immediately confronted Whalebelly. That little tuskarr's got it coming.

I can tell you're going to win big for me in the arena.

english.title: Sternfathom's Champion
english.objectives: Report to Sternfathom as his new pitfighter.
english.description:
Since you defeated Ooker Dooker, there's a pit fighter spot open on Sternfathom's team. You should go establish yourself as his champion. That way, the giants won't think twice about why a stranger is suddenly coming and going as $g he:she; pleases.

Meanwhile, I'll start to sow some chaos so that we can strike at Prince Oceanus.
english.completion:

I can tell you're going to win big for me in the arena.

text.title: 迪兹·幻火
text.objectives: 找到迪兹·幻火。
text.description: 就神器出土数量来看，我现在待的地方很不错。$b$b我们有其他几位协会成员还在做实地勘探。我本想去找他们的，但从健康的角度来说那主意可能不太妙。$b$b你看上去不像是在遭受疼痛的折磨，能不能去帮我找找迪兹？
text.completion: Shh... keep it down. The last thing I want is to get punched in the face by an ogre.
text.completed: 在纳格兰的破碎悬崖找到迪兹·幻火。

english.objectives: Find Dizzy Sparkshift.
english.description: I'm in a pretty good spot as far as artifacts go.$b$bWe have a couple other society members out in the field. I'd go look for them, but it seems like a bad idea from a health perspective.$b$bYou don't seem to have a problem with pain, think you could find Dizzy?
english.completion: Тс-с-с... потише. Я меньше всего хочу, чтобы меня ударил огр.

text.title: 闹鬼的大厅
text.objectives: 进入学院西部。
text.description: 现在说说你想干什么？你是来看高戈奈斯潮汐之石的？哈！吼哈哈哈！$b$b我的天。$b$b不行的，只有院长才有那个房间的钥匙。她好久都没开过那个门了……噢，大概有一万年了吧。$b$b你现在该去上课了。快点！到西边的房间去！
text.completion: Yes, the headmistress is in her study, but I can't have you bothering her right now. Classes are about to start.

english.objectives: Enter the academy's west wing.
english.description: Now, what was it you wanted? You're here to see the Tidestone of Golganneth? Hah! Ho ho ha ha haa!$b$bHooo my.$b$bNo, only the academy's headmistress has the keys to that chamber, and she hasn't opened the door in... oh, I'd say about ten thousand years.$b$bYou'd best be off to class, now. Go on, then! Into the west wing with you!
english.completion: Yes, the headmistress is in her study, but I can't have you bothering her right now. Classes are about to start.

text.title: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
text.objectives: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
text.description:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds are rousing champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent them from mustering the forces they need to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to make.

text.title: 别弄醒巨人
text.objectives: 收集巨人的武器箱。
text.description:
我们需要制造机会去接近欧逊努斯王子。我们是不是想到一块去了？

看到那边打瞌睡的桅船了吗？他看守着巨人们从我们的船只残骸里拿到的武器。我们可以用那些武器将洞里的其他角斗士都武装起来。

你只需要悄悄地从他身边溜过去，只要别弄醒他就行。
text.progress: As soon as I can, I'll arm the gladiators in Oceanus Cove.
text.completion: I couldn't have snuck passed him better. Now, to get these weapons into the right hands.

english.title: Let Sleeping Giants Lie
english.objectives: Collect the Giants' Stash of Weapons.
english.description:
We're going to need a diversion to get close to Prince Oceanus. Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

See Sleepy Dhow over there? He's guarding all of the weapons the giants take from our shipwrecks. We can use those weapons to arm the rest of the pit fighters that are held in the caves.

All you have to do is get past that giant without waking him.
english.progress: As soon as I have the opportunity, I will arm the gladiators in Oceania Bay.
english.completion: I couldn't have snuck passed him better. Now, to get these weapons into the right hands.

text.title: 自救
text.objectives: 与法罗迪斯交谈，听他讲述他是怎么救下你的。
text.description: 我当然不能坐视他们把你带走。$b$b我会解释一切的。
text.completion: What happened, Farondis?

english.title: Save Yourself
english.objectives: Speak with Farondis and hear his account of how he saved you.
english.description: Of course I couldn't sit back and let them just cart you away.$b$bI will explain everything.
english.completion: What happened, Farondis?

text.objectives: Bring the Tidestone Shards to Senegos.
text.description: Before I forget, $n: the Tidestone shards. They are yours to protect now.$b$bBring them back to your dragon. The people of Azsuna stand behind you.

text.title: 鼓舞士气
text.objectives: 从乌卡都克处获得斗士大餐。
text.description:
在你看来或许一切顺利，但其实我们情况不妙。不过别担心，我的$r小朋友。你帮得上忙。

仔细听好。乌克都克的姐姐乌卡都克，正在那边的勇士洞穴里烹制她那道举世闻名的斗士大餐。那道菜可以让我们的队伍士气大增。

你只需要去说服她交出大餐就行。
text.completion:
Yes, this'll do nicely... oh no! The last of my pit fighters have been defeated.

It's just you and me now, little $r.

english.title: Morale Booster
english.objectives: Get the Fighter Chow from Ooka Dooker
english.description:
Things may look good from where you're standing, but, we're losing. However, do not fret, my little $r friend. You can help.

Listen closely. Ooka Dooker, Ooker's sister, is back over yonder in the champions' cave making her world famous Fighter Chow. It'll do the trick and boost our team's morale.

All you have to do is to convince her to hand it over.
english.completion:
Yes, this'll do nicely... oh no! The last of my pit fighters have been defeated.

It's just you and me now, little $r.

text.title: 第一回合，开打！
text.objectives: 让尾锚把你扔进竞技场，击败鲸腹老板后前往欧逊努斯海窟找欧库纳·长牙。
text.description:
我的所有角斗士都出局了！

现在就全靠你了，$n。锈舵会派出他的三位勇士来对付你。
text.completion: <This is where you expected to find Okuna. Instead, you only found the pack with the weapons.>
text.giverWindow: 在竞技场里活下来，并最终消灭鲸腹老板。

english.title: Round 1, Fight!
english.objectives: Have Sternfathom throw you into the arena, defeat Boss Whalebelly, and then find Okuna Longtusk inside Oceanus Cove.
english.description:
All of my gladiators are out of commission!

It's down to you, $n. Bilgerudder's going to pit his three champions against you.
english.completion: <This is where you expected to find Okuna. Instead, you only found the pack with the weapons.>

text.title: 一步登天
text.objectives: 打败乌克都克。
text.description:
现在没有时间让你通过层层选拔了。不过，在竞技场里切磋武艺是你和巨人搞好关系的最佳方式。

那边那个好心的巨人叫尾锚，他一直输给锈舵。如果你打败他的猢狲勇士，就能挤进尾锚的队伍里去。

看来乌克都克正在中场休息，最好趁机给那只毛猴一顿胖揍。
text.completion:
You made quick work of that monkey. Now there's an empty position on Sternfathom's team that you can fill.

But first, let's get me set up for what comes after your big match.
text.giverWindow: 赶走这个家伙，这样你才能取代他在尾锚队伍里的位置。

english.title: No Time for Tryouts
english.objectives: Deliver a beatdown to Ooker Dooker.
english.description:
We don't have time for you to go through a lengthy set of tryouts. But, fighting in the arena is our best chance at getting you in good with the giants.

That kind-hearted giant over there that's losing against Bilgerudder is Sternfathom. If you were to defeat his hozen champion, you'd make yourself a spot on his team.

Looks like Ooker Dooker's taking a rest between bouts. Now's the time to deliver a good ol' monkey beatdown.
english.completion:
You made quick work of that monkey. Now there's an empty position on Sternfathom's team that you can fill.

But first, let's get me set up for what comes after your big match.

text.title: 准备就绪的霜狼
text.objectives: 选择一位追随者（盖亚安祖母，可敬的卡尔戈或洛卡拉），然后与马卡·缚石谈一谈。
text.description: 虽然我们今天损失惨重，但霜狼们随时可以起来履行跟你们的约定。$b$b为了遵守这个协议，我的一些族人主动要求加入你的队伍，与你的部队并肩作战。$b$b但我们的人手紧张，所以我只能让你从中挑选一位追随者。$b$b你做出决定之后，就告诉我一声吧。
text.completion: Excellent choice. I will be sad to see them leave, but I know they will help strengthen our combined packs in the coming conflicts.$b$bI will see that they make their way to your garrison as soon as they have said farewell to their loved ones.$b$bThey should be ready the next time you need to send followers on a mission.
text.completed: Speak with Makar Stonebinder in Thunder Pass.

english.title: The Frostwolves Stand Ready
english.objectives: Choose a follower (either Greatmother Geyah, Kal'gor the Honorable, or Lokra) and then speak with Makar Stonebinder.
english.description: Though we have lost much this day, the Frostwolves stand ready to uphold our pact with your people.$b$bTo honor this agreement, some of my clan have asked to join your ranks and fight alongside your forces.$b$bOur numbers are strained so I ask that you chose only one.$b$bSpeak with me when you have made your decision.
english.completion: Excellent choice. I will be sad to see them leave, but I know they will help strengthen our combined packs in the coming conflicts.$b$bI will see that they make their way to your garrison as soon as they have said farewell to their loved ones.$b$bThey should be ready the next time you need to send followers on a mission.
english.completed: Speak with Makar Stonebinder in Thunder Pass.

<武器还在你手上，你需要在巨人眼皮底下神不知鬼不觉地行动。>
text.completion:

text.title: 恶魔之魂
text.objectives: 在法罗纳尔前线捕获$1oa个恶魔之魂。
text.description:
我需要从这些邪恶的生物身上获取燃烧军团的情报。但是活着的恶魔几乎不可能屈服。

不过，我和你一样，也有一件强大的神器——夺魂之镰。

拿上我的一颗灵魂宝石，把它放在恶魔的尸体旁，它就能分裂出恶魔的“灵魂”。到时候我们再来看看夺魂之镰能否让他们开口。
text.progress: 我们需要那些恶魔之魂，$c。
text.completion: Yes. Already, I can tell their souls are weaker than their flesh.

english.title: Demon Souls
english.objectives: Trap $1oa demon souls on the Faronaar Front.
english.description:
I need to extract information about the Burning Legion from these foul creatures. But living, the demons are almost impossible to break.

However, like you, I wield a powerful artifact -- the Scythe of Souls.

Take one of my soul gems. If you place it next to a demon's corpse, it will rip the 'soul' out. Then, we will see if the scythe can get them to talk.
english.progress: 我们需要那些恶魔之魂，$c。
english.completion: Yes. Already, I can tell their souls are weaker than their flesh.

text.title: 海事法
text.objectives: 在玛拉纳东边的搁浅船只附近寻找卢伯·艾伦。
text.description:
尊敬的$g先生:女士;，打扰一下。我和打捞队的同事注意到那边那艘船在昨晚的风暴中搁浅了。

我们为那些船员深感遗憾。

<沙考尔先生摆出一副同情的样子。> 

不过，我们还是要照章办事。海事法对这种情况规定得很清楚。如果你正巧路过那里的话，一定要帮我找找物资搜索员卢伯。我等他回来喝茶已经很久了。
text.completion:
Do you know what ship this is? It's the Queen's Reprisal. Queen... as in the Banshee Queen, Sylvanas Windrunner.

If the farmstead weren't sunk under the waves, I'd be heading home to Gilneas right about now.

english.title: Maritime Law
english.objectives: Find Looper Allen near the ship that's run aground on the east side of Mak'rana.
english.description:
Good $g sir:madame;, a moment of your time. My fellow salvors and I could not help but notice yon ship that ran aground in the storm last night.

A pity about its crew.

<Mr. Shackles makes empathetic gestures.>

Still, the law's the law. The maritime code is quite clear on the matter. If you find yourself out that way, would you mind terribly checking in on my acquisitions scout, Looper? I would have expected him back for tea some time ago.
english.completion:
Do you know what ship this is? It's the Queen's Reprisal. Queen... as in the Banshee Queen, Sylvanas Windrunner.

If the farmstead weren't sunk under the waves, I'd be heading home to Gilneas right about now.

text.title: 军团的阴谋
text.objectives: 从灵魂收割器救出$1oa个恶魔猎手。
text.description:
我的部队扫荡了恶魔在这里的前哨基地。但是，一只鬼母及其爪牙俘虏了其余的恶魔猎手，其中包括赛娅娜·夜刃。

我们必须救出这些伊利达雷，并且摧毁燃烧军团。
text.progress: If we intend to win the war against the Legion, we must know exactly what the demons are planning.
text.completion:
I've always had my doubts about Cyana. Something was never quite right there. Looks like she cracked and joined the Legion.

Still, we are not going to let her, or this Cordana Felsong, get away with it.

english.title: Fel Machinations
english.objectives: Free $1oa Demon Hunters from Soul Harvesters.
english.description:
My force wiped out the demons' forward base here. But, an imp mother and her brood took the rest of my demon hunters hostage, including Cyana Nightglaive.

We need to free the Illidari and destroy the Burning Legion.
english.progress: If we intend to win the war against the Legion, we must know exactly what the demons are planning.
english.completion:
I've always had my doubts about Cyana. Something was never quite right there. Looks like she cracked and joined the Legion.

Still, we are not going to let her, or this Cordana Felsong, get away with it.

text.title: 有利可图
text.objectives: 在玛拉纳消灭$1oa个海地精或者龙虾人，并解决他们的领袖卡卡拉女王。
text.description:
可以请你帮个忙吗，朋友？东边海潮地里的生物让我越来越担心了。我们每次试着和他们做生意，都遭到暴力的拒绝。这样下去不是办法，既妨碍生意又影响赚钱。

很遗憾，我必须承认谈判已经解决不了问题。

你愿意代表我来处理玛拉纳的居民以及他们的“女王”吗？

我可以保证，你会得到丰厚的报酬。
text.progress: How is stripping going?
text.completion:
What? A jailer demon you say? Oublion? What a ghastly name.

No wonder we couldn't become trade partners with them. Oh, if only I'd known, there wouldn't have been any need for such slaughter!

Ah well. Live and learn.
text.giverWindow: 杀死女王，并清除你面前的一切阻碍。

english.title: Making the World Safe for Profit
english.objectives: Kill $1oa gilblin and/or makrura at Mak'rana and slay their leader, Queen Kraklaa.
english.description:
Might I ask a small favor, my friend? These creatures in the tide pools to the east are starting to frighten me. Our efforts to trade with them have been rebuffed at every turn with aggression. This is not good; neither for running a business, nor for profit.

Sadly, I must admit the time for talk has come to an end.

Might you be willing to serve as my representative in dealing with the denizens of Mak'rura and their "queen"?

I can assure you that your efforts will be rewarded commensurately.

你能帮我重新激活结界吗？我可不想燃烧军团踏平这里。

你做什么我管不着，伙计。不过，你要是被抓住了，可千万别提起我。

就当没见过我。

I wasn't here.

text.objectives: 和食魂者阿莱利一起拷问恶魔的灵魂。
text.description:
我们到哨所的另一边去把这些恶魔的灵魂逐个放出来，审问他们有关伊利丹大人的事情。

夺魂之镰会让他们开口的。
text.completion:
I wouldn't take what Arev'naal said to heart. The inquisitor demons are masters of misinformation. You don't suspect betrayal within the ranks, do you?

<The Souleater looks thoughtful and grim.>

I fear we won't have all of our answers about Lord Illidan for a while.

我会竭尽全力解开牢笼的邪能魔法束缚。

你一定要拦住那些军团恶魔。

text.title: “攻”书
text.objectives: 处理3部古代典籍。
text.description: <图书管理员轻声说话。>$b$b管理这种大型奥术图书馆会遇到一个问题，那就是书籍常常会被飘散的魔法影响，失控地飞来飞去。必须在它们造成更多破坏之前，摧毁这些承载了过多魔法的书籍。$b$b如果你看到这种制造麻烦的东西，就把它们处理掉。别闹出太大的动静。
text.completion: Don't worry about the scattered pages and spines - I will have my aides clean up.$b$bThank you. You may return to your studies.

english.objectives: Destroy 3 Ancient Tomes.
english.description: <The librarian speaks in shushed tones.>$b$bOne problem with maintaining such a large arcane library is that the books often pick up an errant enchantment and start darting about on their own. These overmagicked books need to be destroyed before they cause any further damage.$b$bIf you encounter any of these exasperating essays, please put them down. Quietly.
english.completion: Don't worry about the scattered pages and spines - I will have my aides clean up.$b$bThank you. You may return to your studies.

text.title: 要塞战役：暗影之中
text.objectives: 在雄狮岗哨杀死$1oa名议会夜刃刺客。
text.description: 我需要你的帮助。艾斯卡不见了。有理由相信，他跟踪上了聚集在塔纳安的塞泰克余党。我一直在调查，而结果……那是什么？$b$b<瑞沙德的声音越来越低，像是在窃窃私语>$b$b阴影中有什么动静，有人在监视我们！$b$b拿上这些药剂，只要碰到空气，这些液体就会变成味道刺鼻的云雾。非常难闻，他们肯定受不了的。用它把那些监视我们的人从藏身之处赶出来。
text.completion: So the Shadow Council is involved? Interesting...

english.title: Garrison Campaign: In the Shadows
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Council Nightblades within Lion's Watch.
english.description: I need your help. Iskar has gone missing. I have reason to believe he has followed the remnants of the Sethekk who have been gathering here in Tanaan. I've been investigating and... what was that?$b$b<Reshad's voice drops to a whisper>$b$bThere is movement in the shadows, we are being watched!$b$bTake these vials, they form a gas with a terrible smell when the liquid comes in contact with the air. Smells terrible, they won't be able to resist it. Use them to drive our watchers out of hiding.
english.completion: Значит, здесь замешан Совет Теней? Любопытно...

Smells terrible, they won't be able to resist it. Use them to drive our watchers out of hiding.

text.title: 冒名顶替
text.objectives: 爬上雄狮之眠的悬崖，潜入暴风城军情七处的总部，然后消灭迪瑟洛克。
text.description:
迪瑟洛克在每个屋顶上都部署了军情七处最厉害的狙击手。我们不能使用坐骑，也不能飞行。上面有爪钩锚点，我们可以用绳子爬上悬崖。

我们还在通往军情七处的几条路上放了些可以藏身的干草包。我们要做的，就是潜入总部并消灭迪瑟洛克。

上去之后就分开行动，让我们更有机会穿过城市。

祝你好运，$n。
text.completion: You did it! Mathias Shaw is back in charge of SI:7 and you prevented an all-out war between the Alliance and Horde.$B$BThe rest of us agree, you've proven yourself an invaluable member of the Council of Shadows and the Uncrowned.$B$BCongratulations, Shadowblade $n!
text.completed: 返回暗影大厅去找陶矢。

english.title: The Imposter
english.objectives: Grapple up the Lion's Rest cliffs, sneak through Stormwind City to the SI:7 courtyard, and then kill Detheroc.
english.description:
Detheroc has SI:7's finest snipers on all of the rooftops. We can't mount up and we can't fly. There are grapple points above so that we can move up the cliff. 

We've also setup hay bales to hide in along the likely routes to SI:7. We just need to stealth in and kill Detheroc.

Once we get up there, we'll separate to increase the chances of at least one of us making it through the city.

Good luck, $n.
english.completion:
У тебя получилось! Матиас Шоу снова во главе ШРУ, и ты не $gпозволил:позволила; Орде и Альянсу вцепиться друг другу в глотки.

У нас нет ни малейших сомнений в том, что ты будешь незаменимым членом Союза Теней и Некоронованных.

Поздравляю, Теневой клинок $n!
english.completed: Return to Taoshi in the Chamber of Shadows.
