text.title: 铭记之人
text.objectives: 在水下花园寻找守夜人埃迪。
text.description: 名为高戈奈斯潮汐之石的创世之柱原本在南边那些精灵的鬼魂手里。$b$b他们雄伟的城市纳萨拉斯在很久以前就毁于一旦。城市的统治者法罗迪斯王子也一同灭亡。你们这些小东西太容易死掉了。$b$b王子的鬼魂应该知道潮汐之石碎片的下落。去找他的人民吧。
text.completion: Who goes there?$b$bAre you an emissary from that bizarre floating city?

english.title: Those Who Remember
english.objectives: Locate Nightwatcher Idri in the Drowned Gardens.
english.description: The ghostly elves, to the south, once had the Pillar of Creation known as the Tidestone of Golganneth.$b$bTheir great city of Nar'thalas was destroyed an eon ago. The city's ruler, Prince Farondis, fell with the city. You small ones die so easily.$b$bIf anyone knows where the fragments rest, it will be the ghost of the prince. Seek out his people.
english.completion: Who goes there?$b$bAre you an emissary from that bizarre floating city?

text.title: 调酒魔导师
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个充满魔力的蛋。
text.description:
你应该知道，我可是饮料方面的行家……尤其精通灌魔烈酒。调酒是一种炼金术，而且众所周知，炼金术就是魔法。

我的新款饮料一定要比以前那些更有特色。大部分材料我都有了，只剩下几样还没弄到。

你看到湖中的苍鹭了吗？和阿苏纳的许多生物一样，在这座岛上流动的魔力同样渗入了它们体内。

它们的蛋对我有很大的用处。
text.progress: Are we speaking again because you have my eggs?
text.completion: Capital! A prodigious start.$B$BI implore you to create this marvelous mixture for yourself. I want to share the delight of alchemical spirits with the world!$B$BYou'll need to get more eggs for yourself, though.

english.title: The Magister of Mixology
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Arcane-Infused Eggs.
english.description:
As you must know, I'm a connoisseur of drinks... specifically, arcane-infused spirits. Cocktail mixing is alchemy, and as everyone knows, alchemy is magic.

My latest drink must be more exotic than anything I've conjured before. I already have most of what I need. But there are a couple of items left on the list.

Notice the herons down in the lagoon? As with many of the creatures on Azsuna, the magic coursing through the island permeates them.

Their eggs will do nicely.
english.progress: Раз ты снова здесь, полагаю, ты $gпринес:принесла; мне яйца для коктейля?
english.completion: Capital! A prodigious start.$B$BI implore you to create this marvelous mixture for yourself. I want to share the delight of alchemical spirits with the world!$B$BYou'll need to get more eggs for yourself, though.

text.title: 视觉动物
text.objectives: 收集贡戈麦什的六颗眼球。
text.description:
那些蛋能增强我的饮料的“魅力”。但是，还有一个环节千万不可忽视！

那就是品相。

比如，你可以在牙签上插一颗普通的橄榄，或者随便在杯子上插一根胡萝卜条。

但，我可不是你。

不，我的朋友。我的饮料造型必须来自一种独一无二的生物。我只会限量供应一次，所以它必须得用特别的材料。

那就是贡戈麦什的眼球。
text.progress: Yes? You have the eyes?
text.completion:
I was going to present this to one of the ladies of the court. Doing so might increase my standing in certain social circles.

But, I just can't bring myself to do it. Who better to drink my latest masterpiece than, well... me?
text.giverWindow: 魔导师加鲁霍德需要贡戈麦什的全部六颗眼球，来装点他最新最伟大的鸡尾酒。

english.title: Presentation is Everything
english.objectives: Collect the Six Eyes of Gangamesh.
english.description:
The eggs will provide the 'oomph' to my drink's character. But there's another element, and this must not be underestimated!

Presentation.

Now, you could go with your standard olive skewered on a toothpick. Maybe a carrot stalk stuck slapdash out of a glass.

But then, you wouldn't be me.

No, my friend. What MY drink needs to sell it visually comes from a one-of-a-kind creature. I'm only going to serve it once and so my drink deserves something unique.

The eyes of Gangamesh are what I need.
english.progress: Yeah? Do you have eyes?
english.completion:
I was going to present this to one of the ladies of the court. Doing so might increase my standing in certain social circles.

But, I just can't bring myself to do it. Who better to drink my latest masterpiece than, well... me?
english.giverWindow: Magister Garuhod wants all six of this beast's eyes to top off his latest, greatest cocktail.

text.title: 突击测验：高级符文绘制
text.objectives: 绘制一个奥术符文、一个火焰符文和一个冰霜符文。
text.description: 还在想着进院长的书房吗？如果你证明自己一直刻苦学习，我或许可以让你进去。$b$b采用合适的符文阵对于施法而言十分关键。能够绘制符文就代表着能够施展法术。$b$b我会给你大致的轮廓，你就用脚来绘制符文。
text.progress: For business, for business! Move your legs!
text.completion: Exemplary work, young $n. With runes like these, you'll be graduating in no time.

english.title: Pop Quiz: Advanced Rune Drawing
english.objectives: Trace an arcane rune, a fire rune, and a frost rune.
english.description: Still aching to get into the headmistress' study, eh? I suppose I can let you in... as long as you prove that you've been studying.$b$bProper rune formation is essential when it comes to spellcasting. If you can draw a rune, you can cast a spell.$b$bI will provide outlines for you. You can simply use your feet to trace the runes.
english.progress: For business, for business! Move your legs!
english.completion: Exemplary work, young $n. With runes like these, you'll be graduating in no time.

text.title: 院长的钥匙
text.objectives: 从院长艾尔娅·蓝月身上拿到潮汐之石秘库钥匙。
text.description: 我怀疑你是不是在逃课——但是我也看得出来，你非常想见院长。$b$b好吧！蓝月院长就在前面，不过我觉得她恐怕不想被打扰。
text.progress: Were you able to meet with the headmistress?
text.completion: She... she gave you her key? My word!

english.title: The Headmistress' Keys
english.objectives: Obtain the Tidestone Vault Key from Elya Azuremoon, the Academy Headmistress.
english.description: I have a suspicion you are avoiding your studies - but I can see you're anxious to see the Headmistress.$b$bVery well! Headmistress Azuremoon can be found up ahead, though I doubt she will enjoy being interrupted.
english.progress: Ну что, удалось тебе встретиться с госпожой директрисой?
english.completion: She... she gave you her key? My word!

text.title: 法罗迪斯王子
text.objectives: 在倾颓王宫与守夜人埃迪会面。
text.description: 我很高兴，显然我对你的怀疑是毫无根据的。$b$b你要找法罗迪斯王子？跟我来，我带你去王子的宫殿。
text.completion: That's him, behind me.

english.title: Prince Farondis
english.objectives: Meet up with Nightwatcher Idri at the Crumbled Palace.
english.description: I'm glad to see that my doubts in you were unfounded.$b$bYou seek Prince Farondis? Follow me. I will show you to the prince's hall.
english.completion: That's him, behind me.

text.title: 假扮学生
text.objectives: 找到纳萨拉斯学院帽子、长袍、魔杖和法术书。
text.description: 给我站住。看看你！就像刚从街头跑来一样。你的长袍和帽子呢？$b$b还有，别告诉我你没带魔杖和法术书就来学院了。$b$b新生。$b$b把自己好好收拾一下，我再考虑要不要让你进去。
text.progress: Still trying to get into the academy, I see.
text.completion: Your hat and robes don't match, but you still look better. I hardly recognize you.

english.title: Dressing With Class
english.objectives: Obtain a Nar'thalas Academy Hat, Robes, Wand, and Spellbook.
english.description: Now stop right there. Look at you! You look like you just walked in off of the street. Where are your robes and hat?$b$bAnd don't tell me you've entered the academy without your wand and spellbook.$b$bFreshmen.$b$bPut yourself together, and maybe then I will consider letting you enter the academy.
english.progress: Everyone is trying to get into the academy, as I take a look.
english.completion: Your hat and robes don't match, but you still look better. I hardly recognize you.

text.title: Trials of Khadgar: Iron Maidens
text.objectives: Defeat the Iron Maidens encounter, with the following conditions.
text.description: Defeat your enemies with greater skill to earn the favor of Khadgar - and with it, greater rewards!

english.title: Trials of Khadgar: Iron Maidens
english.objectives: Defeat the Iron Maidens encounter, with the following conditions.
english.description: Defeat your enemies with greater skill to earn the favor of Khadgar - and with it, greater rewards!

text.title: 围城：布兰肯斯波
text.objectives: 在悬槌堡击败布兰肯斯波。
text.description: 钢铁部落只是我们在德拉诺必须要应对的众多威胁之一。我们得把他们留下的残局收拾干净。$b$b布兰肯斯波是远古时代的深渊行者，钢铁部落在悬槌堡附近水域的活动引起了他的注意。这位水栖巨人会在所到之处留下蔓延的真菌和苔藓，如果不加制止，我们所有人都会被赶尽杀绝。$b$b前往悬槌堡，击败布兰肯斯波。
text.completion: Very good, Commander! Brackenspore's infestation will not be spreadin' to da rest of Draenor.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Walled City: Brackenspore
english.objectives: Defeat Brackenspore in Highmaul.
english.description: The Iron Horde is just one of the threats we must deal with on Draenor. We must also clean up the chaos they are leaving in their wake.$b$bBrackenspore, ancient walker of the deep, was drawn from the waters near Highmaul by the presence of the Iron Horde. He spreads his fungal growth in his wake and will eradicate all of us if left unchecked.$b$bTravel to Highmaul and defeat Brackenspore.
english.completion: Прекрасно, командир! Зараза Бурогриба не распространится по Дренору.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 奥秘圣殿：克拉戈
text.objectives: 在悬槌堡击败克拉戈。
text.description: 快把你对艾泽拉斯食人魔的印象抛在脑后吧，$n。食人魔在德拉诺曾经缔造了无比强大的文明。直到今天，他们还在力图重现往日的辉煌。$b$b悬槌堡在纳格兰的挖掘行动中发现了一件神秘的遗物。克拉戈是唯一一个直接暴露在遗物面前还能生还的幸存者，而这次经历使得他近乎免疫一切魔法。$b$b必须赶在食人魔成功复制克拉戈独特的力量之前将他消灭。前往悬槌堡，击败克拉戈！
text.completion: Ko'ragh be defeated. You be as strong as dey say, commander. I be proud to be at your side.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
english.objectives: Defeat Ko'ragh in Highmaul.
english.description: Forget all you know of the ogres on Azeroth, $n. On Draenor they commanded a once-mighty civilization. Even now they threaten to reclaim their former glory.$b$bHighmaul excavations in Nagrand unearthed a mysterious relic. The only ogre to survive direct exposure to this relic was Ko'ragh; he was left with a near-complete immunity to all magic.$b$bKo'ragh must be killed before the ogres learn to replicate his unique powers. Travel to Highmaul and defeat Ko'ragh!
english.completion: Ko'ragh be defeated. You be as strong as dey say, commander. I be proud to be at your side.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 元首高塔：元首马尔高克
text.objectives: 在悬槌堡击败元首马尔高克。
text.description: 向悬槌堡发起决定性攻击的条件已经成熟了，指挥官。你愿意参战吗？$b$b作为悬槌堡至高无上的统治者，元首马尔高克出身于一个世代统治高里亚帝国的巫师家族。生性残忍且狡猾奸诈的马尔高克意识到钢铁部落的崛起，以及与之对抗的下场。所以他默允了与他们的同盟关系。$b$b前往悬槌堡，击败元首马尔高克。没了领袖的食人魔帝国必将一蹶不振。
text.completion: A brilliant victory, commander! Imperator Mar'gok be defeated. You indeed be a champion of da Horde!
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
english.objectives: Defeat Imperator Mar'gok in Highmaul.
english.description: The conditions are ripe for a decisive attack against the Highmaul, commander. Will you engage?$b$bDescended from a long line of sorcerers, Imperator Mar'gok is the grand Imperator of Highmaul. He is both cunning and brutal, and allied himself with the Iron Horde when he recognized what it would be to oppose them.$b$bTravel to Highmaul and defeat Imperator Mar'gok. Without their leader, the Ogre Empire will descend into chaos for many years.
english.completion: A brilliant victory, commander! Imperator Mar'gok be defeated. You indeed be a champion of da Horde!
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 熔渣车间：山脉之心
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂的爆裂熔炉里击败山脉之心。
text.description: 黑石兽人的作战方式不同于其他氏族。他们依靠的是在其特殊熔炉中锻造的武器和护甲。$b$b在黑石氏族的黑石铸造厂深处有个熔炉，为它供能的是个名叫山脉之心的原始力量化身。去摧毁它，从敌人手中把他们用来作战的武器夺过来。$b$b前往黑石铸造厂，摧毁山脉之心。
text.completion: Well done, commander. With da Heart of da Mountain defeated, you have crippled the ability of da Blackrock clan to use their most powerful furnace.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Slagworks: Heart of the Mountain
english.objectives: Defeat the Heart of the Mountain at the Blast Furnace in Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: Blackrock orcs fight like no other clan. They rely on arms and armor forged in the heart of their unnatural crucibles.$b$bDeep within the Foundry of the Blackrock clan is a furnace powered by a primal force known as the Heart of the Mountain. Destroy it, and deprive our foe of the arms they rely on.$b$bTravel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat the Heart of the Mountain.
english.completion: Well done, commander. With da Heart of da Mountain defeated, you have crippled the ability of da Blackrock clan to use their most powerful furnace.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 黑色熔炉：克罗莫格
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂里击败克罗莫格。
text.description: 指挥官。据霜狼斥候回报，黑石矿工们发现了一个玛戈隆，而且强迫那野兽帮他们打造地狱机器。他们管它叫“克罗莫格”。$b$b必须干掉它，$n。到黑石铸造厂去，击败克罗莫格。
text.completion: Well done, commander! Not since Garrosh Hellscream commanded our forces in Northrend have I seen such decisive action.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
english.objectives: Defeat Kromog in Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: Commander. Frostwolf scouts report that blackrock miners dug up a magnaron, and they've coerced the beast into helping them to create their infernal machines. They call it "Kromog."$b$bWe must destroy it, $n. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Kromog.
english.completion: Well done, commander! Not since Garrosh Hellscream commanded our forces in Northrend have I seen such decisive action.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 钢铁装配车间：加安上将
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂中击败加安上将。
text.description: 我们的军队在陆地上步步推进，但在海上却仍然优势全无。我们必须趁钢铁部落的领军人物还未出海时将其一举歼灭。$b$b钢铁部落舰队上将、头号钢铁女武神加安战术高超。她和麾下的两位副官，玛拉卡和苏卡，让任何胆敢前去跟她们做对的人有去无回。$b$b前往黑石铸造厂，击败加安上将。
text.completion: Brilliant work, commander. Without da mind of Admiral Gar'an behind it, da Iron Horde's naval fleet be greatly diminished.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
english.objectives: Defeat Admiral Gar'an in Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: Our forces are making progress on land, but victory at sea still eludes us. We must take out the Iron Horde leadership while they are in harbor.$b$bGar'an, Admiral of the Iron Horde fleet and first of the so-called Iron Maidens, is tactically brilliant. She, along with her lieutenants, Marak, and Sorka, have crushed all who have been sent to oppose them.$b$bTravel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Admiral Gar'an.
english.completion: Brilliant work, commander. Without da mind of Admiral Gar'an behind it, da Iron Horde's naval fleet be greatly diminished.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 黑手的熔炉：黑手
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂里击败黑手。
text.description: 格罗玛什·地狱咆哮依靠他麾下督军的力量牢牢控制着钢铁部落。是时候发起决定性打击了。$b$b黑石氏族的督军黑手既是个无畏无惧的战士，也是个残忍无情的暴君。他在钢铁部落军中的地位仅次于格罗玛什，在熔炉上方监督着铸造厂的作业。$b$b前往黑石铸造厂，击败黑手。
text.completion: One of da most ruthless orcs to walk any land be defeated. You be havin' my congratulations, and my thanks.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
english.objectives: Defeat Blackhand in the Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: Grommash Hellscream relied on the strength of his Warlords to keep the Iron Horde under his control. It is time to strike a decisive blow.$b$bBlackhand, Warlord of the Blackrock clan, is a dauntless warrior and ruthless tyrant. He is second only to Grommash within the Iron Horde and oversees operations in the Foundry from atop its Crucible.$b$bTravel to the Blackrock Foundry and defeat Blackhand.
english.completion: Один из самых беспощадных орков повержен. Прими мои поздравления и мою благодарность.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 围城：布兰肯斯波
text.objectives: 在悬槌堡里击败布兰肯斯波。
text.description: 一波未平，一波又起——我敢说，即便没有部落，这个被圣光抛弃的世界也会把我们活活吞噬。$b$b布兰肯斯波是远古时代的深渊行者，钢铁部落在悬槌堡附近水域的活动引起了他的注意。如今他的影响已经像瘟疫般蔓延开来了，$n。你必须赶快去除掉他！$b$b到悬槌堡去击败布兰肯斯波，等他强大到无法阻止就来不及了。
text.completion: Excellent! Brackenspore's infestation will not spread to the rest of Draenor. Thank you, commander.

english.title: Walled City: Brackenspore
english.objectives: Defeat Brackenspore in Highmaul.
english.description: If it ain't one threat, it's another - I swear this light-forsaken world would try to eat us alive even without no Horde to fight.$b$bBrackenspore, ancient walker of the deep, was drawn from the waters near Highmaul by the presence of the Iron Horde. That thing is already spreading like a disease, $n. Ye got to put it down!$b$bTravel to Highmaul and defeat Brackenspore before he gets too powerful to stop.
english.completion: Excellent! Brackenspore's infestation will not spread to the rest of Draenor. Thank you, commander.

text.title: 奥秘圣殿：克拉戈
text.objectives: 在悬槌堡击败克拉戈。
text.description: 你听说过“克拉戈”这个名字吗？他是悬槌堡食人魔的一员。他们在不久前挖出了一件遗物，结果除了克拉戈之外，所有在场的人无一存活……而克拉戈则对魔法近乎完全免疫。$b$b怎么能让食人魔拥有那样的力量！快到悬槌堡去，击败克拉戈，别让他成为食人魔用来对付我们的武器。
text.completion: Great work! Ko'ragh is defeated. You truly are as powerful as they say.
text.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Arcane Sanctum: Ko'ragh
english.objectives: Defeat Ko'ragh in Highmaul.
english.description: Ye know the name "Ko'ragh?" One of them Highmaul ogres. They dug up a relic some time ago that killed everyone it touched but for Ko'ragh... givin' him a near-complete immunity to all magic.$b$bOgres ain't meant to have that kind of power! Travel to Highmaul and defeat Ko'ragh, before they learn to use him against us.
english.completion: Great work! Ko'ragh is defeated. You truly are as powerful as they say.
english.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 元首高塔：元首马尔高克
text.objectives: 在悬槌堡击败元首马尔高克。
text.description: 我从没把食人魔的威胁当回事，直到有一天我亲眼看见行进中的悬槌堡军团。简直就像一堵肌肉构成的移动城墙，还有帝国最出色的巫师提供魔法支援。千万不能小瞧食人魔的力量。$b$b元首马尔高克是悬槌堡的最高统治者。哎呀，他可狡猾得很——见风使舵地投靠了钢铁部落。要是我们想打破他们的同盟关系，最好从源头下手。$b$b到悬槌堡去，打败元首马尔高克！
text.completion: Well done! A great blow has been dealt this day.
text.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Imperator's Rise: Imperator Mar'gok
english.objectives: Defeat Imperator Mar'gok in Highmaul.
english.description: I never thought much of them ogres, not until I saw a Highmaul legion on the march. Like a wall o' armored muscle, backed by the magics o' the emperor's best sorcerers. Never underestimate an ogre.$b$bImperator Mar'gok is the grand Imperator of Highmaul. Aye, he's a cunning one - allied himself with the Iron Horde, he did. If we're to break up the party, we'd best start at the top.$b$bTravel to Highmaul and defeat Imperator Mar'gok!
english.completion: Well done! A great blow has been dealt this day.
english.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 熔渣车间：山脉之心
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂的爆裂熔炉击败山脉之心。
text.description: 黑石氏族的战士们用的武器，是在某个纯粹的烈焰生物喷吐出的邪恶之火中铸造出来的，那就是山脉之心。让我们解除敌人的武装吧，$g小伙子:小姑娘;！去干掉那个炼狱生物，那样一来黑石兽人就没有足够的热量来给他们的爆裂熔炉供能了。$b$b到黑石铸造厂去，解决掉山脉之心。
text.completion: Well done, commander! With the Heart of the Mountain defeated, the Blackrock will have nothing to wield but sticks and stones.

english.title: Slagworks: Heart of the Mountain
english.objectives: Defeat the Heart of the Mountain at the Blast Furnace in Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: Blackrock warriors use weapons forged in cursed fire by the breath of a creature o' pure flame: The Heart o' the Mountain. Let's disarm 'em, $gboy:lass;! Destroy that infernal creature, and the Blackrock won't have enough heat to fuel their Blast Furnace.$b$bTravel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat the Heart o' the Mountain.
english.completion: Well done, commander! With the Heart of the Mountain defeated, the Blackrock will have nothing to wield but sticks and stones.

text.title: 黑色熔炉：克罗莫格
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂里击败克罗莫格。
text.description:
据你要塞的斥候回报，黑石矿工们发现了一个玛戈隆，而且那邪恶的野兽已经开始帮助那些蛮子打造地狱机器了。他们管它叫“克罗莫格”。

到黑石铸造厂去，消灭那个怪物！
text.completion: With Kromog defeated, we won't seeing as many Iron Horde machines rolling out to the front lines. You've saved a lot of lives today, commander.

english.title: The Black Forge: Kromog
english.objectives: Defeat Kromog in Blackrock Foundry.
english.description:
Yer garrison scouts report that blackrock miners dug up a magnaron, and that the filthy beast has begun helpin' those brutes churn out their infernal machines. They call it "Kromog."

Travel to Blackrock Foundry and slay that fiend!
english.completion: With Kromog defeated, we won't seeing as many Iron Horde machines rolling out to the front lines. You've saved a lot of lives today, commander.

text.title: 钢铁装配车间：加安上将
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂里击败加安上将。
text.description: 俗话说，“射人先射马，擒贼先擒王”。要是我们能除掉钢铁部落的领军人物，那他们一定会变成一盘散沙。$b$b加安是钢铁部落舰队上将，也是头号钢铁女武神。她和麾下的两位副官，玛拉卡和苏卡，已经主宰了德拉诺的海面。$b$b但她们马上就要完蛋了，$n。到黑石铸造厂去，击败加安上将。
text.completion: Great work, commander! We'll wrest control of the seas yet!

english.title: Iron Assembly: Admiral Gar'an
english.objectives: Defeat Admiral Gar'an in Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: "If ye want to topple a wall, start with the foundation." It's an old Dwarf saying. If we take out the Iron Horde's leadership, the whole thing tumbles.$b$bGar'an is the Admiral o' the Iron Horde fleet and first of the so-called "Iron Maidens." She, along with her lieutenants, Marak, and Sorka, have dominated the seas of Draenor.$b$bNo more, $n. Travel to Blackrock Foundry and defeat Admiral Gar'an.
english.completion: Great work, commander! We'll wrest control of the seas yet!

text.title: 黑手的熔炉：黑手
text.objectives: 在黑石铸造厂里击败黑手。
text.description: 要是没有那些督军帮他管理各个氏族，老格罗玛什不可能轻易统领钢铁部落。让我们给那些家伙来一下狠的，把他们彻底打趴！黑石氏族的督军黑手既是个无畏无惧的战士，也是个残忍无情的暴君。他在钢铁部落军中的地位仅次于格罗玛什，在熔炉上方监督着铸造厂的作业。$b$b前往黑石铸造厂，击败黑手。
text.completion: So it's done, then? The foundry is in shambles. We've delivered a mighty blow today, commander. Great work!
text.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Blackhand's Crucible: Blackhand
english.objectives: Defeat Blackhand in the Blackrock Foundry.
english.description: Ol' Grommash cannot rule the Iron Horde without his Warlords keeping the clans in line. Let's deal 'em a blow that they can't recover from! Blackhand, Warlord of the Blackrock clan, is a dauntless warrior and ruthless tyrant. He's second only to Grommash within the Iron Horde and oversees operations in the Foundry from atop its Crucible.$b$bTravel to the Blackrock Foundry and defeat Blackhand.
english.completion: So it's done, then? The foundry is in shambles. We've delivered a mighty blow today, commander. Great work!
english.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Death to Amethon!
text.objectives: Retrieve a Humming Draenite Spike from Amethon above Kuuro's Claim in Talador.
text.description: Foreman Eksos down in your Talador outpost figures he has the answer for why there's been so much seismic activity recently.$B$BSee, there's this giant, ah... earth fury, I think they're called, and it's covered in these powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. The crystals hum real loud and we think it's driving the fury crazy!$B$BProblem is, nobody's got the firepower to take the thing down so we can examine a sample. Think you could lend us a hand, commander?
text.progress: Sir, what is that you have there?
text.completion: Excellent, this must be the crystal Eksos keeps talking about. We'll get top men studying this right away.

english.title: Death to Amethon!
english.objectives: Retrieve a Humming Draenite Spike from Amethon above Kuuro's Claim in Talador.
english.description: Foreman Eksos down in your Talador outpost figures he has the answer for why there's been so much seismic activity recently.$B$BSee, there's this giant, ah... earth fury, I think they're called, and it's covered in these powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. The crystals hum real loud and we think it's driving the fury crazy!$B$BProblem is, nobody's got the firepower to take the thing down so we can examine a sample. Think you could lend us a hand, commander?
english.progress: Sir, what is that you have there?
english.completion: Excellent, this must be the crystal Eksos keeps talking about. We'll get top men studying this right away.

text.title: Death to Gor'thul!
text.objectives: Slay Gor'thul at Bloodmane Pridelands in Spires of Arak.
text.description: Saberon spirit army. I ain't pullin' your leg, commander, that's what we've got coming for us if we don't act fast.$B$BThe Shattered Hand shaman Gor'thul was spotted down in Spires of Arak in the Bloodmane Pridelands right about the same time we started hearing reports of saberon spirits raiding our supply caravans.$B$BI don't want to take any chances, commander. I think you should personally head down there and put a stop to this before it starts.
text.completion: Perfect, sir. I'm glad we won't have to worry about saberon spirits on top of everything else that's trying to murder us.

english.title: Death to Gor'thul!
english.objectives: Slay Gor'thul at Bloodmane Pridelands in Spires of Arak.
english.description: Saberon spirit army. I ain't pullin' your leg, commander, that's what we've got coming for us if we don't act fast.$B$BThe Shattered Hand shaman Gor'thul was spotted down in Spires of Arak in the Bloodmane Pridelands right about the same time we started hearing reports of saberon spirits raiding our supply caravans.$B$BI don't want to take any chances, commander. I think you should personally head down there and put a stop to this before it starts.
english.completion: Perfect, sir. I'm glad we won't have to worry about saberon spirits on top of everything else that's trying to murder us.

text.title: 废灵者达库尔必须死！
text.objectives: 在纳格兰的鲜血竞技场与古尔戈索克交谈，并在特别表演赛中获胜。
text.description: 你听说过鲜血竞技场吗，指挥官？$B$B其实很简单。有个名叫穆戈尔的大个子食人魔喜欢看别人为了活命跟凶蛮的野兽搏杀。还有个名叫古尔戈索克的野心勃勃的地精，他负责安排比试，从中获利。$B$B不管怎么说，古尔戈索克跟我是老朋友了，他专门为你安排了一场特别的表演赛！听起来棒极了是吧？你只要在他耳边悄悄说一句：“我要挑战寻魔者”就可以了。
text.completion: Word is already spreading of your epic fight, commander. This may improve relations with the ogres in the future.

english.title: Death to Nullifier Darkoor!
english.objectives: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.
english.description: You ever heard of the Ring of Blood, commander?$B$BIt's pretty simple. Big ogre named Mogor loves watching people fight for their lives against savage beasts. Ambitious goblin called Gurgthock arranges the fights and rakes in the profits.$B$BAnwyays, Gurgthock and I are long time buddies and he's arranged a special exhibition match just for you! Pretty sweet, right? Just whisper into his ear "I seek the seeker."
english.completion: Word is already spreading of your epic fight, commander. This may improve relations with the ogres in the future.

text.title: 逆流必须死！
text.objectives: 在影月谷黯影沼泽北部的塔纳安海峡里消灭逆流。
text.description: 你好啊，指挥官！$B$B我这有坏消息。$B$B我们把一些间谍工作分包给了当地的渔夫——就是说我们给他们酬劳，而他们则负责驾船到黯影沼泽北部帮我们打探钢铁部落的活动。谁也不吃亏，对吧？$B$B可结果……却事与愿违。每艘船都有去无回。显然是那只巨大的水元素——我记得它叫逆流——把途经那片水域的所有不速之客全给消灭了。$B$B你有把握帮我们干掉它吗，指挥官？
text.completion: Thank you, commander. We hope the intel we gather from the Tanaan Channel will prove very useful in the coming months.

english.title: Death to Undertow!
english.objectives: Kill Undertow in the Tanaan Channel north of Umbrafen in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: Good day to ya, commander!$B$BI have bad news.$B$BWe've been contracting out some spy work to the local fisherman - we pay 'em some coin, they take their boats out north of Umbrafen and see what the Iron Horde's up to. Win-win, right?$B$BWell, it turns out... no. Every boat that goes out never comes back. Apparently this giant water elemental, Undertow I think it was, is murdering the snot out of everyone that passes through.$B$BAny chance you could clear it out for us, commander?
english.completion: Thank you, commander. We hope the intel we gather from the Tanaan Channel will prove very useful in the coming months.

text.title: 泰摩尔必须死！
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德高格里克之陨西部消灭泰摩尔，并取得一堆消化了一半的龙虾人肉。
text.description: 你在戈尔隆德的岗哨遇到了严重的刃牙虎人麻烦，指挥官，而且我们也确实没法不断地派出兵力前去增援。所以我想出了一个办法。$B$B在戈尔隆德的西海岸上有只巨大的蠕虫叫泰摩尔，是家喻户晓的龙虾人吞噬者。如果你能干掉那家伙，带一堆……消化了一半的龙虾人肉来，我们就能做出一道好菜，再运回那里去，用它安抚刃牙虎人，那能让它们消停好一阵子！
text.progress: Orders commander?$B$BAnd what is that awful smell?!
text.completion: Excellent. This meat ought to keep those pesky saberon busy.

english.title: Death to Tremor!
english.objectives: Kill Tremor west of Gorgorek's Fall in Gorgrond and obtain the Pile of Partially Digested Lobstrok Meat.
english.description: Your outpost in Gorgrond has a serious saberon problem, commander, and we can't really afford to keep sending more troops to help 'em out. So I have an idea.$B$BThere's an enormous worm beast on the west coast of Gorgrond called Tremor, better known as the devourer of lobstroks. If you took that thing down and brought the, well, pile of partially digested lobstrok meat back here, we can cook it here, ship it back there, use it to calm the saberon for a good long time!
english.progress: Orders commander?$B$BAnd what is that awful smell?!
english.completion: Excellent. This meat ought to keep those pesky saberon busy.

text.title: Death to Hivelord Ik'rix!
text.objectives: Retrieve the Iceshatter Carapace from Hivelord Ik'rix at Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
text.description: We've got a radical new idea to try using ice ravager carapaces in our tempering process for armor and weapons. It's the sort of trailblazing work we strive for, commander!$B$BOnly problem is, ravagers apparently aren't keen on our guys and gals taking their carapaces off of them. There's this particular ravager at the Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge called Hivelord Ik'rix - if you could take him down we wouldn't need more for weeks!
text.progress: Yes, commander?
text.completion: Thank you, commander. We will get to work on this right away!

english.title: Death to Hivelord Ik'rix!
english.objectives: Retrieve the Iceshatter Carapace from Hivelord Ik'rix at Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description: We've got a radical new idea to try using ice ravager carapaces in our tempering process for armor and weapons. There's this particular ravager at the Southwind Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge called Hivelord Ik'rix - if you could take him down we wouldn't need more for weeks!
english.progress: Yes, commander?
english.completion: Thank you, commander. We will get to work on this right away!

text.title: 奥金顿
text.objectives: 在奥金顿击败塔隆戈尔。
text.description: 指挥官，古尔丹最得力的密探塔隆戈尔已经渗透进了位于塔拉多的奥金顿，并妄图吞噬在陵墓中安息的万千亡魂。我们决不能让这个邪恶的术士汲取更多力量了。$B$B快进入神圣的奥金顿陵墓，在塔隆戈尔和暗影议会造成更多伤害前将其击溃。
text.completion: Another agent of Gul'dan be fallin' before your might, commander. Gul'dan will surely be tremblin' at the heels of our victory dis day.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Auchindoun
english.objectives: Defeat Teron'gor in Auchindoun.
english.description: Commander, Gul'dan's favored agent Teron'gor has infiltrated Auchindoun in Talador and has already taken to devouring the countless souls within. We must not let this nefarious warlock gain any further strength.$B$BEnter the holy mausoleum of Auchindoun and rout Teron'gor and the rest of the Shadow Council before more damage is done.
english.completion: Another Gul'dana messenger has fallen before your power, commander. Our victory today will make Gul'dan tremble with fear.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: Bloodmaul Slag Mines
text.objectives: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
text.description: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart of gems and ore, never to return.$B$BWe suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthing an ancient relic of immense power for their sorcerer-king.$B$BThe ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.
text.completion: Da Bloodmaul be finished, and with dem Imperator Mar'gok's chances of acquirin' da relic within da slag mines.$B$BDs be a good day, mon.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Bloodmaul Slag Mines
english.objectives: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
english.description: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart of gems and ore, never to return.$B$BWe suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthing an ancient relic of immense power for their sorcerer-king.$B$BThe ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.
english.completion: С Кровавым Молотом покончено, и шансы императора Мар'гока заполучить реликвию из шлаковых шахт теперь ничтожны.$b$bОтличный день.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 恐轨车站
text.objectives: 在恐轨车站击败啸天者托瓦拉。
text.description: 我们必须赶快行动，指挥官。就在我们说话的当口，恐轨号正准备开离恐轨车站，用铺天盖地的大军席卷沙塔斯呢。有传闻说，他们给列车装备了足以粉碎内城护盾的强大武器。$B$B啸天者托瓦拉负责确保恐轨号安全抵达塔拉多。你必须阻止托瓦拉，决不能让列车抵达沙塔斯！
text.completion: Derailing da Grimrail be a mighty blow to da Iron Horde. It will take dem a great deal of time to amass more troops thanks to you.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Grimrail Depot
english.objectives: Defeat Skylord Tovra in Grimrail Depot.
english.description: We must move quickly, commander. As we speak the Grimrail is preparing to depart Grimrail Depot to deliver a massive battalion of troops to Shattrath. Rumor has it that they have outfitted the train with a weapon strong enough to shatter the shield protecting the inner city.$B$BSkylord Tovra has taken to guarding the train on its journey to Talador. You must stop Tovra and the Grimrail before it reaches Shattrath!
english.completion: Derailing da Grimrail be a mighty blow to da Iron Horde. It will take dem a great deal of time to amass more troops thanks to you.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 钢铁码头
text.objectives: 在钢铁码头击败斯古洛克。
text.description: 钢铁码头是钢铁部落在这场战争中的战略要地之一。据斥候回报，码头上现在正加班加点，表明攻击已经迫在眉睫。$B$B有人看见格鲁尔之子斯古洛克已离开黑石铸造厂，配备着全副重型火炮，被送上了他们最强力的战舰。不管他们想要攻打哪里，指挥官——你要做的就是洗劫钢铁码头，赶在他们出发前击败斯古洛克。
text.completion: Without Skulloc and their precious docks, da Iron Horde be a wolf pack trapped within their own cave... unable to hunt.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Iron Docks
english.objectives: Defeat Skulloc in the Iron Docks.
english.description: The Iron Docks is one of the Iron Horde's greatest assets in this war. Our scouts have reported that the docks are alight with activity, indicating imminent attack.$B$BSkulloc, son of Gruul, was seen leaving the Blackrock Foundry, armed to the teeth with powerful cannons, and has been loaded onto their mightiest warship. It does not matter where they intend to strike, commander - you must sack the Iron Docks and defeat Skulloc before they ever leave.
english.completion: Without Skulloc and their precious docks, da Iron Horde be a wolf pack trapped within their own cave... unable to hunt.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 影月墓地
text.objectives: 在影月墓地中击败耐奥祖。
text.description: 耐奥祖原是一位高贵的兽人——他本来是影月氏族睿智的酋长和萨满长者。因为急于加入钢铁部落，他抛弃了长久以来的所有信念，扭曲先祖的灵魂以换取黑暗的禁忌之力……只为取悦地狱咆哮。$B$B影月氏族已经堕落了，指挥官。进入他们先祖的墓地，终结耐奥祖的疯狂行径，别让他把整个德拉诺全都送进吞噬一切的虚空巨口里。
text.completion: I already be feelin' da relief of da ancestral spirits of Draenor with Ner'zhul's fall. You have deprived Grommash of a powerful weapon, commander.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds
english.objectives: Defeat Ner'zhul in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
english.description: Ner'zhul was once a noble orc - he was the wise chieftain and elder shaman of the Shadowmoon clan. In his desperate bid to join the Iron Horde he has spat on all he once stood for and twisted his ancestors' spirits to tap into dark, forbidden power... all to please Hellscream.$B$BThe Shadowmoon has fallen, commander. Enter their ancestral burial grounds and put an end to Ner'zhul's madness before he pulls all of Draenor into the engulfing maw of the void.
english.completion: I already be feelin' da relief of da ancestral spirits of Draenor with Ner'zhul's fall. You have deprived Grommash of a powerful weapon, commander.
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: Skyreach
text.objectives: Defeat High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
text.description: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastating crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.$B$BThe arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison, commander.
text.completion: Perhaps now da Adherents of Rukhmar will respect we 'lesser races'.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.title: Skyreach
english.objectives: Defeat High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
english.description: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastating crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.$B$BThe arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison, commander.
english.completion: Perhaps the Ruhmar followers will now be more respectful of the "inferior races".
english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: The Everbloom
text.objectives: Defeat Yalnu in the Everbloom.
text.description: The Kirin Tor created an outpost in Gorgrond with a portal to Stormwind to facilitate quick reinforcements in the assault on the Blackrock Foundry. In their infinite wisdom they built it in the heart of the Everbloom, home to the botani and the mightiest of the genesaur - Yalnu.$B$BThe outpost has already been overrun and it is only a matter of time before the overgrowth spreads to Stormwind... and with it the whole of Azeroth.
text.completion: Dese wizards' deaths be punishment enough for their lack of foresight. We should be thankful dat we were able to stop da overgrowth before it reached our world.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
text.objectives: Defeat Warlord Zaela in Upper Blackrock Spire.
text.description: Hellscream's Ironmarch vanguard managed to reach Blackrock Mountain and has allied with Warlord Zaela of the Dragonmaw clan. Even now the Iron Horde readies to invade Azeroth while Zaela prepares a doomsday weapon in the heart of the mountain to ensure nothing stands in their way.$B$BYou must put a stop to Zaela once and for all, commander. She has been a thorn in our side for too long.
text.completion: With Warlord Zaela's fall we can be focusin' our efforts on Draenor and da heart of da Iron Horde. They have nowhere to hide now.
text.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

english.completed: Return to High Overlord Saurfang in your garrison.

text.title: 寻宝合同：古特里克的杀生刀
text.objectives: 在破碎悬崖的食人魔当中寻找金铲发现的线索。
text.description:
在纳格兰的食人魔口中，流传着一把名叫古特里克的杀生刀的古老武器。我很想研究研究它。

有个地精财宝猎人叫瓦尔·金铲，他发现了那把武器的下落。可惜这个地精却在破碎悬崖失踪了——据说他在失踪前和当地人起了争执。

english.title: Treasure Contract: Gutrek's Cleaver
english.objectives: Search the ogres in the Broken Precipice for clues regarding Goldspade's discovery.
english.description:
In Nagrand, the ogres tell of an ancient weapon called Gutrek's cleaver. I would very much like to study it.

A goblin treasure hunter by the name of Val Goldspade discovered the whereabouts of the weapon. Unfortunately, this goblin has gone missing somewhere in the Broken Precipice - probably after a run-in with the locals.

text.title: 黑石塔上层
text.objectives: 在黑石塔上层击败督军扎伊拉。
text.description: 地狱咆哮的铁军先锋部队设法抵达了黑石山，并与龙喉氏族的督军扎伊拉结盟了。眼下，钢铁部落正在准备入侵艾泽拉斯，而扎伊拉则在黑石山的腹地组装一架灭世武器，要将所有挡路者尽数消灭。$B$B你必须彻底粉碎扎伊拉的阴谋，指挥官。她已经威胁我们太久了。
text.completion: With Warlord Zaela out of the picture we can focus our efforts on Draenor and the heart of the Iron Horde. They have nowhere to hide now.
text.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Upper Blackrock Spire
english.objectives: Defeat Warlord Zaela in Upper Blackrock Spire.
english.description: Hellscream's Ironmarch vanguard managed to reach Blackrock Mountain and has allied with Warlord Zaela o' the Dragonmaw clan. Even now the Iron Horde readies to invade Azeroth while Zaela prepares a doomsday weapon in the heart o' the mountain to ensure nothing stands in their way.$B$BYou must put a stop to Zaela once and for all, commander. She's been a thorn in our side for too long.
english.completion: With Warlord Zaela out of the picture we can focus our efforts on Draenor and the heart of the Iron Horde. They have nowhere to hide now.
english.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

text.title: The Everbloom
text.objectives: Defeat Yalnu in the Everbloom.
text.description: The Kirin Tor created an outpost in Gorgrond with a portal to Stormwind to facilitate quick reinforcements in the assault on the Blackrock Foundry. Unfortunately they built it in the heart o' the Everbloom, home to the botani and the mightiest o' the genesaur - Yalnu.$B$BThe outpost has already been overrun and it is only a matter o' time before the overgrowth spreads to Stormwind... and with it the whole of Azeroth.
text.completion: I wish we could have saved the mages' lives, but sadly it was not to be. We should be thankful that we were able to stop the overgrowth before it reached our world.
text.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

text.title: 通天峰
text.objectives: 击败通天峰的高阶贤者维里克斯。
text.description: 高阶贤者维里克斯在阿兰卡峰林的通天峰之巅制造出了一件毁灭性的水晶超级武器。她正打算以鸦人的太阳神鲁克玛之名，肃清所谓的“低等种群”。$B$B这件武器曾在几秒内差点灭绝那些鸦人流亡者。你必须阻止维里克斯，否则她下一个目标就会是你的要塞了。
text.completion: Perhaps now the Adherents of Rukhmar will respect we 'lesser races'.
text.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

english.title: Skyreach
english.objectives: Defeat High Sage Viryx in Skyreach.
english.description: High Sage Viryx has finished a devastatin' crystal superweapon atop the highest point in Skyreach in Spires of Arak. She intends to eradicate the 'lesser races' in the name of their god Rukhmar.$B$BThe arakkoa outcasts were nearly wiped out in mere seconds by the weapon. You must stop Viryx before she turns her sights to your garrison!
english.completion: Perhaps now the Adherents of Rukhmar will respect we 'lesser races'.
english.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

text.title: Shadowmoon Burial Grounds
text.objectives: Defeat Ner'zhul in the Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
text.description: Ner'zhul wasn't always evil - once he was the wise chieftain and elder shaman o' the Shadowmoon clan. In his desperate bid to join the Iron Horde he's forsaken all he once stood for and twisted his ancestors' spirits to tap into dark, forbidden power... all to please Hellscream.$B$BEnter their ancestral burial grounds and put an end to Ner'zhul's madness before he pulls all o' Draenor into the engulfing maw o' the void.
text.completion: I'm no shaman, far from it, but even I can feel the relief of the ancestral spirits of Draenor with Ner'zhul's fall. You have deprived Grommash of a powerful weapon, commander.
text.completed: Return to Muradin Bronzebeard in your garrison.

english.objectives: Defeat Gug'rokk in the Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
english.description: The Bloodmaul ogres are brutal slavers, commander. Innocents from across Draenor are dragged deep into the volcanic slag mines in Frostfire Ridge to dredge up cart after cart o' gems and ore, never to return.$B$BWe suspect that they have turned their focus to unearthin' an ancient relic o' immense power for their sorcerer-king.$B$BThe ogre Gug'rokk rules over the slag mines with an iron fist. Take him down and the mines will fall as well.
english.completion: The Bloodmaul are finished, and with them Imperator Mar'gok's chances of acquiring the relic within the slag mines.$B$BThis is as fine a day as I've seen in some time.

text.description: Foreman Grobash in da Talador outpost figures he knows why der's been so much seismic activity recently.$B$BDer be an earth fury called Amethon that be covered in powerful crystals in a cave up above Kuuro's Claim. Da crystals' hummin' be drivin' da fury crazy!$B$BWe want a sample to see if we can figure out why da crystals are so powerful. I wouldn't be askin' ya if I thought anybody else could do it, commander.
text.progress: What be makin' that infernal racket? Is that the crystal from Amethon you be holdin'?
text.completion: You always be savin' da day, commander. Thank you.

You should deal with da shaman personally before dis matter gets out of hand.

text.title: 逆流必须死！
text.objectives: 在影月谷黯影沼泽北部的塔纳安海峡里消灭逆流。
text.description: 我们遇到麻烦了，指挥官。$B$B我们派出了几艘小船前往影月谷黯影沼泽北部的塔纳安海峡，侦察那里的联盟基地和钢铁部落在塔纳安丛林中的行动。$B$B问题是我们派出的每艘船在回来时都散了架，甚至连回不回得来都不一定。罪魁祸首应该是个名叫逆流的水元素。$B$B我知道你很忙，可如果能除掉那怪物，真是帮了我们大忙了。
text.completion: A thousand thank yous, commander. Dis spyin' should prove valuable in da comin' months.

english.title: Death to Undertow!
english.objectives: Kill Undertow in the Tanaan Channel north of Umbrafen in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description: We be havin' a problem, commander.$B$BWe been sendin' some small boats into the Tanaan Channel north of da Umbrafen in Shadowmoon ta spy on da Alliance base der as well as da Iron Horde in Tanaan Jungle.$B$BDa problem is dat every boat we send out come back in pieces, if it come back at all. We think a water elemental called Undertow is da culprit.$B$BI know you be busy, but destroyin' that creature would be very helpful to our efforts.
english.completion: A thousand thank yous, commander. Dis spyin' should prove valuable in da comin' months.

text.title: 泰摩尔必须死！
text.objectives: 在戈尔隆德高格里克之陨西部消灭泰摩尔，并取得一堆消化了一半的龙虾人肉。
text.description: 戈尔隆德的岗哨遇到了刃牙虎人的麻烦，而且我们也确实无法继续派出兵力前去增援。别担心，我有办法。$B$B在戈尔隆德的西海岸上有只巨大的虫兽叫泰摩尔，是家喻户晓的龙虾人吞噬者。如果你能干掉那家伙，把一堆龙虾人肉带到这儿来，我们就能做出一道好菜，再运回哨站，用它安抚刃牙虎人，那能让它们消停好一阵子！
text.progress: Ey, commander.$B$BWhat be that awful smell?
text.completion: Dis be exactly what we need, commander. I'll send it to da chefs right away.

english.title: Death to Tremor!
english.objectives: Kill Tremor west of Gorgorek's Fall in Gorgrond and obtain the Pile of Partially Digested Lobstrok Meat.
english.description: Da Gorgrond outpost be havin' troubles with saberon, and we can't afford ta throw troops at the problem any longer. Don't worry, I be havin' an idea.$B$BThere be an enormous worm beast on the west coast of Gorgrond called Tremor, da devourer of lobstroks. If you killed da beast and brought da pile of lobstrok meat back here, we can cook it 'ere, send it to da outpost, and use it to calm da saberon for good!
english.progress: Ey, commander.$B$BWhat be that awful smell?
english.completion: Dis be exactly what we need, commander. I'll send it to da chefs right away.

text.description: We been tryin' out a new way to temper weapons with ice ravager carapaces. Der icy hides are perfect for da process.$B$BHivelord Ik'rix in da Southwind Cliffs nearby is rumored to be da largest ravager we ever seen - if you could bring its carapace back, we'd be able to make all sorts of things!
text.progress: Ey, boss-mon. What can I do for you today?
text.completion: Excellent. Dis be exactly what we lookin' for!

text.title: 欢迎参加暗月竞速赛
text.objectives: 跑过暗月竞速赛起点，到达蓝色柱标，然后返回暗月竞速赛起点。
text.description:
看来这是你参加的首场竞速赛，是吧？别紧张——规则并没有看上去那么复杂。让我给你讲讲……

跑过那边那面大旗子，比赛就正式开始了。然后跟着沿途的小旗子跑，直到你看见一个大大的蓝色柱标。触碰它，再返回到这里来。

你的得分取决于所耗时间的长短，所以全速前进吧！另外还要小心那些带电绊网。要是碰到它们，你的速度就会变慢。祝你好运！
text.completion: You made it! This is just a practice race so your time doesn't matter... other than bragging rights.$B$BTime to try the real race!

english.title: Welcome to the Darkmoon Races
english.objectives: Run through the Darkmoon Races Start Banner, hit the Blue Post, then return to the Darkmoon Races Start Banner.
english.description:
So this is your first race, eh? Don't worry - it's easier than it looks. Let me break it down for you...

Run through that big  banner there. That starts everything. Then, follow the smaller banners until you see a big, blue Post. Hit that, then return here.

You're scored on your time, so finish as fast as you can! And watch out for those electrified tripwires. They'll slow you down if you run through them. Good luck!
english.completion: У тебя получилось! Это были тренировочные гонки, так что время не имеет значения. Но похвалу ты $gзаслужил:заслужила;!$b$bТеперь можно перейти к Крутым гонкам!

text.title: Orb of Dominion
text.objectives: Retrieve an Orb of Dominion from the Den of Secrets in Shadowmoon Valley.
text.description: Gul'dan and his Shadow Council have their hooks embedded deep into Garona's soul. We've tried traditional magical methods and they haven't helped her. It's time to get unorthodox.$b$b<Khadgar cracks his knuckles, his eyes flashing with a disturbing eagerness.>$b$bI've just learned of a Shadow Council holdout hidden beneath the Draenei city of Elodor. They are using an Orb of Dominion to brainwash spies. Quickly! Assault the cave and recover the orb for me. We will turn this dark magic to our advantage.
text.progress: <Khadgar's fingers glow in anticipation.>$B$BThe orb! Did you find it?
text.completion: Hand it here - gently now - ah, do you feel it? Makes my skin crawl. It's watching us, $n.$B$BI have invited the Shadow Council into my house. Let's get this over with before this thing can cause any mischief.
text.completed: Return the orb to Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.description: The Shadow Council are more entrenched than you expected. A large contingent seems focused on infiltrating the draenei Exarch Council in the town above.$b$bKhadgar certainly wouldn't complain if you did a little... "housecleaning."
text.completion: Well done, $n! I find it troubling that the Shadow Council is so entrenched in these hidden regions of Draenor. Gul'dan has kept himself busy.

text.title: Breaking Badness
text.objectives: Speak with Khadgar and assist him as he frees Garona from Gul'dan's mind control.
text.description: It is time to liberate Garona. I know what to do... I think. I'd like you to stay close in case anything goes wrong.$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready to begin.
text.completion: Garona remains shaken, but she is with us now. She is eager to plot revenge against her former master!$B$BI shall consider forgiving her for stabbing me.
text.completed: Speak with Archmage Khadgar at Khadgar's Tower in Zangarra.

text.title: An Inside Job
text.objectives: Infiltrate Bladefury's Command with Garona's help. Use her talents to eliminate guards without being seen. Locate Iron Horde intelligence and then spy on Gul'dan.
text.description: If Garona's intelligence is correct, Gul'dan will be inside this Iron Horde compound. With Garona's help, slip inside, gather any info you find, and learn what Gul'dan intends to do.$b$bThe guards are on high alert. Garona can "liquidate" individual guards for you, but she must not be seen! You will have to choose your targets carefully and pick your way through the bastion undetected. Don't let anyone sound the alarm.$b$bIf things get too hot, I'll teleport you to safety. At least... I'll try.
text.completion: Well done, both of you!$B$BGul'dan is even more slippery than I imagined. He's been building up his power base behind the scenes, and now that we've weakened his foes, he's moved in to take control of what remains of the Iron Horde.$B$BWe need to plan our next move.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Khadgar outside Bladefury's Command north of Talador.

text.title: Light Be With You
text.objectives: Meet Yrel at the Coliseum of Light near the Temple of Karabor.
text.description: You've done everything I've asked, $n. I believe we can apply one final enchantment to your ring. But... we must be cautious. Last time I augmented your ring I killed you. (Sorry.) It will take a divine act to empower you further.$b$bFortunately, you've made some powerful allies during your time here. Travel to the Temple of Karabor, where Yrel is waiting for you. With the blessing of a Naaru your ring will become as powerful and unique as - well, as you yourself. Go to Karabor. You've earned it.
text.completion: You have earned this, $C. You've traveled the length and breadth of my world. You've surmounted unimaginable odds and stood toe-to-toe against ancient beasts, dark magics, and terrifying machines. Time and again you've inspired my people with your patience and bravery.$B$BThank you, $n.

text.title: 德拉诺的祝福
text.objectives: 在纳格兰的元素王座与德雷克塔尔交谈。
text.description: 你做到了我所要求的一切，$n。我相信我们已经可以将你的戒指强化至最终阶段了。但……我们必须小心行事。上一次强化时，我就害死过你。（真抱歉。）为了让你变得更强，我们需要远古魔法的帮助。$b$b幸运的是，在这段时间里，你也结交了一些强大的盟友。到纳格兰的元素王座去找先知德雷克塔尔吧。你可以在那里接受元素的祝福，安全地解开戒指的最终形态。去吧，英雄！获取你应得的奖励！
text.completion: You have earned this, $C. You've traveled the length and breadth of this savage world. You've surmounted unimaginable odds and stood toe-to-toe against ancient beasts, dark magics, and terrifying machines. Time and again you've surprised me with your patience and bravery.$B$BThank you, $n. I am proud to call you my friend.

english.description: You've done everything I've asked, $n. I believe we can apply one final enchantment to your ring. But... we must be cautious. Last time I augmented your ring I killed you. (Sorry.) It will take an act of ancient magic to empower you further.$b$bFortunately, you've made some powerful allies during your time here. Seek out Farseer Drek'Thar at the Throne of Elements in Nagrand. There you can receive the blessing of the elements and safely unlock your ring's final form. Go, hero! Claim your reward!
english.completion: You have earned this, $C. You've traveled the length and breadth of this savage world. You've surmounted unimaginable odds and stood toe-to-toe against ancient beasts, dark magics, and terrifying machines. Time and again you've surprised me with your patience and bravery.$B$BThank you, $n. I am proud to call you my friend.

text.title: The Final Assault
text.objectives: Speak with your faction leader in your garrison and complete the quests to build a shipyard. Khadgar will meet you there when it's built.
text.description: Our campaign in Draenor has taken an unexpected turn. With Gul'dan assuming power over the Iron Horde, history is poised to repeat itself - our world is in more peril than ever.$b$bIt's time to bring the full might of your garrison to bear against Tanaan Jungle. Build a shipyard for your garrison! I will meet you at your new shipyard and we will discuss our next move from there.

text.title: Treasure Contract: Amulet of Rukhmar
text.objectives: Search the ruins of upper Skettis for the Arakkoa research involving the Amulet of Rukhmar.
text.description:
It seems the Adherents of Rukhmar have stumbled upon some information leading to an ancient amulet, said to possess the power of their god and bestow it upon the wearer. We should make sure they don't find it.

Head to Skettis and find what they have learned. Hopefully we can find it before they get to it.

text.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The First Key
text.objectives: Find and activate the first key to the Apexis device.
text.description:
The Arakkoa research points to three "keys" that need to be activated in order to use the Apexis device. The first is located in Skettis. The text mentioning it reads:

"The first key is kept in the high reaches of upper Skettis. It lay where the dead can protect it from the talons of the unwanted."

text.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Second Key
text.objectives: Find and activate the second key to the Apexis device.
text.description:
The first point has been activated and two more remain. The second location is hinted at in the old outcast writing:

"Beneath the third fall of the great Skettis river lay the second key. May the ever-rushing waters sweep away those that might seek it."

text.objectives: Find and activate the final key to the Apexis device.
text.description:
One last key is required to access the Apexis device. The writings pertaining to its location read:

"The final key has been housed deep within the fungal caves where the river makes its final drop. Though the pale orcs that dwell there may be vile, they should prove a worthy deterrent."

text.title: Amulet of Rukhmar: The Apexis Device
text.objectives: Activate the Apexis device and claim the Amulet of Rukhmar.
text.description:
Now that the keys have been activated, the Apexis device that leads to the amulet should be accessible. 

The Arakkoa research states that it is likely located in Lost Veil Anzu, within the "shrine to the raven god."
text.progress: Were you able to take the amulet from the arakkoa?
text.completion: I'm glad to see this out of the claws of the Adherents of Rukhmar. $B$BI'll get this to Dr. Jones right away.

text.title: 古龙之陨
text.objectives: 消灭魔虫以取得$1oa个开裂的魔虫核心，然后放进塞纳苟斯的法力池。
text.description: 我会尽可能稳住他的情况，不过我需要你的帮助。$b$b他仅存的少许能量来自他栖息的法力池。$b$b跟着雏龙。把魔网水晶放进池里，为他补充一点能量，帮他再撑一阵子。$b$b他们似乎会从北边的洞穴里获取水晶。
text.progress: Может, конечно, это звучит глупо... Но я всегда верила, что дедушка будет с нами до конца времен.
text.completion: Thank you. Your efforts dull his pain.$b$b<She sighs.>

english.title: The Death of the Eldest
english.objectives: Slay Leyworms to obtain $1oa Crackling Leyworm Cores, then drop them into Senegos's pool.
english.description: I will do what I can to stabilize him, but I will need your help.$b$bThe small amount of energy he has left is coming from the mana pool he rests in.$b$bFollow the whelplings' lead. Dropping ley crystals into the pool gives him a bit of energy - buying him a few more breaths.$b$bThey seem to be getting the crystals from inside that cave to the north.
english.progress: Может, конечно, это звучит глупо... Но я всегда верила, что дедушка будет с нами до конца времен.
english.completion: Thank you. Your efforts dull his pain.$b$b<She sighs.>

objectiveDetails.description: 往塞纳苟斯的法力池投入水晶

text.title: 最后的雏龙
text.objectives: 调查蓝翼繁育地。
text.description: 我们需要帮助。$b$b自从死亡之翼陨落之后，龙族几乎失去了所有力量。更糟糕的是，我们再也无法产下龙蛋。$b$b我的孩子已经是仅存的最后一批雏龙。$b$b我需要你，勇士。帮我守护繁育地，我向你保证，在你需要的时候蓝龙一定会鼎力相助。
text.completion: Don't you worry, small one. I am still back in Azurewing Repose, resting in my pool.$b$bIt doesn't take much energy to throw a projection of myself here and there. I may be old and dying, but I AM still a blue dragon.

english.title: The Last of the Last
english.objectives: Investigate the Azurewing Whelplands.
english.description: We need help.$b$bSince the fall of Deathwing, we dragons have lost nearly all of our power. To make matters worse, we can no longer bear eggs.$b$bMy whelplings are the last of the last.$b$bI need you, champion. Help defend my whelplands, and I swear to you, the blues will be at your side when you need them.
english.completion: Don't you worry, small one. I am still back in Azurewing Repose, resting in my pool.$b$bIt doesn't take much energy to throw a projection of myself here and there. I may be old and dying, but I AM still a blue dragon.

text.title: 枯法者
text.objectives: 在蓝翼繁育地消灭$1oa个枯法者。
text.description: 枯法者是最可恶的。他们抓走我们的雏龙，把这些无助的龙宝宝打晕然后吸干他们的法力。$b$b平时我们的幼龙和守护者会防着这些家伙，但是今天我们恐怕需要你的帮助了。
text.completion: Twelve withered slain? Very good.$b$bThat should be enough to keep them away for a few months.

english.title: The Withered
english.objectives: Slay $1oa withered in the Azurewing Whelplands.
english.description: The withered are the worst kind of pest. They capture our whelplings, knock them unconscious, and then drink whatever mana they can from the helpless babes.$b$bNormally our drakes and keepers would fend them off. Today, it looks like we may need your help.
english.completion: Twelve withered slain? Very good.$b$bThat should be enough to keep them away for a few months.

text.title: 鲁纳斯认识路
text.objectives: 让鲁纳斯护送你。
text.description: 无论我之前做了什么让你恨不得杀了我，我都希望可以弥补。$b$b唔……你那头巨龙说他越来越虚弱，我知道是什么原因。鲁纳斯可以解决这个问题，我的朋友。$b$b我的族人艾尔伊斯正在从阿苏纳的大地中汲取魔网能量。我可以带你去他汲取法力的地方。$b$b要弥补别人造成的伤害，现在还不算晚。相信我，没错的。
text.progress: Я все равно ему не доверяю.
text.completion: They're tapping into the ley lines?

english.title: Runas Knows the Way
english.objectives: Allow Runas to escort you.
english.description: I wish to make it up to you for whatever I did that made you want to kill me.$b$bHmm... your dragon complains about being weak. I know why. Runas can fix it, my friend.$b$bOne of my kind, Ael'Yith, pulls ley energy from the very ground of Azsuna. I can take you to the location of his mana siphons.$b$bIt's not too late to undo the harm the others have done. You've done well to trust me.
english.progress: Я все равно ему не доверяю.
english.completion: They're tapping into the ley lines?

text.title: 丝黛拉苟萨
text.objectives: 寻找丝黛拉苟萨。
text.description: 事情不对劲，$n。$b$b我派了丝黛拉苟萨去协助你，但是我已经感应不到她了。$b$b拜托，请你去寻找我孙女的下落。
text.completion: ...so many of them...

english.title: Stellagosa
english.objectives: Find Stellagosa.
english.description: Something is wrong, $n.$b$bI sent Stellagosa to assist you, but I can no longer sense her.$b$bPlease, go out there and find out what's happened to my granddaughter.
english.completion: ...so many of them...

text.title: 精疲力尽
text.objectives: 找到一个黯淡的魔网水晶，然后用它使$2oa条法力枯竭的雏龙复苏。
text.description: <这头雏龙还活着，但是仍然昏迷不醒。它肯定被某个枯法者吸干了法力。>$b$b<你已经知道暴露的魔网水晶里蕴含着少许魔法能量。也许你可以用它来救醒一些雏龙。>
text.progress: Clever $R. Yes, a ley crystal should bring them back to their senses.
text.completion: I owe you a great debt, $n.$b$bHelping a weakened old dragon like me is valorous enough. Saving my whelplings, and securing the future of our bloodline?$b$bI am now firmly committed to your cause.

english.title: The Consumed
english.objectives: Find a Dim Ley Crystal, then revive $2oa Mana-Drained Whelplings.
english.description: <The whelpling is alive, but unconscious. One of the withered must have already drained it of mana.>$b$b<You've already learned that exposed ley crystals contain a small amount of magical energy. Perhaps you can use one to revive some of the whelps.>
english.progress: Умно, |3-6($r). Да, силовой кристалл поможет им прийти в чувство.
english.completion: I owe you a great debt, $n.$b$bHelping a weakened old dragon like me is valorous enough. Saving my whelplings, and securing the future of our bloodline?$b$bI am now firmly committed to your cause.

objectiveDetails.description: 使法力枯竭的雏龙复苏

text.title: 互帮互助
text.objectives: 派雏龙摧毁扎赫纳尔的所有法力收集器晶塔。
text.description: 这下就好多了。我就知道你靠得住，朋友。请让我好好报答你吧。$b$b我知道怎么才能摧毁大型法力收集晶塔。我们要把你的龙救出来！$b$b晶塔只对地面目标有效，但是它们防不住空袭。让你的雏龙去对付它们吧，朋友。雏龙可以飞到我们到达不了的地方。$b$b相信我，没错的。
text.completion: With the pylons destroyed, Senegos' pool should now be re-energized.

english.title: You Scratch My Back...
english.objectives: Release the whelplings on each of the Mana Collector Pylons in Zarkhenar.
english.description: Much better. I knew I could count on you, my friend. Allow me to return the favor.$b$bI know how you can destroy the large mana collector pylons. We shall save your dragon yet!$b$bThe pylons only work against ground targets, yet they're defenseless from above. Send your whelplings at them, my friend. The whelplings can fly where we cannot.$b$bTrust me.
english.completion: With the pylons destroyed, Senegos' pool should now be re-energized.

text.title: 夜之子王子
text.objectives: 消灭艾尔伊斯。
text.description: <塞纳苟斯屏气凝神。>$b$b这下我感觉到了。就在东边的建筑废墟里。他们中的某个笨蛋肯定是被困在了魔网深处。$b$b我怀疑他身边肯定有重兵把守，$n。我的子嗣的命运又一次掌握在了你的手中。
text.completion: He may not be slain, but at least he is gone.$b$bWithout their leader, the mindless withered should soon scatter and die.
text.giverWindow: 他一直从废墟上方对你进行骚扰。也许是时候去会会他了……

english.title: The Nightborne Prince
english.objectives: Slay Ael'Yith.
english.description: <Senegos is focused.>$b$bI sense it now. In the ruined building, to the east. One of these cretins must have tapped deep into the ley line.$b$bI suspect he will be heavily defended, $n. Once again, the well-being of my brood is in your hands.
english.completion: He may not be slain, but at least he is gone.$b$bWithout their leader, the mindless withered should soon scatter and die.
english.giverWindow: He's been pestering you from atop his ruins. Maybe it's time to pay him a visit...

text.title: 生命延续
text.objectives: 与丝黛拉苟萨交谈以飞回蓝翼栖地。
text.description: 等等，他说什么？他在说……“以巨龙为食”？$b$b我们必须去看看祖父的情况，立刻动身！$b$b你准备好出发了就告诉我。
text.completion: No... we're too late!

english.title: Still Alive
english.objectives: Speak with Stellagosa to take a ride back to Azurewing Repose.
english.description: Wait, what was it that I heard? Was it... "feast on the dragons"? We must check on grandfather, right away!$b$bLet me know when you're ready to depart.
english.completion: No... we're too late!

text.title: More Big Racing!
text.objectives: Run through the Start Banner, hit the Purple Post, then the Green Post, then the Red Post, then the  return to the Start Banner.
text.description:
You like this big race, do you? Me too!

It has four legs: get to the purple post, then green, then red, then back here.

Your time matters, so do it fast!
text.completion: Good job, and nice time!

text.title: 寻宝合同：爆炸物大发现
text.objectives: 在黑潮栖木击败爆破专家麦加奇，并夺取他的爆炸物配方手册。
text.description:
在影月谷的某个洞穴里据说有一本古老的典籍，里面的秘密能帮我们对抗钢铁部落。但那座洞穴却被由奥术能量筑成的古老屏障保护着。

在黑潮栖木有个地精，他好像知道怎么消除那道屏障。去劝他把秘密说给你听，然后把那本书带回来吧。

english.title: Treasure Contract: Explosive Discoveries
english.objectives: Defeat Demolitionist Megacharge in Darktide Roost and take his explosives cookbook.
english.description:
In Shadowmoon Valley there is a cave said to possess an ancient tome that may contain secrets that can help our cause against the Iron Horde. The cave, however, is protected by an ancient barrier composed of arcane energy.

There is a goblin in Darktide Roost, said to know how to take down any barrier. Persuade him to give up his secrets and bring back the book.

text.title: Dark Grimoire: The First Ingredient
text.objectives: Follow the clue from Megacharge's Cookbook to locate some precision blasting powder.
text.description:
You will need three ingredients to make Megacharge's special "Arcane Bunker Buster," which should be able to take down the barrier. The first ingredient, some precision blasting powder, should be available nearby. The book reads:

"To make one, you'll first need to acquire some high grade, precision blasting powder. Here in Blackfuse Company, it's pretty easy to come by, since they use it for all of the cannons."

text.title: Dark Grimoire: The Second Ingredient
text.objectives: Follow the clue from Megacharge's Cookbook to find the high voltage detonator.
text.description:
With the blasting powder acquired, you now must find a suitable detonator. A note attached to the entry in the cookbook hints to where one might be found:

"Reminder: Order more high-voltage detonators. The last shipment was lost off of the Shadowmoon coast near the demon-inhabited cliffs. Maybe we should send a diving team to salvage."

text.objectives: Collect blood from demons in Socrethar's Rise.
text.description:
The final ingredient to create Megacharge's bomb is a sizable quantity of demon's blood. 

Unfortunately, that's not something they're likely to give up easily...

text.objectives: Destroy the ancient barrier below Socrethar's Rise and claim the Grimoire of the Nameless Void.
text.description:
The components have been gathered and the "Arcane Bunker Buster" is assembled. Hopefully, this should pack enough punch to take out the barrier.

There's only one way to find out...
text.progress: Dr. Jones asked me to take this book from you, but I'm not sure I want to touch it.

text.title: 进攻塔纳安
text.objectives: 与卡德加会面，然后同德拉卡谈话，开始进军。
text.description: 工作完成！按照你的命令我们已经建好了第一艘舰船，现在已经可以从这里发动海上攻势了。$b$b既然已经有了运输手段，也就该让杜隆坦和你的那位大法师知道，我们已经准备好向塔纳安发动攻击了。到码头上和他们谈谈，然后开始登船吧。
text.completion: The landing was easier than I expected, but there is trouble ahead.

english.title: The Invasion of Tanaan
english.objectives: Meet with Khadgar and then speak to Draka to start the invasion.
english.description: It is done! By your command we have built our first ship and can run our naval operations from here.$b$bNow that we have our transport, we can let Durotan and that Archmage of yours know that we are ready to kick off an invasion of Tanaan. Speak with them at the docks to embark.
english.completion: The landing went smoothly, but there's trouble ahead of us.

text.title: 妨碍进程
text.objectives: 收集这个地区部队部署的情报，并与斥候会合。
text.description: 这些港口居然被钢铁部落遗弃了，真是个奇怪的现象，不过我们的斥候报告说前方还有一些麻烦。$b$b一批血环氏族的拾荒者正忙着在西北方那些废弃的建筑中大肆掠夺。$b$b前面还有一些兽人邪教徒正在黑暗之门附近……搞一些……古怪的事情。$b$b我们应该尽可能收集命令书或者别的什么情报来搞清楚这里的状况，然后去更远处和我们的斥候汇合……
text.completion: It be good ta hear da road is safer, but here be another problem.

english.title: Obstacle Course
english.objectives: Find any information on the forces deployed in the area and meet with the scouts afterwards.
english.description: It is strange that these docks were abandoned by the Iron Horde, but up ahead our scouts report trouble.$b$bA set of Bleeding Hollow scavengers is busy looting the abandoned buildings to the northwest.$b$bFurther down the road orc cultists are doing... something... near the Dark Portal.$b$bWe should try to recover any orders or information as to what is going on here, then meet with our scouts further in...
english.completion: Что дорога свободна – это хорошо, но есть другая проблема.

objectiveDetails.description: 从血环氏族成员那找到情报
在邪教徒那里获得情报

text.title: 突袭铁城港
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林铁城港的钢铁部落援军。
text.description:
钢铁部落仍在从德拉诺各地调派援军以增援地狱火堡垒的防御力量。假如无法切断他们的补给线，我们在塔纳安的计划就会失去控制。

对铁城港的补给线进行一次战略打击应能使钢铁部落疲于防守，让我们能够维持住目前的成果。
text.completion: Welcome back, commander. Our scouts just returned with word of your success.$B$BWell done!

english.title: Assault on Ironhold Harbor
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.
english.completion: С возвращением, командир. Как раз только что вернулись наши разведчики с рапортом об успехе операции.$B$BОтличная работа!

text.title: 正式竞速赛
text.objectives: 跑过起点，先后抵达蓝色柱标、绿色柱标和红色柱标，最后返回起点。
text.description:
来吧，暗月竞速赛的参赛者，让我们瞧瞧你的本事！

正式竞速赛分为四个赛段——先后分别抵达蓝色柱标、绿色柱标、红色柱标，最后再回到这里。

时间决定着胜负，所以全速前进吧！
text.completion: Good job, and nice time!

english.title: The Real Race
english.objectives: Run through the Start Banner, hit the Blue Post, then the Green Post, then the Red Post, then return to the Start Banner.
english.description:
Ok, Darkmoon Racer, let's see what you got!

The real race has four legs: get to the blue post, then green, then red, then back here. 

Your time matters, so do it fast!

铁人拉力赛来咯！祝你好运！

比赛分为四个赛段——先后分别抵达紫色柱标、绿色柱标、红色柱标，最后再回到这里。

english.description:
Here's the big one! Good luck out there!

This race has four legs: get to the purple post, then green, then red, then back here. 

Your time matters, so do it fast!
english.completion: Good job, and nice time!

text.title: 寻宝合同：雷神贤者
text.objectives: 在玛戈纳洛克找到雷神贤者阿格拉姆。
text.description:
在霜火岭，有位名叫阿格拉姆的雷神贤者似乎发现了某件传说武器的下落，那件武器就是兽人口中的戈隆灾星。

他最后一次露面，是在去往玛戈纳洛克的路上。去找到他，看看能不能让他带你找到这件遗物。

english.title: Treasure Contract: The Thunderlord Sage
english.objectives: Locate the Thunderlord sage Argoram in Magnarok.
english.description:
In Frostfire Ridge, a Thunderlord sage by the name of Argoram seems to have uncovered the whereabouts of a storied weapon, known to the orcs as Gronnsbane. 

He was last spotted headed into Magnarok. Find him and see if he can lead you to this relic.

objectiveDetails.description: 在阿格拉姆身上寻找线索

text.title: 戈隆灾星：破碎的长矛
text.objectives: 在玛戈纳洛克里寻找戈隆灾星的矛头、矛杆和配重锤。
text.description:
在翻阅阿格拉姆的日记之后，你意识到要想找到这件遗物，绝不仅仅是凑齐长矛部件那么简单。

但是，也只能从此找起了……

english.title: Gronnsbane: The Broken Spear
english.objectives: Search throughout Magnarok for Gronnsbane's blade, haft, and weight.
english.description:
Looking through Argoram's journal, it becomes apparent that claiming this relic will be far more complicated than simply finding the pieces of the spear.

However, that would be the best place to start...

text.title: 戈隆灾星：火之祝福
text.objectives: 根据线索找到熔火萨满之石，并获得火之祝福。
text.description:
武器已经组装好了，可却少了与它传说身份相称的力量。为了让它重振雄风，你必须得到三种祝福，分别是火之祝福、霜之祝福和兽之祝福。

日记中提到的第一种祝福源于烈火。原文如下：

“他描述了一块古老的巨石，它耸立在一座向外延伸的悬崖边缘，炽热的岩浆从那里倾入大海。我相信他说的那个地方就在托格洛斯之牙的上方。”

english.title: Gronnsbane: The Blessing of Fire
english.objectives: Follow the clue to find the Molten Shamanstone and receive the Blessing of Fire.
english.description:
The weapon has been assembled, but it lacks the power that made it a legend. In order to restore it, you must receive three blessings: one of fire, one of frost, and one of beasts.

The first blessing mentioned in the journal is that of fire. The journal reads:

"He describes an ancient monolith, perched upon the edge of a precipice extending from the cliff where the searing magma falls into the sea.  I believe the location he speaks of is just overlooking Tor'goroth's Tooth."

text.title: 戈隆灾星：霜之祝福
text.objectives: 根据线索找到霜冻萨满之石，并获得霜之祝福。
text.description:
这把古老的武器已经受到了火之祝福，汲取了熔火萨满之石的力量。现在要从霜冻萨满之石中获得下一种祝福了。阿格拉姆在日记中提到了霜冻萨满之石的位置：

“在被独眼魔蛮兵投出的巨型石块赶走之前，我瞥见另一块巨石耸立在血槌白雪皑皑的群山之巅。或许这就是霜冻萨满之石，据说它能提供霜之祝福。”

english.title: Gronnsbane: The Blessing of Frost
english.objectives: Follow the clue to find the Frozen Shamanstone and receive the Blessing of Frost.
english.description:
The weapon has been imbued with the Blessing of Fire, drawing power from the Molten Shamanstone. The Frozen Shamanstone should impart the next blessing. Argoram mentions its location in his journal:

"As I was maneuvering away from the great boulders hurled at me by the ogron brutes, I glanced what looked like another monolith atop the tallest of the snow-capped towers in Bloodmaul. Perhaps this is the Frozen Shamanstone, which is thought to grant the Blessing of Frost"

text.title: 戈隆灾星：兽之祝福
text.objectives: 击败古老的黑色双头飞龙，然后将戈隆灾星浸在它的鲜血之中。$B$B获得祝福之后，将武器交还给伯德里克·格雷领取奖励。
text.description:
戈隆灾星上涌动着烈火与冰霜之力。现在只需要获得兽之祝福，就能令这把武器恢复全盛时期的力量了。阿格拉姆相信，只要让它沾上石怒崖古老的黑色双头飞龙的鲜血，即可大功告成。他的日记原文如下：

“在高耸的石怒崖上，我看见了一座食人魔祭拜这些古代野兽的祭坛。或许我能用它引一只下来。”
text.progress: Have you returned with the Thunderlords' relic?
text.completion: Who would've thought that such a normal looking spear would be able to take down a full-sized Gronn? $B$BI'm sure Dr. Jones will appreciate this in his collection.

english.title: Gronnsbane: The Blessing of Beasts
english.objectives: Defeat the ancient black rylak and douse Gronnsbane in its blood.$B$BOnce empowered, return the weapon to Bodrick Grey for your reward.
english.description:
Gronnsbane now pulses with energies of fire and frost. All that remains to restore the full power of the weapon is to receive the Blessing of the Beast. Argoram believed this could be accomplished by bloodying the weapon against one of the ancient black rylaks of Stonefury Cliffs. His journal reads:

"High in the Stonefury Cliffs, I have seen an altar where the ogres have left offerings to these ancient beasts. Perhaps I could use it to lure one of them"
english.progress: Have you returned with the Thunderlords' relic?
english.completion: Who would've thought that such a normal looking spear would be able to take down a full-sized Gronn? $B$BI'm sure Dr. Jones will appreciate this in his collection.

用高塔尔的血强化戈隆灾星

text.title: 清理码头
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个钢铁部落兽人和$2oa个独眼魔。
text.description: 我们的搜救队本以为这个码头已经被抛弃了，但钢铁部落的残余部队却让他们行进缓慢。古尔丹的伙伴们正在尽他们的所能劝说兽人们去追随恶魔，把所有愿意跟随他的部队撤退到塔纳安丛林去。$b$b指挥官，如果你能把这地方打扫干净，我的队伍就能从这里收集一些装备了。$b$b另外，在这里每杀一个兽人，到了塔纳安就可以少一分烦恼了。

english.title: Clearing the Docks
english.objectives: Kill $1oa Iron Horde orcs and $2oa ogron.
english.description: Our salvage team thought these here docks would be abandoned, but they're crawlin' wit' remnants of the Iron Horde. Gul'dan's cronies are convertin' anyone they can and evacuatin' everyone to Tanaan Jungle.$b$bCommander, if yeh can clear this place out, my team can salvage some of this equipment.$b$bPlus, ev'ry orc yeh kill here is one less ta worry about in Tanaan!

text.title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
text.objectives: Harrison Jones in Stormshield Stronghold wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 5 Artifact Fragments to Ecilam.
text.description: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran. Go out and kill any you find and bring at least five to Ecilam the Mage near the campfire in Stormshield Stronghold.
text.completed: Return to Ecilam in Stormshield Stronghold.

english.title: Uncovering the Artifact Fragments
english.objectives: Harrison Jones in Stormshield Stronghold wants you to go kill creatures in the outskirts of Ashran outside of the main road and bring back 5 Artifact Fragments to Ecilam.
english.description: The Artifact Fragments seem to come from any creature we've found in the outskirts of Ashran. Go out and kill any you find and bring at least five to Ecilam the Mage near the campfire in Stormshield Stronghold.
english.completed: Return to Ecilam in Stormshield Stronghold.

text.title: 前进、突破、深入！
text.objectives: 摧毁为大门提供火力掩护的邪能防御火炮。
text.description: 在我们被发现之前，有几个手下已经偷偷摸了进去，然后那些火炮就开动了。小的火炮还不算什么，不过那个大家伙……如果想把东西运进去的话，就必须把它处理掉。
text.completion: We be movin' supplies through here now. We finda good place to build!

english.title: In, Through, and Beyond!
english.objectives: Destroy the Fel Defense Cannon covering the gate.
english.description: A few of us snuck through before we was spotted, den de cannons started up. De small ones are no trouble, but de big one... we gonna need to take it out if we wanna get anyting through.
english.completion: All right, now we have a supply line. I managed to find a great place for the base.

objectiveDetails.description: 与暗影猎手穆图巴谈一谈

text.title: 突袭基地
text.objectives: 在塔纳安丛林建造你的突袭基地。
text.description: 附近有个很好的地方。离敌人不是太近，不过也足够我们为西边的同伴们分担压力了。跟我来。
text.completion: The easy part is done, now comes the hard part.

english.title: The Assault Base
english.objectives: Establish your assault base in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: Nearby be a good place. Not too close to da enemy, but close enough for us to take some pressure off da boys in the west. Follow me.
english.completion: Отлично. Это была легкая часть – а трудная еще впереди.

对铁城港的补给线进行一次战略打击应能使钢铁部落疲于防守，让我们能够维持住目前的成果。
