text.title: 寻宝合同：被感染的兽人
text.objectives: 在永茂丛林的变异兽人当中找到狞笑的托戈的日记。
text.description:
在戈尔隆德的嘲颅氏族中间流传着关于割颅者的传说。他的面具——人们只知道它叫静寂之颅——是氏族中的一个传奇，能帮我们增加对他们的了解。

所有人都以为割颅者人间蒸发了，直到不久前，他才再次现身，准确的说是在永茂丛林里。最后一个见到他的兽人落在了当地的木精手里，但应该还是留下了一些能帮你找到割颅者和面具的蛛丝马迹。

如果真是木精掳走了他，他恐怕不会那么配合。

english.title: Treasure Contract: The Infected Orc
english.objectives: Find Grinning Tolg's journal among the mutated orcs in Everbloom Wilds.
english.description:
In Gorgrond, the Laughing Skull clan has a legend of one called Skulltaker. His mask, known only as the Silent Skull, is legendary among the clan, and could help us learn more about them.

Until recently, he was thought to have vanished. Now it appears he has shown his face, so to speak, in Everbloom Wilds. The last orc to have seen him fell to the botani there, but may still have some clues on how you can find Skulltaker and recover the mask.

If the botani have him, he may not be cooperative.

text.title: 寂静之颅：第一种材料
text.objectives: 根据日记留下的线索找到影蓟叶片。
text.description:
狞笑的托戈当时正在炼制一种可以让他和掠食者交流的药剂，那正是割颅者神出鬼没的关键所在。

需要用到的第一种材料是影蓟叶片，在附近就能找到。日记原文如下：

“它生长在戈尔隆德刺眼的骄阳照耀不到的阴影中。我看到在黑铁高墙附近的巨石柱下有一些。”

english.title: The Silent Skull: The First Reagent
english.objectives: Follow the clue from the journal to find the Shadethisle Leaves.
english.description:
Grinning Tolg was in the process of brewing an elixir that would allow him to communicate with the ravagers, whom the Skulltaker relies on to remain hidden.

The first ingredient, the leaves of the Shadethistle plant, can be found nearby. The journal reads:

"It rests in the shadows of the harsh Gorgrond sun. I saw some under standing stones near the black iron walls."

objectiveDetails.description: 根据线索找到影蓟叶片

text.title: 寂静之颅：第二种材料
text.objectives: 根据日记留下的线索找到骨棘藤蔓。
text.description:
炼制药剂所要用到的第二种材料是骨棘的藤蔓。日记这样写道：

“我还要找一条骨棘的藤蔓，它们生长在古代亡者的骸骨上。我记得在北部荒原干枯的河床上有一头死了很久的野兽留下的骸骨。它那被晒焦的颅骨应该很适合这种植物的生长。”

english.title: The Silent Skull: The Second Reagent
english.objectives: Follow the clue from the journal to find the Bonethorn Vine.
english.description:
The second ingredient to the elixir is a vine from the Bonethorn plant. The journal reads:

"I must find a vine of bonethorn, which grows in the bones of the ancient dead. I remember seeing the bones of a long-dead beast in the dry beds of the northern wilds. Its sun-parched skull would make a pleasant home for such a plant."

objectiveDetails.description: 根据线索找到骨棘藤蔓

text.title: 寂静之颅：第三种材料
text.objectives: 根据日记留下的线索找到汽顶蘑菇。
text.description:
炼制药剂所需要的最后一种材料是一捧汽顶蘑菇。日记原文如下：

“饲鸦者说它们生长在永茂林地高处的蒸汽喷口旁。我在北边的多头蛇水塘附近见过一株。”

english.title: The Silent Skull: The Third Reagent
english.objectives: Follow the clue from the journal to find the Steamcap Mushrooms.
english.description:
The final component of the elixir is a handful of Steamcap mushrooms. The journal reads:

"The Crowfeeder said that they grow among the steam vents in the higher parts of the Everbloom. I have seen one such place above the northern hydra pools."

objectiveDetails.description: 根据线索找到汽顶蘑菇

text.title: 寂静之颅：割颅者之颅
text.objectives: 使用嘲颅药剂找到割颅者，并取得寂静之颅。
text.description:
材料全都凑齐了，现在你该去附近的洞穴寻找狞笑的托戈的营地来炼制药剂了。

一旦喝下药剂，你应该就能和那里的掠食者交流了。运气好的话，它们会带你去找割颅者。

他的面具能够换取不菲的奖励。
text.progress: This must be the cursed skull. Are you sure we should be touching it?
text.completion: This definitely looks like no Laughing Skull mask I've seen before. I'll take it to Jones and see what he makes of it. $B$BHe left me with this payment for you.

english.title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
english.objectives: Use the Laughing Skull elixir to find Skulltaker and claim the Silent Skull.
english.description:
With the reagents found, you should seek out Grinning Tolg's camp in the nearby cave to brew the elixir. 

Once the elixir is consumed, you should be able to communicate with the ravagers there. With any luck, they should be able to bring you to Skulltaker.

His mask should bring a hefty reward.

english.completion: This definitely looks like no Laughing Skull mask I've seen before. I'll take it to Jones and see what he makes of it. $B$BHe left me with this payment for you.

text.title: 废灵者达库尔必须死！
text.objectives: 在纳格兰的鲜血竞技场与古尔戈索克交谈，并在特别表演赛中获胜。
text.description: 古尔戈索克从鲜血竞技场赶来传递口信，说穆戈尔想让他的鲜血勇士去参加一场特殊的表演赛。他说的就是你啊，指挥官！$B$B只要跟古尔戈索克小声说一句“我要挑战寻魔者”，他就会帮你安排好一切！
text.completion: Word is already spreading of your epic fight, commander. This may improve relations with the ogres in the future.

english.title: Death to Nullifier Darkoor!
english.objectives: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.
english.description: Gurgthock stopped by from the Ring of Blood and said that Mogor wants his Blood Champion to participate in a special exhibition match. That's you, commander!$B$BJust whisper "I seek the seeker." into Gurgthock's ear and he'll get things going for ya!
english.completion: Word is already spreading of your epic fight, commander. This may improve relations with the ogres in the future.

text.title: 废灵者达库尔必须死！
text.objectives: 在纳格兰的鲜血竞技场与古尔戈索克交谈，并在特别表演赛中获胜。
text.description: 地精古尔戈索克路过捎来了口信，说穆戈尔想让他的鲜血勇士跟他挖掘到的新秀打场表演赛。他说的就是你啊，头儿。$B$B如果你准备好了，只要跟古尔戈索克小声说一句“我要挑战寻魔者”。剩下的事就交给他去安排吧。
text.completion: Word already be spreadin' about your exploits. If da ogres did not fear your strength yet, dey should now.

english.title: Death to Nullifier Darkoor!
english.objectives: Speak to Gurgthock at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand and win the special exhibition match.
english.description: Da goblin Gurgthock stopped by and be sayin' that Mogor wants his Blood Champion to fight in an exhibition match against something terrible he's dug up. Dat be you, boss.$B$BIf you be ready, whisper to Gurgthock "I seek da seeker." He take care of da rest.
english.completion: Word already be spreadin' about your exploits. If da ogres did not fear your strength yet, dey should now.

text.title: 可耻的鲁纳斯
text.objectives: 消灭可耻的鲁纳斯。
text.description: 我衰弱得很快，$n。我的力量已经大不如前了。我们真的需要你的帮助。$b$b有个恶心的怪物拐跑了几只雏龙。我听到有人叫他：$b$b鲁纳斯。$b$b我会活下去的，家就在不远的地方。但你还有力气，去杀死那个叫鲁纳斯的家伙，别让他继续伤害我的子嗣。
text.completion: Keep your distance from that one, $n.$b$bThose fallen elves are all the same. As two-faced as they come.

english.title: Runas the Shamed
english.objectives: Slay Runas the Shamed.
english.description: I fell so quickly, $n. I am not as strong as I once was. We truly do need your help.$b$bOne of these disgusting creatures ran off with several of the whelplings. I heard him called by name:$b$bRunas.$b$bI will survive. Home is not far. You still have strength, though. Slay this Runas before he does any more damage to our brood.
english.completion: Keep your distance from that one, $n.$b$bThose fallen elves are all the same. As two-faced as they come.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送鲁纳斯去见塞纳苟斯

text.title: 饥渴难耐
text.objectives: 获取4个充能法力珠宝。
text.description: <鲁纳斯一脸焦虑。>$b$b我可以帮你，我非常想帮你，不过我现在有点心烦意乱。看看那些新鲜的、未经萃取的、令人垂涎的法力……$b$b<鲁纳斯打了自己一巴掌。>$b$b不！不！你必须控制自己！$b$b我只需要让脑袋清醒一下。对了，就是它。我那些堕落的同胞会随身带着小型法力珠宝，以备在需要快速补充能量的时候使用。可以找一些给我吗？然后我就告诉你该怎么恢复魔网。
text.progress: Do you have them? Please tell me you have them, my friend.
text.completion: <Runas feverishly crushes the jewels and gets to work rubbing magical dust on his face, arms, and back.>$b$b<He is, for the moment, in bliss.>

english.title: The Hunger Returns
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Charged Mana Jewels.
english.description: <Runas looks antsy.>$b$bI can help you, and I very much want to help you, but I'm a bit distracted. Look at all that raw, unfiltered, mouthwatering mana...$b$b<Runas slaps his own face.>$b$bNo! NO! You must stay in control!$b$bI simply need to clear my head. Yes, that's it. A few of my depraved brethren carry small mana jewels around with them in case they need a quick burst of energy. Find a few for me? Then I will show you how to get your ley line back.
english.progress: Ну что, они у тебя? Прошу тебя, друг, обнадежь меня – скажи, что они у тебя.
english.completion: <Runas feverishly crushes the jewels and gets to work rubbing magical dust on his face, arms, and back.>$b$b<He is, for the moment, in bliss.>

text.title: 滥用魔网
text.objectives: 消灭伊什卡奈斯和泰德里森。
text.description: 这些怪物直接从大地中吸取法力，难怪法力池也无法缓解我的痛苦。$b$b我很担心我的子嗣。如果没有魔网的能量，我们就什么也不是。照这么下去，我可能无法帮你修复潮汐之石了。$b$b找出他们的法力虹吸管道，并惩罚那些使用管道的堕夜精灵混蛋。
text.progress: С гибелью очередного из этих кретинов ко мне возвращаются силы.
text.completion: I do feel a bit stronger.$b$bThose siphons nearly did me in, $n.

english.title: Leyline Abuse
english.objectives: Slay Iskhaneth and Tyndrissen.
english.description: These monsters are pulling mana directly out of the ground. This explains why not even my mana pools can dull my pain.$b$bI worry about my brood. Without the power of the ley lines, we are nothing. At this rate, I may not even be able to help you with your Tidestone.$b$bLook for their mana siphons, and punish the cowardly nightfallen elves that are using them.
english.progress: С гибелью очередного из этих кретинов ко мне возвращаются силы.
english.completion: I do feel a bit stronger.$b$bThose siphons nearly did me in, $n.

text.title: 动感低音
text.objectives: 收集低音炮、镭射读碟器、音效增幅器、S.P.R.K.电容器和古木电线。
text.description:
你知道怎样才能振作士气吗？

重低音、节拍、音乐！

人人都爱派对！你去给我找些设备来，我就能给你造出一套嗨翻德拉诺的音响系统！
text.progress: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
text.completion: What great shape this stuff is in. Yeah, honest! I think I can work with this junk. Give me just a minute here...
text.completed: Return to Drix Brassbolter in your Garrison.

english.title: Bringing the Bass
english.objectives: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
english.description:
You know what would boost morale around here?

Bass. Beats. Music!

Everyone loves a party! You go out and get me some hardware, and I'll make a system that will shatter Draenor itself.
english.progress: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
english.completion: What great shape this stuff is in. Yeah, honest! I think I can work with this junk. Give me just a minute here...
english.completed: Return to Drix Brassbolter in your Garrison.

text.objectives: Speak with Archmage Khadgar outside of Bladefury's Command in Northern Talador.
text.description: We must act quickly - Garona here tells me that Gul'dan is on the move. He is headed to the Path of Glory to meet with Grommash Hellscream.$b$bWe have to act while our intelligence is fresh! Hurry and meet us outside of Bladefury's Command in northern Talador. We won't be able to engage Gul'dan and the whole Iron Horde army on our own, but we may just learn something to use against them...
text.completion: This place is absolutely crawling with guards. I don't know how Garona can be so confident.$B$BAh well, let me brief you on the plan, such as it is...

text.title: Assault on the Temple of Sha'naar
text.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle.
text.description:
Up in the hills of Tanaan Jungle, the Sargerei have converted a once-sacred temple into a den of demonic summoning.

We must attack them now, before their rituals complete. The longer we delay, the stronger our enemy grows.
text.completion: Welcome back, commander. Our scouts just returned with word of your success.$B$BWell done!

text.title: 突袭邪能熔炉
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林铁城港的钢铁部落援军。
text.description:
钢铁部落仍在从德拉诺各地调派援军以增援地狱火堡垒的防御力量。假如无法切断他们的补给线，我们在塔纳安的计划就会失去控制。

对铁城港的补给线进行一次战略打击应能使钢铁部落疲于防守，让我们能够维持住目前的成果。

english.title: Assault on the Fel Forge
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde reinforcements at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Iron Horde continue to bring in reinforcements from all over Draenor to reinforce their position at Hellfire Citadel. If we don't cut off the flow of supplies then we risk losing control of our plans in Tanaan.

A strategic attack to the supply lines at Ironhold Harbor is just the thing to keep the Iron Horde on the defensive and maintain our momentum.

text.title: 寻宝合同：德莱尼技师
text.objectives: 在命运之柱的入口附近寻找有关技师马顿的水晶的证据。
text.description:
我听说有个名叫马顿的德莱尼技师想要设法复原一块古老的德莱尼水晶，那水晶好像是源于纳鲁。他管它叫阿古斯之梦。

在影月兽人跟钢铁部落结盟前，那位技师到他们那里寻求帮助，从此下落不明。你的一位斥候不久前在命运之柱的入口附近发现了跟马顿的样貌特征十分相符的德莱尼。去那看看能有什么发现吧。

english.title: Treasure Contract: The Artificer
english.objectives: Search near the entrance of the Pillars of Fate for evidence of Artificer Maatun's crystal.
english.description:
I have heard of a draenei artificer by the name of Maatun that was seeking to restore an old draenei crystal, possibly of naaru origin. He called the crystal the Dream of Argus. 

The draenei went missing after seeking out help from the Shadowmoon orcs back before they allied themselves with the Iron Horde. One of your scouts recently spotted a draenei matching the description of Maatun near the entrance of the Pillars of Fate. Go there and see what you can dig up.

text.title: 阿古斯之梦：第一块碎片
text.objectives: 根据日记留下的线索找到洛尔·石拳。击败她，并取得粗糙的水晶碎片。
text.description:
在复原阿古斯之梦的过程中，马顿请求了三位兽人的帮助。结果他们无一例外地背叛了他，将马顿来不及拼合的水晶碎片抢走了。要是你能找到这些兽人的话，水晶碎片也许还在他们手里。

第一个目标就在不远处。日记里写道：

“我听说她花了很多时间在营地北边的水晶洞穴里。她在那里研究本地的水晶，寻找强化其力量的方法。”
text.giverWindow: 影月氏族的战士，也是研究当地水晶的专家。

english.title: Dream of Argus: The First Fragment
english.objectives: Follow the clue from the journal to find Lor Stonefist. Defeat her and claim the Rough Crystal Shard.
english.description:
In his quest to restore the Dream of Argus, Maatun enlisted the help of three orcs. These same orcs betrayed him and took the crystal shards before they could be combined. If you find these orcs, they may still have them.

The first target shouldn't be far. The journal reads:

"I was told she spent most of her time in the crystal cave to the north of the encampment. There she studied the native crystals for ways to improve their potential abilities."
english.giverWindow: A warrior of the Shadowmoon clan, as well as an expert on the native crystals.

objectiveDetails.description: 根据线索找到粗糙的水晶碎片

text.title: 阿古斯之梦：第二块碎片
text.objectives: 根据日记留下的线索找到沃克·黑舌。击败他，并取得开裂的水晶碎片。
text.description:
马顿提到的第二个兽人是一位巫师，同时也是符文石雕刻大师。他应该在主营地里的某个地方。日记原文如下：

“她提到这位兽人通常都在营地南部的符文大师小屋中。我可以根据房子周围的立石以及顶上漂浮的符文石来分辨。”
text.giverWindow: 符文大师，影月氏族的高阶仪祭师。

english.title: Dream of Argus: The Second Fragment
english.objectives: Follow the clue in the journal to find Vok Blacktongue. Defeat him and claim the Cracked Crystal Shard.
english.description:
The second orc that Matuun mentioned was a master runecarver and sorcerer. He should be located somewhere in the main camp. The journal reads:

"She mentioned that the orc could normally found in one of the runemaster's huts in the southern part of the camp. They could be identified by the standing stones surrounding the structure, as well as the floating runestones above."
english.giverWindow: Master runecarver and high ritualist of the Shadowmoon.

objectiveDetails.description: 根据线索找到开裂的水晶碎片

text.title: 阿古斯之梦：最后一块碎片
text.objectives: 根据日记留下的线索找到库洛斯·碎魂。击败他，并取得光滑的水晶碎片。
text.description:
最后一位兽人是个隐士，他不住在命运之柱营地里，而是生活在远离其他影月兽人的地方，但人们经常看到他出现在上方的山顶上。日记这样写道：

“但据说，他经常出现的山顶上墓地里，俯视下方的营地。他能和死去的祖先沟通，比起活着的同胞，据说他更喜欢这些亡者。”
text.giverWindow: 选择与亡者为伴的神秘隐士。

english.title: Dream of Argus: The Final Fragment
english.objectives: Follow the clue in the journal to find Koros Soulsplinter. Defeat him and claim the Smooth Crystal Shard.
english.description:
The last orc to be found was a hermit who kept away from the bulk of the Shadowmoon orcs at the Pillars of Fate camp, but was often seen in the high hills above. The journal reads:

"It is said, however, that he can often be seen among the graves upon the high hill, overlooking the camp below.  There he would commune with the dead ancestors, whom it is said he preferred over his living brethren."
english.giverWindow: A mysterious hermit who prefers the company of the dead.

objectiveDetails.description: 跟随线索找到光滑的水晶碎片

text.title: 阿古斯之梦：重塑水晶
text.objectives: 找到水晶重塑装置并用它来复原阿古斯之梦。
text.description: 有了这些碎片，现在可以复原阿古斯之梦了。你必须找到马顿在他日记中提过的那个装置。据说它就在俯瞰痛楚堡垒的洞穴中。
text.progress: Were you able to restore the draenei crystal?
text.completion: This is incredible! I would never be able to tell that this crystal was once broken! $B$BI'm sure Dr. Jones will be pleased to see this, as well as the draenei if the stories behind it are true.

english.title: Dream of Argus: The Crystal Reborn
english.objectives: Locate the crystal reconstruction device and use it to restore the Dream of Argus.
english.description: With the shards recovered, it is now possible to restore the Dream of Argus. You must seek out the device that Maatun mentions in his journal, which is said to be in a cave overlooking Anguish Fortress.
english.progress: Were you able to restore the draenei crystal?
english.completion: This is incredible! I would never be able to tell that this crystal was once broken! $B$BI'm sure Dr. Jones will be pleased to see this, as well as the draenei if the stories behind it are true.

text.title: 世界驰名的鲜血竞技场！
text.objectives: 成为纳格兰鲜血竞技场的竞技场之王。
text.description: 亲爱的彻头彻尾的坏蛋朋友，$B$B如果你看到了这封信，那就说明你正是我们在纳格兰鲜血竞技场苦苦等待的有着金刚不坏之身的王牌勇士。$B$B我们诚挚地邀请你带上两位朋友，来跟戈尔隆德这一带最凶猛的生物以命相搏。战斗无疑将是残酷的——可观众们好的就是这口！$B$B来找我谈谈，开始第一场比试吧——击败我为你挑选的四位最彪悍的对手，然后你将有机会和卫冕冠军本人过过招！$B$B——古尔戈索克
text.completion: You did it. You really did it! Here's your winnings, champ.$B$BMan, the Highmaul ogres are not going to like this...
text.end: 成为纳格兰鲜血竞技场的竞技场之王。

english.title: The World Famous Ring of Blood!
english.objectives: Become Lord of the Ring at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand.
english.description: Dear Unadulterated Badass,$B$BIf you're reading this, you're exactly the sort of tough-as-nails champ in the making we need down at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand.$B$BYou and two friends are cordially invited to fight for your lives against the toughest creatures this side of Gorgrond. It's positively brutal - and the crowd loves it!$B$BCome talk to me to start your first fight - beat four of the fiercest creatures I've got and you'll get a shot at the champ himself!$B$B-Gurgthock
english.completion: You did it. You really did it! Here's your winnings, champ.$B$BMan, the Highmaul ogres are not going to like this...
english.end: Become Lord of the Ring at the Ring of Blood in Nagrand.

text.title: Gutrek's Cleaver: The Spirit Forge
text.objectives: Locate the Spirit Forge in Earthshaker Gorge and reforge Gutrek's Cleaver.
text.description:
With the pieces recovered, all that is left is to reforge Gutrek's Cleaver. Goldspade's journal seems to indicate that the only place to do this is the location where it was initially dismantled.

The journal mentions a "Spirit Forge" used to dismantle the blade, and that it may be located somewhere in the nearby gorge. Find the forge and use it to combine the pieces you've gathered.
text.progress: Dis be da blade dat Jones was lookin for?
text.completion: Excellent, mon! I be takin dis to Jones right away. $B$BHere be your reward.

text.title: 戈隆灾星：兽之祝福
text.objectives: 击败古老的黑色双头飞龙，然后将戈隆灾星浸在它的鲜血之中。$B$B获得祝福之后，将武器交还给洛坎领取奖励。
text.description:
戈隆灾星上涌动着烈火与冰霜之力。现在只需要获得兽之祝福，就能令这把武器恢复全盛时期的力量了。阿格拉姆相信，只要让它沾上石怒崖古老的黑色双头飞龙的鲜血，即可大功告成。他的日记原文如下：

“在高耸的石怒崖上，我看见了一座食人魔祭拜这些古代野兽的祭坛。或许我能用它引一只下来。”
text.progress: You bring da spear from da Thunderlords?
text.completion: Jones will be happy when he sees dis. $B$BHere's da payment he promised.

english.title: Gronnsbane: The Blessing of Beasts
english.objectives: Defeat the ancient black rylak and douse Gronnsbane in its blood.$B$BOnce empowered, return the weapon to Rokhan for your reward.
english.description:
Gronnsbane now pulses with energies of fire and frost. All that remains to restore the full power of the weapon is to receive the Blessing of the Beast. Argoram believed this could be accomplished by bloodying the weapon against one of the ancient black rylaks of Stonefury Cliffs. His journal reads:

"High in the Stonefury Cliffs, I have seen an altar where the ogres have left offerings to these ancient beasts. Perhaps I could use it to lure one of them"
english.progress: You bring da spear from da Thunderlords?
english.completion: Jones will be happy when he sees dis. $B$BHere's da payment he promised.

text.title: 寂静之颅：割颅者之颅
text.objectives: 使用嘲颅药剂找到割颅者，并取得寂静之颅。
text.description:
材料全都凑齐了，现在你该去附近的洞穴寻找狞笑的托戈的营地来炼制药剂了。

一旦喝下药剂，你应该就能和那里的掠食者交流了。运气好的话，它们会带你去找割颅者。

他的面具能够换取不菲的奖励。
text.progress: Dat must be da cursed skull you got dere.
text.completion: Dis be an odd mask for a Laughing Skull, to be sure. $B$BJones left dis reward for ya.

english.title: The Silent Skull: Taking from the Taker
english.objectives: Use the Laughing Skull elixir to find Skulltaker and claim the Silent Skull.
english.description:
With the reagents found, you should seek out Grinning Tolg's camp in the nearby cave to brew the elixir. 

Once the elixir is consumed, you should be able to communicate with the ravagers there. With any luck, they should be able to bring you to Skulltaker.

His mask should bring a hefty reward.

text.description: With the shards recovered, it is now possible to restore the Dream of Argus. You must seek out the device that Maatun mentions in his journal, which is said to be in a cave overlooking Anguish Fortress.

text.title: 指挥官亲征！
text.objectives: 从塔纳安丛林的多名斥候那里听取报告。
text.description: 那些新生的邪兽人挡住了我们的去路，不过我们最终会获胜的。德拉卡和我派出了一整支斥候队伍前往丛林收集我们需要应对的敌人的信息。$b$b要想全面了解我们在那里要应对的敌人，你最好赶快去找他们。
text.completion: We have quite a war on our hands. At least we do not lack for targets to strike!

english.title: Commander in the Field!
english.objectives: Get reports from various scouts in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: We have been stopped by these new fel orcs, but we will ultimately prevail. Draka and I did manage to get a full scouting group out into the jungle to gather what else we will have to deal with.$b$bYou should seek them out, gain a full understanding of what we face here.
english.completion: У нас тут идет полномасштабная война. Что ж – по крайней мере, нет недостатка в противниках!

text.description: The Horde intends to force us out of Ashran, $n. We can't let them succeed. March into the Road of Glory and thin their ranks by at least five.

text.title: 享用巨龙魔力
text.objectives: 在蓝翼栖地消灭$1oa个枯法者。
text.description: 你除掉了他们的首领，所以他们就来到了这里？可以理解。这些生物只想要一种东西——魔力——他们大老远就能闻出魔力的味道。$b$b没有首领以后，他们很快就会凋零、死亡。现在，我们唯一的办法是尽可能地削减他们的数量，阻止他们伤害巨龙！
text.completion: That will have to do for now.

english.title: Feasting on the Dragon
english.objectives: Slay $1oa withered in Azurewing Repose.
english.description: You killed their leader, so they came here? Understandable. These creatures crave only one thing - magic - and they can sniff it out from leagues away.$b$bWithout a leader, they will soon wither and die. Our only recourse in the meantime is to put as many as possible down before they take these dragons with them!
english.completion: That will have to do for now.

text.objectives: 使用发光的魔网水晶，或者发挥你的治疗能力让受伤的幼龙复苏。
text.description: 这些枯法者想把我们一族赶尽杀绝！$b$b赶快，$n！剥下一块魔网水晶，到战场上治疗任何受伤的幼龙。$b$b我将尽全力保护这些雏龙，并让它们康复。
text.completion: Well done. I saw the other drakes take to the skies.$b$bAnd look! You found Emmigosa!$b$bIt seems she's taken a shine to you, $n. I trust you'll keep her safe for now.

english.objectives: Use the Radiant Ley Crystal or your healing spells and abilities to resuscitate wounded dragons.
english.description: This many withered threaten to wipe our brood out completely!$b$bQuickly, $n! Crack off a ley crystal and heal any wounded drakes you can find out on the battlefield.$b$bI will do what I can to keep these whelplings safe and healthy.
english.completion: Well done. I saw the other drakes take to the skies.$b$bAnd look! You found Emmigosa!$b$bIt seems she's taken a shine to you, $n. I trust you'll keep her safe for now.

The Sargerei council continues to work in secret with the warlock, Gul'dan. Up in the hills of Tanaan Jungle, they have converted a once-sacred temple into a den of demonic summoning.

We must attack them now, before their rituals complete. The longer we delay, the stronger their forces become.

text.title: 皇家召令
text.objectives: 使用皇家召令，然后跟随空军上将罗杰斯进入暴风城港口传送门。
text.description: 幸会，$p。我代表安度因·乌瑞恩国王欢迎你的到来。$B$B我的队伍正准备执行一项特殊的任务，而国王陛下希望你也能加入。请查阅这份皇家召令，如果没有异议的话，就请你随我一起返回暴风城港口。$B$B<罗杰斯递给你一份密封的信函。>
text.completion: Thank you for your cooperation.

english.title: A Royal Summons
english.objectives: Use the Royal Summons and follow Sky Admiral Rogers through the portal to Stormwind Harbor.
english.description: Well met, $p. I have come on behalf of King Anduin Wrynn.$B$BMy crew is preparing for a special mission, and the king would like you to join us. Please review this official summons and, if you are satisfied, return with me to Stormwind Harbor.$B$B<Rogers hands you a sealed envelope.>
english.completion: Thank you for your cooperation.

text.title: 散落的天火号补给品
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个天火急救包。
text.description: 你还好吗？来，说“啊”。$B$B<米希卡试着用一根潮湿的树枝来压住你的舌头。>$B$B抱歉……这里太需要医疗补给了。天火号的医务室本来有充足的储备，但是现在却掉的满地都是。$B$B如果你能从残骸中找回任何补给，都能挽救生命！
text.progress: Did you find anything?
text.completion: Just in time! I was about to start bandaging wounds with leaves.

english.title: Supplies From the Skies
english.objectives: Gather $1oa Skyfire First Aid Kits.
english.description: Are you feeling alright? Say 'ah.'$B$B<Mishka attempts to depress your tongue with a damp twig.>$B$BSorry... we are in desperate need of medical supplies here. The infirmary on the Skyfire was well-stocked, but it's all scattered to the winds now.$B$BAnything you can salvage from the wreck will save lives!
english.progress: Удалось что-нибудь отыскать?
english.completion: Just in time! I was about to start bandaging wounds with leaves.

text.title: 血环之血
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林泽斯高的血环氏族。
text.description:
血环氏族对塔纳安的钢铁部落提供了极大的援助。他们在泽斯高不断追捕我们的斥候、破坏我们的行动，同时还在帮助古尔丹聚集更多的力量。

我们可以考虑对泽斯高进行一次直接突击，迫使他们撤兵回防。这应该能为我们赢得一定的喘息时间。
text.completion: I already have reports of Bleeding Hollow hunters falling back to Zeth'Gol. This will give us a good edge in the battles to come.

english.title: Bleeding the Bleeding Hollow
english.objectives: Assault the Bleeding Hollow at Zeth'Gol in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Bleeding Hollow provide significant reinforcement to the Iron Horde in Tanaan. From their home in Zeth'Gol they relentlessly pursue our scouts, disrupt our operations, and gather more power for Gul'dan's magic.

We should consider a direct raid on Zeth'Gol to make them pull back their forces across the valley. This should give us some breathing room... for a time.
english.completion: Мне уже доложили, что охотники из клана Кровавой Глазницы отступают в Зет'Гол. Это даст нам немалое преимущество в грядущих битвах.

text.title: 钢铁前线之战
text.objectives: 协助联盟与部落的联军突袭塔纳安丛林的钢铁前线。
text.description: 将军，我们的部队在钢铁前线发动了一场联合攻击。战事已经进入了白热化阶段，伤亡也很惨重。$b$b向钢铁前线汇报，并为那里的战斗出一份力。我相信有您亲临战场必定能鼓舞战士们取得胜利！
text.completion: I'm already hearing reports from The Iron Front that the tide of the battle has turned.$B$BSoon, The Iron Horde will have nowhere to run!

english.objectives: Aid the Alliance and Horde assault at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description: General, our troops are currently engaged in a conjoined assault at the Iron Front. The fight has been raging for some time now, and casualties are high.$b$bReport to the Iron Front and lend your strength to the war effort. I have no doubt that your presence on the battlefield will inspire the soldiers to victory!
english.completion: I'm already hearing reports from The Iron Front that the tide of the battle has turned.$B$BSoon, The Iron Horde will have nowhere to run!

text.title: Battle At The Iron Front
text.objectives: Aid the Alliance and Horde assault at The Iron Front in Tanaan Jungle.
text.description: The war against the Iron horde rages on.$b$bNot far from here at The Iron Front, our warriors are engaged in mortal combat with the enemy. They fight tenaciously and with great fury, but the losses have been severe.$b$bGo to The Iron Front and show the enemy that we will not falter in this war.$b$bShow them that we fight as wolves!
text.completion: Thanks to your aid, we have gained a foothold at The Iron Front. Soon, Gul'dan and the Iron Horde will have nowhere else to run.

They fight tenaciously and with great fury, but the losses have been severe.$b$bGo to The Iron Front and show the enemy that we will not falter in this war.$b$bShow them that we fight as wolves!

text.title: 登陆！
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个被遗忘者蝙蝠骑手或亡灵哨兵。
text.description: 很高兴看到你在空难中幸存了下来。不幸的是，大部分登船的敌人也活了下来。$B$B一想到那些怪物登上了我的船，我就直犯恶心。去干掉他们，$p。为了我的船员……为了乌瑞恩国王……$B$B为了联盟！
text.completion: Don't worry about the ship - it's just wood and metal.$B$BThe Skyfire lives on as long as we keep fighting.

english.title: Boarded!
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Forsaken Bat-Riders or Forsaken Deathstalkers.
english.description: Glad to see you survived the crash. Unfortunately, so did most of the enemy's boarding party.$B$BJust the thought of those monsters setting foot on my ship makes me sick. Wipe them out, $p. For my crew... For King Wrynn...$B$BFor the Alliance!
english.completion: Don't worry about the ship - it's just wood and metal.$B$BThe Skyfire lives on as long as we keep fighting.

text.title: 强取电池
text.objectives: 从亡灵骑兵马尔维克身上找回发报机电池。
text.description: 我们必须尽快向联盟海军汇报坐标！$B$B我正在制造一部新的发报机来发送呼救信号，需要用到天火号通讯控制台的电池。$B$B控制台就在飞艇顶部，但愿亡灵的魔爪还没有伸到那里去。
text.progress: I cannot build a new transponder without that battery!
text.completion: NUTS and BOLTS!$B$BPardon my language.$B$BThis thing is almost as dead as the guy you took it from. We need juice, and lots of it. I have an idea...

english.title: Assault and Battery
english.objectives: Recover the Transponder Battery from Dread-Rider Malwick.
english.description: We need to report our position to the Alliance navy ASAP!$B$BI am building a new transponder to send a distress signal, but I need a battery from the Skyfire's communications console.$B$BYou'll find the console at the top of the ship - I just hope those undead haven't put their creepy, bony fingers on it yet!
english.progress: Without this battery, I cannot construct a new transmitter!
english.completion: NUTS and BOLTS!$B$BPardon my language.$B$BThis thing is almost as dead as the guy you took it from. We need juice, and lots of it. I have an idea...

text.title: 失踪的第七军团
text.objectives: 寻找失踪的第七军团龙骑兵。
text.description: 第七军团的英雄们当时都留在了飞艇的前部迎战风暴幼龙，掩护船员撤离。$B$B但他们至今未归。$B$B请你去找到他们，$p！
text.completion: <Though his eyes are open, the solider does not respond to your presence. An electrical field buzzes around him.>
text.completed: 与骑士队长罗德斯交谈。

english.title: The Lost Legion
english.objectives: Locate the missing 7th Legion Dragoons.
english.description: The heroic men and women of the 7th Legion stayed at the front of the ship to fight off storm drakes while the crew evacuated.$B$BNone of them have returned.$B$BPlease find them, $p!
english.completion: <Though his eyes are open, the solider does not respond to your presence. An electrical field buzzes around him.>
english.completed: Speak with Knight-Captain Rhodes.

text.title: 引雷针
text.objectives: 吸收风暴幼龙的闪电攻击为发报机充能。
text.description: <欧沃斯巴克的小手动作神速，他把线圈和导管装到设备上面，然后把它塞进了一个降落伞包。>$B$B穿上它。$B$B你会在山顶上找到天火号的前半部分残骸——还有它撞上的那个巨型风暴幼龙巢穴！我们可以用幼龙的能量来为发报机充电。$B$B当然，你得先刺激它们放电，然后这个设备就能吸收大部分的能量。$B$B你被电死的可能性完全在可接受的范围内！
text.completion: Alright... I'm reading full power on the transponder.$B$BNow for an antenna...

english.title: Lightning Rod
english.objectives: Charge the Transponder by absorbing Storm Drake lightning attacks.
english.description: <Overspark's tiny hands move like lightning, affixing coils and tubes to the device before cramming it into a parachute pack.>$B$BPut this on.$B$BJust up the hill you'll find the front half of the Skyfire - and the big nest of storm drakes it crashed into! We can use the energy from those drakes to charge the transponder.$B$BYou'll have to incite them, of course, but the device should draw most of the power.$B$BThe probability of you being electrocuted is well within acceptable parameters!
english.completion: Alright... I'm reading full power on the transponder.$B$BNow for an antenna...

text.title: 如坐针毡
text.objectives: 从静电力场中救出$1oa名第七军团龙骑兵。
text.description: 唔！$B$B不行，还是站不起来，全身发麻。$B$B这种小打小闹对第七军团来说根本不算什么，可我们对它们的电力攻击毫无防备。我还没反应过来呢，就被困在这个静电力场里了。在你过来之前，我连一块肌肉都动不了。$B$B我的战友们被带进了洞穴深处，请你去救救他们，别让他们被幼龙给吃了！
text.completion: <The transponder lights up. An uneasy voice comes over the line.>$B$BHello? Is this working? (By the Light, I hate these things.)$B$BThis is Mishka. Missing 7th Legion soldiers have returned to camp. All accounted for.$B$BUh.. over. Message over.$B$BOver and goodbye.$B$BEnd transm- <The radio cuts out sharply.>

english.title: Pins and Needles
english.objectives: Release $1oa 7th Legion Dragoons from static fields.
english.description: Hngghh!$B$BNope, can't stand yet. It's all pins and needles.$B$BSmall fries like this are usually no problem for the 7th, but we weren't prepared for their electrical attacks. Before I knew it, I was trapped in some kind of static field. Couldn't move a muscle until you came along.$B$BMy comrades were carried deeper into the cave. Get 'em out before they become whelp chow!
english.completion: <The transponder lights up. An uneasy voice comes over the line.>$B$BHello? Is this working? (By the Light, I hate these things.)$B$BThis is Mishka. Missing 7th Legion soldiers have returned to camp. All accounted for.$B$BUh.. over. Message over.$B$BOver and goodbye.$B$BEnd transm- <The radio cuts out sharply.>

text.title: 信号增强
text.objectives: 利用天火号螺旋桨发送呼救信号，然后抵御敌人的攻击直至援兵抵达。
text.description: 天火号的右舷螺旋桨掉到了营地上方的悬崖上面，我们可以把它当做超级天线，把呼救信号发送到天涯海角，就连梅卡托克的闹钟都接收得到！$B$B不幸的是，这可能会引起一些麻烦。$B$B我们已经做好在营地对抗敌人的准备——发送信号，准备守住天线！
text.completion: The distress signal got through. We'll be evacuated to Greywatch immediately.$B$BI'm afraid that, for now, you will have to continue on your mission without us. Once we are settled, I will send out recon patrols to see if we can glean the location of the Aegis.$B$BYou must secure the Aegis of Aggramar if we are to drive back the Legion threat!

english.title: Signal Boost
english.objectives: Use the Skyfire Propeller to broadcast a distress signal, then hold out until help arrives.
english.description: The Skyfire's starboard propeller came to rest on the cliffs overlooking our camp - we're gonna use it like a big antenna and push our distress signal so far that even Mekkatorque's alarm clock could pick it up!$B$BUnfortunately, it might attract some unwanted attention.$B$BWe're braced for enemy contact down here at the camp - fire up that signal and be ready to defend the antenna!
english.completion: The distress signal got through. We'll be evacuated to Greywatch immediately.$B$BI'm afraid that, for now, you will have to continue on your mission without us. Once we are settled, I will send out recon patrols to see if we can glean the location of the Aegis.$B$BYou must secure the Aegis of Aggramar if we are to drive back the Legion threat!

text.title: 利爪大德鲁伊
text.objectives: 找到钢爪谷。
text.description: 你可以在我们森林的最南边找到沉眠者地穴。$B$B大德鲁伊科达·钢爪和她的忠实信徒就是在那里履行着监视翡翠梦境的神圣职责。$b$b到钢爪谷找瑞丽萨·熊歌，把塞纳留斯林地的危机告诉她。
text.completion: The forest already whispers of Malfurion's return. There are few among us who have not heard of his deeds.$B$BThe trees said he also travels with a companion, one named $n. Are you $Ghe:she;?
text.completed: 在钢爪谷与瑞丽萨·熊歌谈一谈。

english.title: Archdruid of the Claw
english.objectives: Locate Steelclaw Vale.
english.description: Near the southern edge of our forest you will find Sleeper's Barrow.$B$BThere, Archdruid Koda Steelclaw and her dedicated disciples carry out their sacred duty to observe the Emerald Dream.$b$bFind disciple Rylissa Bearsong in Steelclaw Vale and notify her of the crisis in the Grove of Cenarius.
english.completion: The forest already whispers of Malfurion's return. There are few among us who have not heard of his deeds.$B$BThe trees said he also travels with a companion, one named $n. Are you $Ghe:she;?
english.completed: Speak to Rylissa Bearsong at Steelclaw Vale.

text.title: 唤醒大德鲁伊
text.objectives: 唤醒利爪大德鲁伊。
text.description: 现在，我们必须合力唤醒大德鲁伊钢爪。$B$B她与其他的德鲁伊同胞都在南边的兽穴里沉眠。$B$B镇压了熊怪之后，我们就可以安全通过入口。$B$B去唤醒大德鲁伊。祈求月神保佑我们还来得及。
text.completion: <The Archdruid's deep, shallow breaths rumble across the chamber.>
text.completed: 与沉眠者地穴的大德鲁伊科达·钢爪交谈。

english.title: Awakening the Archdruid
english.objectives: Awaken the Archdruid of the Claw.
english.description: Now, we must focus our efforts on waking Archdruid Steelclaw.$B$BShe and our druid brethren slumber in the barrow dens to the south.$B$BWith the furbolgs quelled, we can pass safely to the entrance.$B$BGo and awaken the Archdruid. I pray to Elune that we are not too late.
english.completion: <The Archdruid's deep, shallow breaths rumble across the chamber.>
english.completed: Speak to Archdruid Koda Steelclaw in the Sleeper's Barrow.

text.title: 深藏的恶魔
text.objectives: 消灭8个暗魔入侵者。
text.description: 某个人或是某种东西想让我们永远都醒不过来。我感觉他们还在兽穴里。$B$B<科达奋力站了起来。>$B$B漫长的睡眠让我的身体虚弱不堪。$B$B如果你愿意帮助我们，那就请你清除兽穴里的敌人吧。
text.completion: Excellent. The chambers are clear. Very impressive, $c.

english.title: The Demons Below
english.objectives: Kill 8 Darkfiend Intruders.
english.description: Something, someone, intended us to never awaken. I sense their presence is still here in the barrow.$B$B<Koda takes a moment to stand.>$B$BMy body is weak from deep slumber.$B$BIf you would aid us, clear our barrow of any enemies.
english.completion: Excellent. The chambers are clear. Very impressive, $c.

text.title: 脱离梦境
text.objectives: 唤醒$1oa名利爪德鲁伊。
text.description: 玛法里奥·怒风……我已经好几百年没听过这个名字了。他是我们许多人的导师，如果他要见我，我当然不会拒绝。$B$B我会前往塞纳留斯林地，但首先，我们需要唤醒我的族人。他们仍然沉睡不醒。$b$b有一股强大的神秘力量笼罩着我们。$B$B漫长的睡眠让我的身体虚弱不堪。陌生人，请去帮他们脱离梦境吧。
text.completion: Well done, hero. With my brethren at my side, we will be ready to aid Malfurion.

english.title: Out of the Dream
english.objectives: Awaken $1oa Druids of the Claw.
english.description: Malfurion Stormrage... A name I have not heard in centuries.$B$BHe was teacher to many of us. If he seeks my audience, I cannot refuse.$B$BI will go to the Grove of Cenarius, but first, we must awaken the rest of my clan. They slumber with no way of waking.$b$bA mysterious force of great power is at work against us.$B$BI am still too weak from my hibernation. Please, stranger, go and free them from their dreams.
english.completion: Well done, hero. With my brethren at my side, we will be ready to aid Malfurion.

text.title: 酋长的念珠
text.objectives: 与燃皮林地的斯古克长老交谈。
text.description: 氏族酋长所佩戴的仪式念珠，上面带有贝壳和羽毛的装饰。$B$B或许斯古克长老会对它感兴趣。
text.completion: Graw was the first to succumb to the madness, and the rest of the clan followed.$B$BWith these, I will take the reins as our clan's new chieftain.$B$BThank you, traveler. I will do my best to rebuild my clan.

english.title: The Chieftain's Beads
english.objectives: Speak to Elder Sookh at Smolderhide Thicket.
english.description: The ceremonial beads, decorated with shells and feathers, are worn by the clan's chieftain.$B$BPerhaps Elder Sookh would be interested in seeing these.
english.completion: Graw was the first to succumb to the madness, and the rest of the clan followed.$B$BWith these, I will take the reins as our clan's new chieftain.$B$BThank you, traveler. I will do my best to rebuild my clan.

text.title: 纠结的梦境
text.objectives: 消灭墨菲尔。
text.description: 我感受到了兽穴深处散发出的强大魔力。$B$B不管下面是什么东西，他施放了一个强大的法术，把我们困在了梦境之中。$B$B我仍然十分虚弱，但你的能力让人刮目相看，英雄。我能理解玛法里奥为什么会信任你。$B$B请你去消灭这魔法的根源。
text.progress: Кто-то сковал нас нечистой магией.
text.completion: In my dreams, I saw the satyr's leader. His face was familiar, though I could not see it clearly.$B$BI pray to Elune that it is not too late. I will go to Malfurion at once.

english.title: Entangled Dreams
english.objectives: Kill Morphael.
english.description: I sense powerful magic emanating from deep within the barrow.$B$BWhatever is down there weaves a powerful spell, entangling us within our dreams.$B$BI am still too weak, but your skills are quite impressive, hero. I can see why Malfurion puts his trust in you.$B$BGo and eliminate the source of this magic.
english.progress: Кто-то сковал нас нечистой магией.
english.completion: In my dreams, I saw the satyr's leader. His face was familiar, though I could not see it clearly.$B$BI pray to Elune that it is not too late. I will go to Malfurion at once.

text.title: 返回林地
text.objectives: 返回瓦尔莎拉的塞纳留斯林地，与玛法里奥·怒风谈一谈。
text.description: 既然我的族人已经到齐，我们可以返回塞纳留斯林地了。$B$B到达以后，请去找玛法里奥。我们要找出塞纳留斯的病因。
text.completion: Wonderful. The Archdruids have already assembled.

english.title: Return to the Grove
english.objectives: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Grove of Cenarius in Val'sharah.
english.description: Now that my clan is assembled, we shall return to the Grove of Cenarius.$B$BSpeak to Malfurion when you arrive. We will find out the cause of Cenarius' illness.
english.completion: Wonderful. The Archdruids have already assembled.

text.title: 熔铸碎片
text.objectives: 克里斯汀·石铸想让你收集25块钢铁部落碎片。
text.description: 我们已经取得了突破性进展，现在能更好地熔化你收集来的那些碎片！如果你能给我多找来一些的话，我们就能为你的士兵们打造出更加有用的装备了。
text.progress: Do you have the scraps I've asked for?
text.completion: Here ya are, commander. We've got to let the forges cool for a while, but we should be ready to process more scraps tomorrow.
text.completed: Return to Kristen Stoneforge at your Garrison.

english.title: Scrap Meltdown
english.objectives: Kristen Stoneforge wants you to collect 25 Iron Horde Scraps.
english.description: We've had a breakthrough in melting down the scraps you've been collecting! If you can get me a small pile of 'em, we can get your troops something a bit more useful.
english.progress: Do you have the scraps I've asked for?
english.completion: Эй, командир. Мы сейчас охлаждаем горнила, но когда ты принесешь обломки. мы уже снова будем готовы к работе.
english.completed: Return to Kristen Stoneforge at your Garrison.

text.title: 密报：突袭石怒崖
text.objectives: 突袭霜火岭石怒崖的血槌食人魔。
text.description:
来自霜火岭的血槌食人魔一直在整个大陆的各条贸易路线上伏击往来商人，还强迫被俘的士兵在他们的炉渣矿井里工作。

暗影猎手洛坎下令救出那些被囚禁在石怒崖血槌大本营里的友方军队士兵。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Stonefury Cliffs
english.objectives: Assault the Bloodmaul ogres at Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description:
Bloodmaul ogres from Frostfire Ridge have been ambushing trade routes throughout the continent, and are putting captured soldiers to work in their slag mines.

Shadow Hunter Rokhan has requested the rescue of friendly troops that have been taken prisoner in the main Bloodmaul compound at Stonefury Cliffs.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭石怒崖的血槌军队

text.title: 密报：突袭玛戈纳洛克
text.objectives: 攻击霜火岭玛戈纳洛克的石头怪物。
text.description:
巨大的玛戈隆、戈隆还有其它石头怪物一直威胁着我们的要塞。它们大多数都是从北边的玛戈纳洛克来的。

如果我们突袭它们的老巢，应该就能迫使敌人撤退了。虽然这样做有风险，但却是眼下最好的对策。在那的时候顺便找回我们的补给品吧。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Magnarok
english.objectives: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description:
Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our garrison. Most seem to originate from Magnarok, just to the north.

If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭玛戈纳洛克的石头怪物

text.title: 密报：突袭钢铁军工厂
text.objectives: 突袭霜火岭钢铁军工厂的钢铁部落军队。
text.description:
钢铁部落的战争机器正在被成批成批地运送到战场上来，而我们的军队正在死守阵线。大多数战争机器都是在霜火岭东边的钢铁军工厂里制造出来的。

如果可以对军工厂发起战略突袭，破坏并瓦解钢铁部落的行动，或许就能扭转战局。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Iron Siegeworks
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description:
Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.

A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭钢铁军工厂的钢铁部落军队

text.title: 密报：突袭永茂丛林
text.objectives: 突袭戈尔隆德永茂丛林的木精部队。
text.description:
木精和它们召唤出的植物畸兽一直在渐渐蚕食着我们北边的哨站。我们每杀死一个植物怪，似乎都会生出新的来顶替它的位置。

洛坎想出了一个直捣敌人腹地——永茂丛林的计划。他认为这样一来就能把敌人引回戈尔隆德的丛林里，给我们争取到更多与之周旋的余地。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Everbloom Wilds
english.objectives: Assault the Botani forces in the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.
english.description:
Botani and the plant monstrosities they conjure have been slowly encroaching on our outposts in the north. For every plant we kill, new ones seem to rise in its place.

Rokhan has put together a plan for striking at the heart of their lands, in Everbloom Wilds. He thinks this will draw them back into the jungles of Gorgrond, giving us more room to maneuver around them.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭永茂丛林的木精部队

text.title: 密报：突袭破碎悬崖
text.objectives: 突袭纳格兰破碎悬崖的独眼魔部队。
text.description:
巨大的独眼魔一直在冲击着我们的前线，而且不管我们干掉多少个，敌人似乎都会前仆后继地不断涌来。

这些独眼魔大多数都是从纳格兰遥远西部的破碎悬崖来的。如果我们想在接下来的战斗中立于不败之地，就必须想办法把这些独眼魔从战场上赶走。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Broken Precipice
english.objectives: Assault the ogron forces at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
english.description:
Massive ogron have been battering our frontlines, and no matter how many we down, there seem to be more to replace them.

Most of these ogron appear to be coming from the Broken Precipice, deep in western Nagrand. If we're to stand a chance in the coming battles, we need to find a way to remove these ogron from the battlefield.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

text.title: 密报：突袭莫高尔岗哨
text.objectives: 突袭纳格兰莫高尔岗哨的战歌兽人。
text.description:
来自莫高尔岗哨的战歌掠夺者对高墙之外的一切都不放过。我们已经告诫旅行者不要在外单独行动，可很多人还是置若罔闻。

要是我们突袭莫高尔岗哨的话，几乎肯定能让战歌士兵们忙于撤退防守，从而牵制他们在纳格兰大部分的骑兵力量。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Mok'gol Watchpost
english.objectives: Assault the Warsong force at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.
english.description:
Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.

If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭日泉岗哨的战歌部队

text.title: 密报：突袭黑潮栖木
text.objectives: 突袭影月谷黑潮栖木的钢铁部落军队。
text.description:
双头飞龙又重新出现在了我们对抗钢铁部落的战场上。倘若我们不从源头上遏制它们的话，很快就会失去对道路的控制权，被迫撤回哨站。

这些多出来的双头飞龙很有可能是从影月谷东南部的黑潮栖木飞来的。如果我们赶快行动，应该还来得及破坏敌人的行动。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Darktide Roost
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
There's been a resurgence of rylaks on the battlefield in our skirmishes against the Iron Horde. If we don't stop them at the source, we'll quickly lose control of the roads and be pushed back into our outposts.

The most likely source of these additional rylaks is in southeastern Shadowmoon Valley, at Darktide Roost. If we move quickly, we should be able to stop their operation cold.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭黑潮栖木的钢铁部落军队

text.title: 密报：突击索克雷萨高地
text.objectives: 攻击影月谷索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队。
text.description:
近来有情报显示，在影月谷南边索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队呈现出了日渐频繁的活动之势。

索克雷萨的门徒对整个德拉诺都构成了威胁。决不能让那些家伙在我们鞭长莫及的地方建立落脚点。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Socrethar's Rise
english.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
Recent reports suggest a notable rise of activity by Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in southern Shadowmoon Valley.

Socrethar's disciples pose a threat all over Draenor. We must not allow them to gain a foothold so far from our reach.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队

text.title: 密报：突袭失落的安苏鸦巢
text.objectives: 攻击阿兰卡峰林失落的安苏鸦巢附近的敌对生物。
text.description:
我们有一些最出色的斥候，在失落的安苏鸦巢遗迹附近失踪了。

洛坎要求派遣任何可用的人手去查明威胁，并看看遗迹间还有没有我们的幸存者。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Lost Veil Anzu
english.objectives: Assault the hostile creatures at Lost Veil Anzu in Spires of Arak.
english.description:
Some of our best scouts have gone missing in the vicinity of the lost ruins of Veil Anzu.

Rokhan has requested any available resources be dispatched to identify the threat and see if any of our men yet remain alive within the ruins.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭失落的安苏鸦巢附近的生物

text.title: 密报：突袭命运之柱
text.objectives: 突袭影月谷命运之柱的影月部队。
text.description:
影月氏族的残余力量继续在阿兰卡峰林东部边界的群山里蠢蠢欲动。

洛坎担心他们离通往影月谷的咽喉要道过近，会是个隐患，要求我们尽快削减他们的兵力。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Pillars of Fate
english.objectives: Assault the Shadowmoon forces at Pillars of Fate in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
Remnants of the Shadowmoon clan continue to operate out of the peaks on the eastern border of Spires of Arak.

Rokhan is concerned at their proximity to key choke points leading into Shadowmoon Valley, and has put out a request that we thin their forces as soon as possible.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭命运之柱的影月部队

text.title: 密报：突袭斯克提斯
text.objectives: 突袭阿兰卡峰林斯克提斯的鸦人部队。
text.description:
我们不断收到关于鸟人在南边伏击，以及焚烧途径主干道路车队的报告。

哨站的卫兵们请求我们对阿兰卡峰林斯克提斯处的鲁克玛信徒们发起反击。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Skettis
english.objectives: Assault the arakkoa forces at Skettis in Spires of Arak.
english.description:
We've been receiving regular reports of birdmen from the south ambushing and burning caravans along the main roads.

Guards from our outposts are requesting that we launch a counter attack against the main presence of Adherents of Rukhmar at Skettis in Spires of Arak.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭斯克提斯的鸦人部队

text.title: 密报：突袭沙塔斯港口
text.objectives: 突袭塔拉多沙塔斯城的萨格雷军队。
text.description:
沙塔斯城现在处于萨格雷军队的控制下，他们的首领是索克雷萨，曾经的大主教。

沙塔斯城东部区域的暗影议会军队正在虚空恶魔的帮助下壮大自己的力量，必须要在他们对我们的行动构成威胁前斩草除根。
text.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Shattrath Harbor
english.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at Shattrath City in Talador.
english.description:
Shattrath City is in the hands of Sargerei forces under the leadership of the once Exarch, Socrethar.

The Shadow Council forces in the eastern portion of the city are gaining in power through the aid of demons from the Nether, and need to be culled before they become a threat to all of our operations.
english.completion: News about da assault beat ya back, boss-mon. And some spoils of the fightin'.$B$BYa be a force to be reckonin' with.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭沙塔斯城的萨格雷军队

text.title: 熔铸碎片
text.objectives: 戈伦莱克想让你收集25块钢铁部落碎片。
text.description: 我们已经想出了能让那些碎片发挥更大用处的办法，使你的军队从中受益。给我多带些来，我会让我们的铁匠为你加工。
text.progress: Do you have the scraps I've asked for?
text.completion: Very good, commander. This should prove useful to your troops.
text.completed: Return to Grun'lek at your Garrison.

english.title: Scrap Meltdown
english.objectives: Grun'lek wants you to collect 25 Iron Horde Scraps.
english.description: We've figured out how to make those scraps in to something a bit more useful to your troops. Bring me a pile of them and I'll have our smiths process it for you.
english.progress: Do you have the scraps I've asked for?
english.completion: Very good, commander. This should prove useful to your troops.
english.completed: Return to Grun'lek at your Garrison.

text.title: 密报：突袭石怒崖
text.objectives: 突袭霜火岭石怒崖的血槌食人魔。
text.description:
来自霜火岭的血槌食人魔一直在整个大陆的各条贸易路线上伏击往来商人，还强迫被俘的士兵在他们的炉渣矿井里工作。

伯德里克·格雷下令救出那些被囚禁在石怒崖血槌大本营里的友方军队士兵。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Stonefury Cliffs
english.objectives: Assault the Bloodmaul ogres at Stonefury Cliffs in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description:
Bloodmaul ogres from Frostfire Ridge have been ambushing trade routes throughout the continent, and are putting captured soldiers to work in their slag mines.

Bodrick Grey has requested the rescue of friendly troops that have been taken prisoner in the main Bloodmaul compound at Stonefury Cliffs.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭石怒崖的血槌军队

text.title: 密报：突袭玛戈纳洛克
text.objectives: 攻击霜火岭玛戈纳洛克的石头怪物。
text.description:
巨大的玛戈隆、戈隆还有其它石头怪物一直威胁着我们西边哨站的安全。它们大多数都是从霜火岭的玛戈纳洛克来的。

如果我们突袭它们的老巢，应该就能迫使敌人撤退了。虽然这样做有风险，但却是眼下最好的对策。在那的时候顺便找回我们的补给品吧。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Magnarok
english.objectives: Assault the stone monstrosities at Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description:
Colossal magnaron, gronn, and other stone monstrosities have been threatening our outposts in the west. Most seem to originate from Magnarok in Frostfire Ridge.

If we strike at them at their home, we should be able to force them back. It's risky, but it may be our best move. While you're there, see if you can recover any of our supplies.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭玛戈纳洛克的石头怪物

text.title: 密报：突袭钢铁军工厂
text.objectives: 突袭霜火岭钢铁军工厂的钢铁部落军队。
text.description:
钢铁部落的战争机器正在被成批成批地运送到战场上来，而我们的军队正在死守阵线。大多数战争机器都是在霜火岭东边的钢铁军工厂里制造出来的。

如果可以对军工厂发起战略突袭，破坏并瓦解钢铁部落的行动，或许就能扭转战局。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Iron Siegeworks
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.
english.description:
Iron Horde war machines are being shipped onto battlefields by the dozens, and our forces are struggling to hold their ground. Most of these machines seem to be originating from the Iron Siegeworks in eastern Frostfire Ridge.

A strategic attack to disrupt and dismantle the Iron Horde at the siegeworks could be just what we need to turn the tide of the war.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭钢铁军工厂的钢铁部落军队

text.title: 密报：突袭永茂丛林
text.objectives: 突袭戈尔隆德永茂丛林的木精部队。
text.description:
木精和它们召唤出的植物畸兽一直在渐渐蚕食着我们北边的哨站。我们每杀死一个植物怪，似乎都会生出新的来顶替它的位置。

伯德里克·格雷想出了一个直捣敌人腹地——永茂丛林的计划。他认为这样一来就能把敌人引回戈尔隆德的荒野，给我们争取到更多与之周旋的余地。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Everbloom Wilds
english.objectives: Assault the botani forces in the Everbloom Wilds of Gorgrond.
english.description:
Botani and the plant monstrosities they conjure have been slowly encroaching on our outposts in the north. For every plant we kill, new ones seem to rise in its place.

Bodrick Grey has put together a plan for striking at the heart of their lands, in Everbloom Wilds. He thinks this will draw them back into the wilds of Gorgrond, giving us more room to maneuver around them.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭永茂丛林的木精部队

text.title: 密报：突袭破碎悬崖
text.objectives: 突袭纳格兰破碎悬崖的独眼魔部队。
text.description:
巨大的独眼魔一直在冲击着我们的前线，而且不管我们干掉多少个，敌人似乎都会前仆后继地不断涌来。

这些独眼魔大多数都是从纳格兰遥远西部的破碎悬崖来的。如果我们想在接下来的战斗中立于不败之地，就必须想办法把这些独眼魔从战场上赶走。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Broken Precipice
english.objectives: Assault the ogron forces at the Broken Precipice in Nagrand.
english.description:
Massive ogron have been battering our frontlines, and no matter how many we down, there seem to be more to replace them.

Most of these ogron appear to be coming from the Broken Precipice, deep in western Nagrand. If we're to stand a chance in the coming battles, we need to find a way to remove these ogron from the battlefield.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

text.title: Missive: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
text.objectives: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
text.description:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds are rousing champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent them from mustering the forces they need to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to make.
text.completed: Return to Scout Valdez at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Missive: Assault on the Gorian Proving Grounds
english.objectives: Assault the ogre forces at the Gorian Proving Grounds in Nagrand.
english.description:
The ogres at the Gorian Proving Grounds are rousing champions to turn against our forces in Nagrand.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent them from mustering the forces they need to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to make.
english.completed: Return to Scout Valdez at your garrison in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 密报：突袭莫高尔岗哨
text.objectives: 突袭纳格兰莫高尔岗哨的战歌兽人。
text.description:
来自莫高尔岗哨的战歌掠夺者对高墙之外的一切都不放过。我们已经告诫旅行者不要在外单独行动，可很多人还是置若罔闻。

要是我们突袭莫高尔岗哨的话，几乎肯定能让战歌士兵们忙于撤退防守，从而牵制他们在纳格兰大部分的骑兵力量。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Mok'gol Watchpost
english.objectives: Assault the Warsong forces at Mok'gol Watchpost in Nagrand.
english.description:
Warsong raiders out of Mok'gol Watchpost have been terrorizing anything and everything not behind a tall wall. We've warned travelers not to stray out alone, but many don't listen.

If we were to launch an assault on Mok'gol Watchpost, we would almost certainly put the Warsong back on the defensive, restricting most of their riders to Nagrand.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭日泉岗哨的战歌兽人

text.title: 密报：突袭黑潮栖木
text.objectives: 突袭影月谷黑潮栖木的钢铁部落军队。
text.description:
双头飞龙又重新出现在了我们对抗钢铁部落的战场上。倘若我们不从源头上遏制它们的话，很快就会失去对道路的控制权，被迫撤回哨站。

这些多出来的双头飞龙很有可能是从影月谷东南部的黑潮栖木飞来的。如果我们赶快行动，应该还来得及解决这个麻烦。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Darktide Roost
english.objectives: Assault the Iron Horde forces at Darktide Roost in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
There's been a resurgence of rylaks on the battlefield in our skirmishes against the Iron Horde. If we don't stop them at the source, we'll quickly lose control of the roads and be pushed back into our outposts.

The most likely source of these additional rylaks is in southeastern Shadowmoon Valley, at Darktide Roost. If we move quickly, we should still have time to get ahead of the problem.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

objectiveDetails.description: 突袭黑潮栖木的钢铁部落军队

text.title: 密报：突击索克雷萨高地
text.objectives: 攻击影月谷索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队。
text.description:
近来有情报显示，在影月谷南边索克雷萨高地的萨格雷军队呈现出了日渐频繁的活动之势。

索克雷萨的门徒对德莱尼和我们的要塞都构成了威胁。我们得尽快压制住他们才行。
text.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

english.title: Missive: Assault on Socrethar's Rise
english.objectives: Assault the Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in Shadowmoon Valley.
english.description:
Recent reports suggest a notable rise of activity by Sargerei forces at Socrethar's Rise in southern Shadowmoon Valley.

Socrathar's disciples pose a threat to draenei and our garrison alike. We need to quell them at our soonest convenience.
english.completion: Word of the assault has already made it back, as have some spoils from the fight.$B$BWell done sir, if you don't mind me saying.

A decisive assault on their training grounds should prevent dem from musterin' the forces dey be needin' to stand against us, and will help remind them that we are not an enemy they want to be makin'.

text.title: 查丽妮酒庄
text.objectives: 收集夜玫瑰配方的三张残页。
text.description: 外来者，请你帮帮我。$b$b我原本要把夜玫瑰配方进献给艾萨拉女王陛下，但是卑鄙的酿酒师把它抢走了，还把我关了起来。$b$b拜托你去找回我的配方，好让我把它呈给查丽妮夫人，以赢得女王的欢心。
text.progress: Have you found the pieces of the recipe?
text.completion: Thank you, outsider! Thank you very much.$B$BYou have done more for me than my own people ever have.$B$BLady Challiane would never take the word of a lowly cellarman over her vintners.$B$BNow I can use this recipe to earn her favor, and then the favor of our beloved queen Azshara...

english.title: Challiane Vineyards
english.objectives: Collect the 3 parts of the Nightrose recipe.
english.description: Please, outsider, help me.$b$bMy recipe for Nightrose wine was to be the toast of Queen Azshara herself. But before I could make it, the vile vintners took it from me and locked me away.$b$bPlease, recover my recipe so that I might bring it to Lady Challiane and earn the queen's favor.
english.progress: Ты $gнашел:нашла; части рецепта?
english.completion: Thank you, outsider! Thank you very much.$B$BYou have done more for me than my own people ever have.$B$BLady Challiane would never take the word of a lowly cellarman over her vintners.$B$BNow I can use this recipe to earn her favor, and then the favor of our beloved queen Azshara...

text.title: 巡视
text.objectives: 跟随空军上将罗杰斯，为天火号的出航做准备。
text.description: 你肯定在疑惑，这些是什么情况。请跟我一起走走吧。$B$B在出航之前，有些准备工作需要完成，而且我知道你的出现一定会让船员们备受鼓舞。
text.completion: Are you with us?

english.title: Making the Rounds
english.objectives: Follow Sky Admiral Rogers and prepare the Skyfire to set sail.
english.description: You must be wondering what all of this is about. Please, walk with me.$B$BI have some final preparations to make before we set sail, and I know that your presence will inspire the crew.
english.completion: Are you with us?

objectiveDetails.description: 向第七军团龙骑兵致意

text.title: 远古试炼
text.objectives: 到阿格拉玛的宝库附近寻找哈维。
text.description:
<乌鸦凝视着你的双眼，一个怪异的声音在你的脑海里回荡。>

我知道你是谁，勇士，我也知道你在找什么。

如果你觉得自己实力非凡，就来找我吧。
text.completion: I'm sure your head is filled with questions. Answers will come, in time.$B$BI am Havi, and my words are those of the Valarjar - the glorious keepers of the Halls of Valor. $B$BYou will need my help if it is the Aegis you seek. Oh yes, I know your goals outsider. As I know many things...
text.completed: 在阿格拉玛的宝库附近与哈维谈一谈。
text.giverWindow: 不知为何，这个奇怪的维库老人好像很了解你……

english.title: The Ancient Trials
english.objectives: Find Havi near Aggramar's Vault.
english.description:
<As the raven stares into your eyes, an odd voice fills your mind.>

I know who you are, champion, and I know what you seek.

Come to me, if you think yourself truly worthy.
english.completion: I'm sure your head is filled with questions. Answers will come, in time.$B$BI am Havi, and my words are those of the Valarjar - the glorious keepers of the Halls of Valor. $B$BYou will need my help if it is the Aegis you seek. Oh yes, I know your goals outsider. As I know many things...
english.completed: Speak with Havi near Aggramar's Vault.
english.giverWindow: This strange old vrykul seems to know you somehow...

text.title: 获得线索
text.objectives: 在卡纳克废墟寻找线索。
text.description: 阿卡塔说，他曾经在这片废墟中见过塞泰克，食人魔，甚至恶魔，但没看到过艾斯卡的影子。$b$b如果想要找到线索的话，我们可能不得不亲自进去看看。我想由你这么强壮的人来带路应该再合适不过了。$b$b嗯，你怎么看？
text.progress: The binding is dirty yet the pages are still in good condition. Upon the bottom of the binding is written "Property of Iskar."
text.completion: This tome looks like the one Iskar used to carry. What could have caused him to leave it?

english.title: Get a Clue
english.objectives: Search the Ruins of Kra'nak for clues.
english.description: Aktar mentioned that in the ruins he's seen Sethekk, ogres, even demons, but no sign of Iskar.$b$bWe're going to have to go in there if we're to find any clues and I'd prefer someone strong like yourself to lead the way.$b$bWell, what do you say?
english.progress: The binding is dirty yet the pages are still in good condition. Upon the bottom of the binding is written "Property of Iskar."
english.completion: Это, судя по всему, один из фолиантов Искара. Но зачем он оставил его здесь?

text.title: 黑暗升华
text.objectives: 在卡纳克废墟和瑞沙德谈谈。
text.description: 你粗略地浏览了一下这些书本，大部分都是关于暗影与幻象本质的注解。在最后一页你发现了一段游记：$B$B我继续寻找着治愈塞泰诅咒的方法。如果泰罗克能够以本体回归，我也不至于沦落到这步田地。该死的瑞沙德！$B$B我认识了一个兽人，他自称叫古尔丹，知道如何治愈这种诅咒！我必须到塔纳安去，找到他的“密文”所在的地方。$B$B把这个消息告诉瑞沙德。
text.progress: I wish it had not come to this...
text.completion: Thank you, $n.$B$BThis was no easy task and I am grateful once again for your assistance. Iskar's madness must be stopped.$B$BI trust that when the time comes you will be ready.

english.title: Dark Ascension
english.objectives: Speak to Reshad in the Ruins of Kra'nak.
english.description: You skim through the pages of the tome, most of them filled with notes on the nature of shadow and illusion. On the last pages you discover a journal:$B$BI continue to search for a cure to the curse of Sethe. If Terokk was restored I would not be in this situation. Damn Reshad!$B$BI was contacted by an orc that identified himself as Gul'dan. He has a cure for the curse! I must travel to Tanaan to search for the location of this "cipher" of his.$B$BTake this information to Reshad.
english.progress: I wish I didn't get to that ...
english.completion: Спасибо тебе, $n.$b$bЭто было непростое дело, и я снова очень благодарен тебе за помощь. Искар окончательно обезумел, и его нужно остановить.$b$bЯ надеюсь, ты будешь $gготов:готова;, когда пробьет решающий час.

text.title: 巫母之死
text.objectives: 消灭玛古拉。
text.description: 我这漫长的一生都致力于学习并完善治疗与恢复的艺术。$b$b世上让我最痛心的事莫过于杀生，旅行者。$b$b我怀着无比沉痛的心情委托你去消灭鹰身人的首领玛古拉，她们已经威胁到了这片林地。$b$b但愿她的死亡能够挽救更多高贵的生命。
text.completion: May peace again fill our sacred grove.

english.title: Death to the Witchmother
english.objectives: Slay Magula.
english.description: The numberless years of my life have been dedicated to learning and perfecting the arts of healing and restoration.$b$bNothing in this world pains me more than taking a life, traveler.$b$bIt is with a heavy heart that I must commission the death of Magula, the leader of the harpies that threaten this grove.$b$bMay her death save the lives of more noble beings.
english.completion: May peace again fill our sacred grove.

text.title: 仆从！消灭它们！
text.objectives: 完成达格洛普的合约需求。
text.description: 依照契约规定，你需要帮我为一个绝对无害的仪式收集补给品。$b$b我需要羽毛和犄角，大量的犄角。看到奥利维安影障的暗影奔马、徘徊者和苍鹭了吗？它们身上应该有很多。$b$b噢！我还需要橄榄，超级多的橄榄，每根手指一个。$b$B仆从，走吧！
text.progress: This land is ripe for the taking. Especially the olives. They are really ripe. And I love ripe olives.
text.completion: Mmmm. Olives. I love these things. They are the only reason worth to come to this filthy world.

english.title: Minion! Kill Them!
english.objectives: Fulfill your part of the deal with Daglop.
english.description: Per your contract you will help me gather supplies for a perfectly harmless ritual.$b$bI need feathers, and horns. Lots of horns. See those shadowrunners, prowlers and heron over there in the Olivian Veil? They should have lots of both.$b$bOh! And I need olives. Lots of olives. One for each finger.$b$BMinion! Let's ride!
english.progress: Эта земля только и ждет, чтобы ее захватили. Она давно созрела. Особенно оливки. Спелые, сочные оливки. Я их просто обожаю.
english.completion: Mmmm. Olives. I love these things. They are the only reason worth to come to this filthy world.

text.title: 石化恶疾
text.objectives: 营救玛诺·学叶、厄文·雾沼和德尔萨纳·贤林。
text.description: 塞纳留斯需要我？$b$b如果可以的话我肯定会尽快动身，可是其他的德鲁伊正身处险境，我现在不能离开。有一些邪恶的鹰身人女巫在觊觎我的林地，想将这里占为己有。$b$b这些害虫会散播一种石化恶疾，时间一久，就会夺走感染者的生命。$b$b虽然我希望所有的追随者都能得救，但是我们必须优先拯救那些资深的信徒，这样他们才能在我离开的时候保护林地。$b$b如果你愿意伸出援手，请找到我的信徒，并帮助他们脱离危险。
text.completion: Your arrival was a blessing, friend.$b$bAnde'thoras-ethil.

english.title: Solid as a Rock
english.objectives: Rescue Marnor Lorleaf, Erwind Mistfen and Del'thanar Sagewood.
english.description: Cenarius requires me?$b$bI shall depart as soon as I am able, but I mustn't leave while my druids are in danger. A vile harpy coven has emerged and seeks to claim my grove as their own.$b$bThese vermin inflict a petrifying disease which, given time, will destroy the infected.$b$bWhile I wish for all of my followers to be cured, it is crucial that my elder disciples survive to protect the grove in my absence.$b$bIf you would assist us, find my disciples and rouse them from this terrible state.
english.completion: Your arrival was a blessing, friend.$b$bAnde'thoras-ethil.

text.title: 明码标价
text.objectives: 帮助达格洛普完成仪式。
text.description: 为了执行仪式，我在暗缚兽穴的一个特别的洞穴里做了些准备。$b$b到那里跟我会合，我会“给”你奖励。呵呵。
text.completion: Great deal right? You got to kill a demon, your fancy weapon got more fancy, and I get to be the master now. Everybody wins!

english.title: This IS In My Contract.
english.objectives: Help Daglop complete his ritual.
english.description: To perform my ritual I need to use a special cave I have prepared at Gloombound Barrow.$b$bMeet me there and I will "give" you your reward. Hee hee.
english.completion: Great deal right? You got to kill a demon, your fancy weapon got more fancy, and I get to be the master now. Everybody wins!

objectiveDetails.description: 与达格洛普交谈以开始仪式

text.title: 重见天日的魔法之力
text.objectives: 在你要塞的矿井附近找到奇怪的石头。
text.description: 指挥官，我听说在要塞矿井里发现了一块奇怪的石头。矿工们不知道它能干什么用，可直觉告诉我，那块石头肯定大有用处。$b$b等你下次去矿井时，也许应该调查一番。要是你不介意的话，不妨拿来让我看看。
text.progress: Greetings sir. Have you found the stone?
text.completion: So it's as I imagined, a battle-stone!$B$BI've been able to collect similar stones here in Draenor, but never one this large! A rare find indeed.
text.completed: Return to Lio the Lioness in your garrison.

english.title: Unearthed Magic
english.objectives: Find the Strange Stone near your garrison mine.
english.description: Commander, I've heard reports of a strange stone found in the garrison mine.  The miners aren't sure what to make of it, but I have a feeling it could be useful.$b$bWhen you next find yourself at the mine, it may be worth investigating.  And if you don't mind, I would love to see the stone for myself.
english.progress: Greetings sir. Have you found the stone?
english.completion: So it's as I imagined, a battle-stone!$B$BI've been able to collect similar stones here in Draenor, but never one this large! A rare find indeed.
english.completed: Return to Lio the Lioness in your garrison.

text.title: 重见天日的魔法之力
text.objectives: 在你要塞的矿井附近找到奇怪的石头。
text.description: 指挥官，矿工们在我们的矿井里发现了带有强大魔力的东西。他们不知道该怎么处理，也许你该去看看？$b$b要是你能找到它，就把它带来交给我，好让我仔细检查下上面的魔法。
text.progress: Where be the stone?
text.completion: Ah sure, I be findin' stones like this everywhere in Draenor, but never one dis big!
text.completed: Return to Serr'ah in your garrison.

english.title: Unearthed Magic
english.objectives: Find the Strange Stone near your garrison mine.
english.description: Commander, da miners be findin' somethin' in our mine with strong mojo.  They don' be knowin' what ta do with it, so maybe you gonna go overe dere and check it out?$b$bIf you find it, bring it here so I can look closer at da magic.
english.progress: Where be the stone?
english.completion: Ah sure, I be findin' stones like this everywhere in Draenor, but never one dis big!
english.completed: Return to Serr'ah in your garrison.

text.title: 图腾的呼唤
text.objectives: 摧毁梦魇图腾。
text.description: 我偶然听到了其他人的谈话，我可能知道他们如此害怕的原因。$B$B他们说酋长有一个神秘的图腾，这给他带来了力量，以及恐怖的幻觉。$B$B如果你能摧毁那个图腾，就能终结这场疯狂。
text.completion: Thank you, $n! My nephew is returned to me.$B$BHe explains that the source of the madness comes from a powerful totem, deep in our village. $B$BIt makes sense, but who - or WHAT - gave us such a thing?$B$BI will share this knowledge with the druids at once.

english.title: Totemic Call
english.objectives: Destroy the Nightmare Totem.
english.description: I heard the others talking earlier. I may know the cause of their fear.$B$BThey say the Chieftain has a mysterious totem. It gives him power, and fearful visions.$B$BIf you destroy the totem, the madness will end.
english.completion: Thank you, $n! My nephew is returned to me.$B$BHe explains that the source of the madness comes from a powerful totem, deep in our village. $B$BIt makes sense, but who - or WHAT - gave us such a thing?$B$BI will share this knowledge with the druids at once.

text.title: 突袭卡纳克废墟
text.objectives: 突袭塔纳安丛林卡纳克废墟的暗影议会军队。
text.description:
暗影议会招募了塞泰克和其他渴求力量的鸦人为他们效力。我们那些觉醒教派的盟友一路追踪他们，到达了塔纳安西边的一座废墟，暗影议会就在那里向他们传授恶魔的法术。

我们必须在他们掌握那可怕的力量之前向他们发动攻击。
text.completion: Welcome back, commander. Our scouts just returned with word of your success.$B$BWell done!

english.title: Assault on the Ruins of Kra'nak
english.objectives: Assault the Shadow Council forces at the Ruins of Kra'nak in Tanaan Jungle.
english.description:
The Shadow Council have recruited the Sethekk and other power hungry Arakkoa to their service. Our allies in the Order of the Awakened have tracked them to a ruin in the west of Tanaan where the Shadow Council is instructing them in the use of fel magic.

We must strike at them before they can master their diabolic powers.
english.completion: Welcome back, commander. Our scouts just returned with word of your success.$B$BWell done!
