text.title: 要塞战役：战争议会
text.objectives: 与要塞议政厅中的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 瓦里安国王亲临你的要塞，整个要塞都沸腾了。$b$b国王与其随行人员已经在议政厅等你了，他们将与你一同探讨针对塔纳安丛林的进攻计划。让他等太久可不明智。
text.completion: <The King is studying maps of Tanaan Jungle and the surrounding area.>$b$b$n! The Alliance owes you a great debt for establishing this garrison. Thanks to your bravery and commanding leadership, we've fought this war here on Draenor, instead of amongst our own homes and farmsteads.$b$bIt's time now to finish this. Are you ready for the final campaign?
text.completed: 与要塞议政厅中的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王谈一谈。

english.title: Garrison Campaign: War Council
english.objectives: Speak with King Varian Wrynn inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
english.description: Your garrison is in an uproar. King Varian Wrynn himself is visiting your fortress to discuss your invasion plan for Tanaan Jungle.$b$bThe King is ready for you inside your town hall along with his full retinue. It would be wise not to keep him waiting...
english.completion: <The King is studying maps of Tanaan Jungle and the surrounding area.>$b$b$n! The Alliance owes you a great debt for establishing this garrison. Thanks to your bravery and commanding leadership, we've fought this war here on Draenor, instead of amongst our own homes and farmsteads.$b$bIt's time now to finish this. Are you ready for the final campaign?
english.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn inside the Town Hall of your garrison.
english.giverWindow: King Wrynn is waiting for you.

text.title: 列车“事故”
text.objectives: 收集炸药和一个引爆器。
text.description: 自从古尔丹控制钢铁部落后，不少兽人站出来抗议，一些人因此而成了阶下囚。其中就有一位工程天才：索洛格·拉克——人称“钢铁造船师”。正是他设计了这里的码头还有兽人舰队的无畏舰。假如我的情报正确的话，他眼下就在那列监狱列车里……而且说服他倒戈应该不难！$b$b收集一些爆炸品然后去东南边的列车那里跟伊瑞尔碰头！
text.progress: Commander, it's you! Naielle promised she would send someone.
text.completion: Roark is definitely in this prisoner train but it's locked tight. We'll have to - oh - you brought explosives? Naielle thinks of everything! Let's crack this car open and see if we can convince that engineer to defect...

english.title: Derailment
english.objectives: Collect Explosive Charges and a Detonator.
english.description: Several orcs have spoken out since Gul'dan assumed control. Some were taken prisoner. Among them is an engineering prodigy: Solog Roark, "The Iron Shipwright." He designed these docks as well as the great dreadnaughts of the orcish fleet. If my scouts are right, he's in that prison train as we speak... And he may be ready to defect!$b$bGather explosives and meet with Yrel at the train to the southeast!
english.progress: Commander, it's you! Naielle promised she would send someone.
english.completion: Рырк совершенно точно находится в этом поезде, но сам выбраться не сможет. Нам придется... Ой, ты $gпринес:принесла; взрывчатку? Найель снова все продумала! Давай-ка вышибем дверь вагона и попробуем убедить этого инженера отправиться с нами...

text.title: 拦截囚车
text.objectives: 使用引爆器炸开监狱列车，说服拉克加入你们。
text.description: 我的游侠会包围住这列车厢。你负责用引爆器炸开厢门。$b$b我会试着和拉克谈一谈，看他是否有意加入我们。他是干船坞这方面的行家，也是能帮我们造出码头的最好人选。$b$b假如不成功的话，我们就不得不杀了他。要是再弄出第二支钢铁舰队，我们就有好果子吃了……
text.completion: Lower your weapon, stranger. Blackhand is dead and our new "Warchief" just signed my death sentence. It looks like I'm going mercenary.$B$BYou want to build a shipyard? Then you want me.

english.title: The Train Gang
english.objectives: Use the detonator to blow open the prison train, and convince Roark to join your cause.
english.description: These rangari will surround and cover the train car. Hit the detonator to blow open the doors.$b$bI will try to talk Roark into joining our cause. He's a genius around a drydock and our best hope for building a shipyard.$b$bIf it doesn't work, we must be prepared to kill him. The last thing we need is someone rebuilding another Iron Fleet...
english.completion: Убери свое оружие, $gнезнакомец:незнакомка;. Чернорук мертв, а наш новый "вождь" только что подписал мне смертный приговор. Так что я готов податься к вам в наемники.$b$bВам нужна пристань? Значит, вам нужен я.

text.title: 钩子，绳子，然后……干掉他！
text.objectives: 使用黑石爪钩抵达纳尔的碉堡。杀死他并夺取拉克的船坞图纸。
text.description: 我会帮你造一座船坞。而且造出来的不会是像这边这样大肆浪费资源的垃圾疙瘩。$b$b不过我需要图纸。古尔丹把这座港口转交给海军上将纳尔后，我的作品就都被他没收了。$b$b<拉克吐了口唾沫。>$b$b他现在已经喝下了古尔丹的绿色毒汁，坐在高处发号施令。我们要爬上去干掉他。
text.progress: I will rebuild.
text.completion: <Solog Roark takes in the view of his harbor one final time.>$B$BWe built it all for nothing, $C. Gul'dan will claim whatever your troops do not destroy.$B$BNext time, I will build something that will last.

english.title: Hook, Line, and... Sink Him!
english.objectives: Use a Blackrock Grapple to reach Knar's bunker. Slay him to obtain Roark's Shipyard Blueprints.
english.description: I can build you a shipyard. And not some wasteful piece of over-engineering like this place.$b$bBut I'm going to need my blueprints. My work was confiscated when Gul'dan turned this harbor over to Admiral Knar.$b$b<Roark spits.>$b$bGul'dan's green poison courses through Knar's veins. He's calling the shots from on high. We'll need to grapple up there to take him out.
english.progress: I will rebuild.
english.completion: <Solologist Ryrk looks around the port for the last time. >$b$b All this was a waste of time, |3-6($c). Anything you do not destroy will go to Gul'dan. $b$b Nothing, my next creations will last for centuries.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用爪钩抵达纳尔的碉堡

text.title: 我们需要造船师
text.objectives: 前往钢铁码头与大主教奈丽谈一谈。你的要塞飞行管理员可以送你去那里。
text.description: 钢铁部落——或者不论古尔丹把他们改造成了什么——已经全面撤回塔纳安并巩固了那座丛林的入口。从正面突击会造成很大的伤亡。$b$b然而海路的防守却较为薄弱。假若我们同时从陆地和海上展开攻击，古尔丹的部落将退无可退。$n，现在该造一座船坞！$b$b我们需要充分利用德拉诺的当地资源。前往钢铁码头，我已经派了一支联盟的物资回收部队去那等你。把你能弄到的设备都弄来，再给我们找个能造出舰队的造船师。
text.completion: Commander! I was told to expect you. The situation here is chaos.$B$BMy Rangari have had this place under surveillance since your original assault. It's come back to life in recent weeks as the remnants of the Iron Horde flee to Tanaan under Gul'dan's orders.$B$BMy scouts have learned something that might interest you...
text.completed: 前往钢铁码头与大主教奈丽谈一谈。你的要塞飞行管理员可以送你去那里。

english.title: We Need a Shipwright
english.objectives: Travel to the Iron Docks and speak with Exarch Naielle. Your Garrison Flight Master can provide transport.
english.description: The Iron Horde - or whatever Gul'dan is turning them into - has fallen back and fortified the entrance to Tanaan. A direct assault will take a heavy toll.$b$bHowever, the sea lanes are open. If we attack by both land and sea, Gul'dan's Horde will have no quarter. $n, it's time to build a shipyard!$b$bWe'll need to source local resources. Travel to the Iron Docks, where a small Alliance reclamation force is already waiting. Gather what equipment you can, and find us a shipwright capable of building a fleet!
english.completion: Командир! Мы тебя ждали. У нас тут полный хаос.$b$bПосле штурма мои рангари постоянно вели наблюдение за этим местом. Буквально несколько недель назад наши враги активизировались. По приказу Гул'дана остатки Железной Орды отступают в Танаан.$b$bМои разведчики раздобыли весьма интересные сведения...
english.completed: Travel to the Iron Docks and speak with Exarch Naielle. Your Garrison Flight Master can provide transport.

text.title: 无可留恋
text.objectives: 回到要塞的议政厅，向乌瑞恩国王报告进展。
text.description: 这里没有任何可以让我留恋的东西了。昔日的氏族兄弟反目成仇，而古尔丹正在腐化我剩下的同胞。$b$b不过你和你那些沙塔斯来的盟友还没有放弃抗争。如果你们保证会废黜古尔丹，我就会站在你们这边。我会到你的要塞去，与你一起建造一座伟大的船坞，它将统治德拉诺的红色海洋！$b$b告诉你的手下，我来了。
text.completion: You found us a shipwright then? Good! Some of your followers are eager to take to the open seas.
text.completed: 向要塞议政厅中的乌瑞恩国王报告进展。

english.title: Nothing Remains
english.objectives: Report back to King Wrynn at the Town Hall in your garrison.
english.description: Nothing is left for me here. My old clanmates have turned into foes, and Gul'dan is desecrating what remains of my people.$b$bYou and your allies from Shattrath still have some fight left. If you pledge to depose Gul'dan, I will stand by your side. I will go to this garrison of yours and together we will build a shipyard that will rule the red seas of Draenor!$b$bLet your people know I am coming.
english.completion: Ну что, нашелся корабел? Да? Отлично! Некоторые твои соратники с нетерпением ждут, когда смогут выйти в море.
english.completed: Report to King Wrynn at the Town Hall in your garrison.

text.title: 港口总动员
text.objectives: 收集足够的资源，为你的要塞建造一座等级1的船坞。
text.description: 快让这个“钢铁造船师”开工吧，指挥官。假如我们想要实现从海陆两路夹攻塔纳安的计划，就得立马弄出能运作的码头。你要和拉克合作，为联盟建造一座船坞！$b$b我之前看到拉克往要塞的西北方去了，就在日暮港附近。
text.progress: I'll need building materials, commander. You can't build docks from mud.
text.completion: <Roark scans the horizon.>$B$BYes, here. A good natural bay. The remains of that old warship can be gutted and turned into your first transport.$B$BI see you've gathered all the materials we need. Are you ready?

english.title: All Hands on Deck
english.objectives: Gather materials and construct a Level 1 Shipyard for your garrison.
english.description: Let's put this "Iron Shipwright" of yours to work, commander. If we're to pull off your plan to assault Tanaan from both land and sea, we'll need to get some docks operational as soon as possible. Work with Roark and build the Alliance a shipyard!$b$bLast I saw, Roark was northwest of the garrison, near Eventide Landing.
english.progress: I'll need building materials, commander. You can't build docks from mud.
english.completion: <Parts the horizon. >$b$bThis is a great place. A quiet bay is the right place. From the wreckage of this old warship, you can build your first transport.I see you already have all the materials you need. Well, shall we get started?

text.title: 上面的朋友
text.objectives: 到阿卡塔的岗哨与瑞沙德碰面。
text.description: 艾斯卡不见了，现在暗影议会开始对我们节节进逼。这些事情之间不可能毫无关联。我们必须到他最后一次现身的地方去，卡纳克废墟。$b$b我已经让一位朋友在那附近修建了一个营地。按我的看法，我们最好抓紧到那里去继续搜索。
text.completion: Ah, $n. You're just in time.$B$BAktar says the Shadow Council are teaching the Sethekk their vile ways. There are even a group of High Arakkoa that have joined the Shadow Council's banner!$B$BI wonder how does Iskar factor into this?

english.title: Friends Above
english.objectives: Meet with Reshad at Atkar's Post.
english.description: Iskar disappeared and now the Shadow Council is at our throats. These can't be unrelated events. We need to go to the last place he was seen, the ruins of Kra'nak.$b$bI've asked a friend to set up a camp nearby. I say we head there to continue our search.
english.completion: Ah, $n, you're just in time. $b$bThe actor told me that the Council of Shadows had begun to teach the shadows their dark arts. Under the banners of the Council of Shadows rose even some of the higher Arakkoas!$b$bI still don't get it, what role does Iskar play in all this?

text.title: 找到杀手
text.objectives: 在泽斯高附近找到袭击血环氏族的杀手。
text.description: 有了这张地图，你就可以精确地找到攻击的源头。是时候找出那些发动这些攻击的人了，也正好看看有没有可能把他们变成盟友。
text.completion: You... remember me? I came through the portal with you. I was called... Ariok. Before I became this.
text.completed: 在塔纳安丛林的泽斯高跟杀手谈一谈。

english.title: Finding the Killer
english.objectives: Locate the slayer of Bleeding Hollow near Zeth'Gol.
english.description: With this map, you have pinpointed the origin of the attacks. It is time to see who or what is behind the attacks, and if they are a possible ally.
english.completion: Ты... помнишь меня? Я прошел с тобой через портал. Меня когда-то звали... Ариок. До того, как я превратился... в это.
english.completed: Speak with the slayer at Zeth'Gol in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 跟随沾着血迹的路径
text.objectives: 跟随阿里乌克前往洞穴。
text.description: 我杀死的那些人……他们提到了一个洞穴。血环氏族的圣地。基尔罗格也许在那儿——我要出发了。
text.completion: Old earth... old blood. I smell Kilrogg. He has been here.
text.completed: 在塔纳安丛林的血环氏族洞穴外面和阿里乌克谈谈。

english.title: Following the Bloody Path
english.objectives: Follow Ariok to the cave.
english.description: The ones I kill... they speak of a cave. Sacred to the Bleeding Hollow. Kilrogg could be there - I am going.
english.completion: Старая земля... старая кровь. Я чую Килрогга. Он был здесь.
english.completed: Speak with Ariok outside the Bleeding Hollow cave in Tanaan Jungle.

text.title: 血环谷
text.objectives: 抵达血环谷最深处。
text.description: 这座洞穴吸引着我。它将愤怒的灵魂禁锢在此。基尔罗格在这里施放了魔法。你让我明白了……
text.completion: You step on hallowed ground, invader. Here the chieftains of the Bleeding Hollow have performed rituals to see the future.$B$BYou should die but there is much at stake...

english.title: The Bleeding Hollow
english.objectives: Reach the bottom of the Bleeding Hollow.
english.description: The cave pulls me. It keeps angry spirits near. Kilrogg has done magic here. You help me understand...
english.completion: Ты ступаешь по священной земле, $gиноземец:чужестранка;. Здесь вожди клана Кровавой Глазницы проводили свои ритуалы, чтобы заглянуть в будущее.$b$bЗа это ты $gдолжен:должна; поплатиться жизнью – но слишком многое поставлено на карту...

text.title: 血环谷的灵魂
text.objectives: 杀死$1oa只被激怒的血魂。
text.description:
很明显，强大的鬼魂正在保卫着这个洞穴，他们是血环氏族的祖先。

不管谷底有什么，先收拾掉这些灵魂之后再去处理，肯定会容易很多。
text.completion: После того как множество духов было повержено, аура ненависти, излучаемая пещерой, ощутимо ослабла.

english.title: Spirits of the Bleeding Hollow
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Enraged Blood Spirits.
english.description:
It is clear the cave is protected by powerful ghosts, ancestors of the Bleeding Hollow.

Whatever is down there, it will be easier to deal with if many of the spirits were dealt with first.
english.completion: После того как множество духов было повержено, аура ненависти, излучаемая пещерой, ощутимо ослабла.

text.title: 基尔罗格之眼
text.objectives: 找到基尔罗格之眼，举行占卜仪式。
text.description:
如果想要知道基尔罗格和他的新主人有什么企图，你需要找到他的眼睛。在仪式完成之后，所有的酋长会都把他们的眼睛放到边上的地窟里，由血环氏族的鬼魂保护着。

在地窟里找到基尔罗格的眼睛。其他酋长不会和我们站在一边，他们会为了它与你战斗。

拿到眼睛后把它放到附近的仪式印记上，就可以找到你要的答案了。
text.progress: What have you learned?
text.completion: Bah. Kilrogg not here. Only omens and warnings. That is your path $n, mine is to destroy Kilrogg...

english.title: The Eye of Kilrogg
english.objectives: Find the Eye of Kilrogg and perform the scrying ritual.
english.description:
If you wish to know what Kilrogg and his new master intend, you will need his eye. After the ritual all chieftains place their eye under the protection of the ghosts of the Bleeding Hollow in the next chamber.

Go and locate the Eye of Kilrogg in the vault. The other chieftains will not stand with us, and will fight you for it.

Then place it on the ritual mark nearby to get your answers.
english.progress: What have you learned?
english.completion: Ха! Килрогга здесь нет... Только предостережения и дурные предзнаменования. Это твой путь, $n, а я должен убить Килрогга...

text.objectives: 进入艾萨拉之眼，击败督军帕杰什和艾萨拉之怒。艾萨拉之眼是个五人地下城，请记得带上几个好友一起冒险。
text.description:
$n，督军帕杰什进入了前面的魔法漩涡。他已经回到东南方向的一座岛屿。艾萨拉女王正在那里集结更多兵力，

女王因为我们的反抗而怒不可遏。现在，她正在召唤一个名为艾萨拉之怒的怪物，企图展开复仇并淹没破碎群岛。

你必须赶在女王放出艾萨拉之怒毁灭一切以前，消灭那个怪物！
text.completion: <The Tidestone of Golganneth stands whole and unprotected.>

english.title: Eye of Azshara: Wrath of Azshara
english.objectives: Enter the Eye of Azshara, then defeat Warlord Parjesh and the Wrath of Azshara. The Eye of Azshara is a dungeon so be certain to gather some friends to undertake this perilous journey.
english.description:
$n, Warlord Parjesh ran into the magical vortex just ahead. He has returned to an island off the shore to the southeast where Queen Azshara is staging more of her forces.

The queen is beyond angry because we opposed her. Even now, she is summoning up a monstrosity known as her Wrath to exact revenge for our defiance and drown the Broken Isles.

You must defeat the Wrath of Azshara before the queen lets it loose to destroy us all!
english.completion: <Golgannet's Tidal Stone is unharmed and unprotected. >

text.title: 德拉诺的小动物们
text.objectives: 在宠物对战中击败收藏家爱瑞斯。
text.description: 我喜欢收集宠物，而且已经在德拉诺发现了几个罕见的小家伙。你想跟我打一场吗？要是你能击败我这几员小将，我想我们都会从这场切磋中受益匪浅的。
text.completion: Not bad. Not bad at all. Stop by the next time I'm in the neighborhood, and I might have some new pets to check out.

text.objectives: Speak to Malfurion Stormrage at Lorlathil in Val'Sharah.
text.description: Greetings, hero.$b$bWelcome to Val'sharah. It has been an age since I have set foot in these precious woods. Too long...$b$bOur work here is simple. We must call upon my mentor, Cenarius, and learn where he safeguards the Tears of Elune. Consider your visit here a brief respite.$b$bCome, this will not take long.

text.title: 神秘的笔记本
text.objectives: 把笔记本交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。
text.description: 这本书早已变得面目全非。上面除了水渍就是明显的动物啃咬留下的痕迹，但幽暗城“金光闪闪”的盗贼区附近的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞也许能有办法看出端倪。

english.title: Mystery Notebook
english.objectives: Return the notebook to Estelle Gendry in the Undercity.
english.description: This book has seen better days. Not much can be made out between the waterlogging and the apparent animal bites, but a few poor attempts at poetry center around the "radiant glow" of the Undercity and someone named Estelle Gendry.
english.completion: <Estelle pages through the damaged tome and sighs wistfully.>$B$BOh dear, another paramour dead! Draenor has a terrible habit of eating my lovers alive.

text.title: 大酋长的召唤
text.objectives: 使用皇家召令，然后跟随纳萨诺斯·凋零者穿过杜隆塔尔传送门。
text.description: 你好，$p。我代表希尔瓦娜斯·风行者欢迎你的到来。我想你应该对这个名字很熟悉。$B$B<纳萨诺斯将一封密函塞到你手里。>$B$B读完之后跟我走。$B$B你识字的吧？
text.progress: If only she hadn't ordered me to take you to her.$gsafe and sound:safe and sound;...
text.completion: Satisfied?

english.objectives: Read the Royal Summons and follow Nathanos Blightcaller through the portal to Durotar.
english.description: Greetings, $p. I am here on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. I should hope you recognize the name.$B$B<Nathanos thrusts a sealed envelope into your hand.>$B$BRead it and follow me.$B$BYou can read, can't you?
english.progress: If only she hadn't ordered me to take you to her.$gsafe and sound:safe and sound;...
english.completion: Satisfied?

objectiveDetails.description: 向黑暗女王的舰队报到

text.title: 监视黑喙崖
text.objectives: 前往黑喙崖，从间谍大师响哨身上获取军情七处的情报。
text.description: 我们发现有联盟的人从天火号空降到黑喙崖。$B$B虽然我在飞越的时候无法确认他们的数量和位置，但是我的确看到树上缠着降落伞，而且地上还有大量的鸦熊。$B$B如果那里真有敌人的话，他们肯定在潜伏着观察我们的行动。$B$B我在崖顶安插了一名骑兵，在我前往风暴峡湾的时候继续监视。$B$B——亡灵骑兵莉萨·库伦，第一联队
text.progress: <The Dwarf Spy guarded a detailed account of the location of the Forsaken forces.>
text.completion: <You have a quick look at the report, which shows that other SHRU spies besides the Tihoswist were active in this area. >
text.giverWindow: 库伦肯定是在动身执行其他任务之前写了这份报告留给纳萨诺斯。

english.title: Eyes in the Overlook
english.objectives: Recover the SI:7 Intel from Spymaster Knockwhistle in Blackbeak Overlook.
english.description: Alliance personnel from the Skyfire were spotted parachuting into Blackbeak Overlook.$B$BI was unable to confirm numbers or positions during my flyover, but I did see parachutes tangled in treetops and a LOT of ravenbears on the ground.$B$BIf anyone is up there, they must be laying low and keeping an eye on us.$B$BI have posted a rider at the top of the overlook to keep watch while I press forward into Stormheim.$B$B- Liza Cullen, Dread-Rider - 1st Wing
english.progress: <The Dwarf Spy guarded a detailed account of the location of the Forsaken forces.>
english.completion: <You have a quick look at the report, which shows that other SHRU spies besides the Tihoswist were active in this area. >
english.giverWindow: Cullen must have left this report for Nathanos before heading off on another mission.

text.title: Content Perk: Call of the Highlord

english.title: Content Perk: Call of the Highlord

text.title: 钩深致远
text.objectives: 取得一把雷铸爪钩枪，然后在赫达沙尔的城墙外面与罗娜·克罗雷见面。
text.description:
这么说来，这些试炼能带领我们获得神盾，而且下一个试练在那座山上？这可能有点麻烦。

要上山就必须要穿过那个维库人城市，而且他们大门紧闭。但我们应该可以用爪钩翻过去。如果你没有爪钩枪，就用我这个从维库人身上搞来的备用品吧。

我会在前方侦察，看看能否找到一个潜入的好位置。
text.progress: Ну что, удачно?
text.completion: That looks like it'll do the job nicely. $B$BLet's get in there before we're spotted.

english.title: A Grapple a Day
english.objectives: Pick up a Stormforged Grapple Launcher and meet Lorna Crowley outside the wall of Hrydshal.
english.description:
So these trials are what will get us the Aegis, and the next one is on the top of that mountain? That may prove problematic.

The only way I see up the mountain is through that vrykul city, and the gates are shut tight. We should be able to grapple over, though. If you don't have a launcher, I managed to wrangle a spare from one of these vrykul.

I'll scout ahead and see if I can find a good spot to get in.
english.progress: Ну что, удачно?
english.completion: That looks like it'll do the job nicely. $B$BLet's get in there before we're spotted.

text.title: DEPRECATED
text.objectives: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
text.description:
You know what would boost morale around here?

Bass. Beats. Music!

Everyone loves a party! You go out and get me some hardware, and I'll make a system that will shatter Draenor itself.
text.completed: This is completion text.
text.turninWindow: You've got everything? It's all in pretty rough shape, but I'll handle it. One B.O.O.M. Box coming up, Commander!

english.title: DEPRECATED
english.objectives: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
english.description:
You know what would boost morale around here?

Bass. Beats. Music!

Everyone loves a party! You go out and get me some hardware, and I'll make a system that will shatter Draenor itself.
english.completed: This is completion text.
english.turninWindow: You've got everything? It's all in pretty rough shape, but I'll handle it. One B.O.O.M. Box coming up, Commander!

text.title: 伪装大师
text.objectives: 消灭间谍大师伊兰迪丝和间谍大师施韦德。
text.description: <你翻阅响哨的报告。>$B$B“我的降落伞被炮弹的碎片打中了，重重地摔到一个鸦熊的巢穴里面。幸运的是，一堆鸟蛋缓解了我坠落的冲力。$B$B虽然我没有看到伊兰迪丝和施韦德，但是他俩都擅于伪装，我相信他们不会被敌人发现。$B$B我只需要把隐蔽装置上面的蛋液清理干净，就可以继续监视敌人的行动。希望母兽别在附近……
text.completion: Finally, I can get back to the action!

english.title: Masters of Disguise
english.objectives: Slay Spymaster Illandris and Spymaster Shwayder.
english.description: <You scan over Knockwhistle's report.>$B$B"My chute caught a piece of shrapnel. Made a rough landing in a ravenbear nest. Luckily, a bunch of eggs broke my fall.$B$BLost sight of Illandris and Shwayder. Both are masters of disguise, and I am confident they can remain undetected.$B$BWill continue to monitor the enemy's activity. Just need to clean all the yolk off my cloaking device. Hope the mother's not around...
english.completion: Наконец-то снова в бой!

text.title: 飞檐走壁
text.objectives: 在山梁顶端发射雷铸爪钩枪，利用它飞越赫达沙尔的城墙。
text.description:
你已经拿到爪钩枪，我们应该可以潜入城市了。那边的墙上好像就有一个合适的爪钩锚点，可以从这边山脊上勾到。

进去以后，我会试着溜过守卫，去摸清山路的情况。如果你可以帮我分散一下他们的注意力，我会非常感激。一切顺利的话，我会在上城区跟你会合。

祝你好运！
text.completion: You should've seen the look on those vrykuls' faces when you came sailing over their wall! $B$BI could see that launcher coming in handy in a lot of places. You'd best hold on to it.

english.title: No Wings Required
english.objectives: Go to the top of the ridge and use the Stormforged Grapple Launcher to launch over the wall at Hrydshal.
english.description:
Now that you've got the launcher, we should be able to infiltrate the city. It looks like there's a good spot to grapple onto on the wall just past us. There's a vantage point on top of this ridge.

Once we're in, I'll try to slip past the guards and get a look at the mountain path. I'd appreciate if you could make some distractions for me. If all goes well, I'll meet up with you in the upper city.

Good luck!
english.completion: You should've seen the look on those vrykuls' faces when you came sailing over their wall! $B$BI could see that launcher coming in handy in a lot of places. You'd best hold on to it.

text.title: 回到林地
text.objectives: 回瓦尔莎拉的塞纳留斯林地找玛法里奥·怒风。
text.description: 现在，我的林地已经平安无事，我终于可以专心对付你提到的威胁了。$B$B听到塞纳留斯的困境着实令人不安。去告诉玛法里奥，我会到塞纳留斯林地跟他汇合的。
text.completion: Wonderful. The Archdruids have already assembled.

english.title: Return to the Grove
english.objectives: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Grove of Cenarius in Val'sharah.
english.description: Now that my grove is safe, I can turn my attention to the threat you speak of.$B$BTo hear of Cenarius' plight is disturbing indeed. Tell Malfurion that I shall meet him at the Grove.
english.completion: Wonderful. The Archdruids have already assembled.

text.title: 回到林地
text.objectives: 回瓦尔莎拉的塞纳留斯林地找玛法里奥·怒风。
text.description: 原谅我，$r。大德鲁伊月爪的陨落是极其沉重的打击……$b$b必须把这里发生的一切告诉玛法里奥。告诉他绍恩已经牺牲，而萨维斯也回到了这个世界。$b$b请尽快，朋友。恐怕这是瓦尔莎拉有史以来面临的最大威胁。
text.completion: Thaon will be dearly missed. We may not have always seen eye to eye, but he was a great druid and a true protector of the vale.$B$BXavius will pay for his death...

english.title: Return to the Grove
english.objectives: Return to Malfurion Stormrage at the Grove of Cenarius in Val'sharah.
english.description: Forgive me, $r. Archdruid Moonclaw's fall is a terrible blow...$b$bMalfurion must be informed of what has transpired here. Inform him of Thaon's fate and of the return of Xavius.$b$bMake haste, friend. I fear this may be the greatest threat Val'sharah has ever faced.
english.completion: Thaon will be dearly missed. We may not have always seen eye to eye, but he was a great druid and a true protector of the vale.$B$BXavius will pay for his death...

text.title: 诅咒饰物
text.objectives: 在冥狱深渊收集8个被诅咒的骨头。
text.description:
等等！在你匆忙离开之前，我们或许能带上除了海草以外的东西。 

你看到了吗，维库人的身上还带着一些骨头——他们把这些骨头当成珠宝一样佩戴。如果你能搞到这种四处堆放的骨头，我们就能更好地进行伪装了。

你还在等什么？
text.progress: Make sure ye've got enough bones before we move on.
text.completion: Ah yes, these will do. $B$BNow lets see what we can make to fool old Guarm, eh?

english.title: Accessories of the Cursed
english.objectives: Collect 8 Cursed Bones in Helheim.
english.description:
Wait! Before ye go rushin' off, we might want to be gettin more than just seaweed. 

Ye see, these vrykul also be carrying bones with them - worn all over like jewelry. If ye can get yer hands on some of the bones they got lyin around, it'll add to the disguise.

So what ye waitin for?
english.progress: Прежде чем двигаться дальше, надо набрать побольше костей.
english.completion: Ah yes, these will do. $B$BNow lets see what we can make to fool old Guarm, eh?

text.title: 哈维的试练
text.objectives: 将一篮根茎蔬菜、一桶螃蟹以及饱满的维库谷物扔进哈维的炖锅中。
text.description:
从你踏上这片土地时，我就感受到了你的力量。你肩负一件伟大而艰巨的任务。

要知道，阿格拉玛之盾安置在父神的殿堂之中。你必须证明自己的英勇，才能从敌人手中取得圣盾。

为此，你将面临诸多试炼，但首先，我要知道你的实力。我的炖菜尚未完成，但我这把老骨头已经没法把食材拿上山了。

你的手臂看起来挺有力气的。你愿意帮我这个老人煮好炖菜吗？
text.progress: Приятно пахнет, правда?
text.completion: Hah, you throw like a shieldmaiden!$B$BWhat? That's a good thing! $B$BTry the stew, young champion, and savor the taste of a task well done.

english.title: Havi's Test
english.objectives: Toss ingredients from the Basket of Root Vegetables, Barrel of Crabs, and Hearty Vrykul Grains into Havi's Stewpot.
english.description:
I could sense your power the moment you arrived in this land. You carry great purpose and a heavy task.

Know that the Aegis of Agrammar rests in the high halls of the All-Father. Only if you prove your valor, can you claim it against your foe.

Many trials must you face for this, but first I must know your strength. My stew is incomplete, and my old bones couldn't carry the ingredients up the hill. 

You look like you have a good arm. Will you help an old man finish his stew?
english.progress: Приятно пахнет, правда?
english.completion: Hah, you throw like a shieldmaiden!$B$BWhat? That's a good thing! $B$BTry the stew, young champion, and savor the taste of a task well done.

text.title: 游侠之王
text.objectives: 向纳萨诺斯·凋零者报到。
text.description: 很高兴看到你从海难中活下来。纳萨诺斯也活了下来，只不过他那张脸看起来更丑了。$B$B他带了一队游侠到北边去寻找希尔瓦娜斯的下落——战斗结束后她就不知所踪。$B$B他要你在苏醒之后跟上去找他。
text.completion: <Nathanos narrows his eyes at the wreckage of Sylvanas' ship.>$B$BShe's out there... she has to be.
text.completed: 向纳萨诺斯·凋零者报到。

english.title: The Ranger Lord
english.objectives: Report to Nathanos Blightcaller.
english.description: Good to see you survived the wreck. Nathanos made it as well, though his face is now even uglier than before.$B$BHe took a group of rangers north to look for Sylvanas - nobody has seen her since the battle.$B$BHe asked me to send you his way if you ever woke up.
english.completion: <Natanos squinting at the wreckage of Silvana's ship. >$B$BShe's around here somewhere... She should be close by.
english.completed: Report to Nathanos Blightcaller.

text.title: 龙鳞护甲
text.objectives: 从赫达沙尔的风暴之翼幼龙身上收集鳞片。
text.description: 看来这附近的维库人喜欢用龙鳞来装饰护甲。$B$B如果你能从这里的幼龙身上收集足够的材料，或许可以做出一些有用的东西。
text.progress: Oh, what do you have there?
text.completion: Good thinking gathering up these scales. $B$BIt should be simple enough to make a solid piece of armor from them.

english.title: Built to Scale
english.objectives: Collect Storm Drake Scales from the Stormwing drakes in Hrydhsal.
english.description: The vrykul around here seem to use scales from these drakes to fashion their armor. $B$BIf you were able to gather enough material from the local drakes, you may be able to make something useful out of it.
english.progress: Ну, что у тебя там?
english.completion: Good thinking gathering up these scales. $B$BIt should be simple enough to make a solid piece of armor from them.

text.title: 杀敌夺草
text.objectives: 从冥狱深渊的克瓦迪尔召雾者和掠魂者身上收集$1oa片海草。
text.description:
虽然不清楚你在这里做什么，但是我仍然十分感谢你。可你如果要继续前进的话，就必须经过那条叫高姆的魔犬。

我在多次尝试之后想出了一个计划。如果能搞到这些克瓦迪尔带在身上的海草，我们也许就能骗过那条笨狗。你要知道，高姆虽然凶残，但是不太聪明。

你觉得怎么样？你能放倒几个克瓦迪尔吗？
text.progress: Do ye have enough for a proper disguise?
text.completion: Wait... ye killed how many kvaldir? Yer braver than I thought, outsider!$B$BI'm sure Helya will see that neither ye nor I belong here once we get past that dog of hers.

english.title: A Little Kelp From My Foes
english.objectives: Collect $1oa pieces of seaweed from Kvaldir Mistcallers and Soulflayers in Helheim.
english.description:
I'm not sure what yer doin' here, but ye have my thanks. If ye want to get any further, though, ye'll need to get past that foul dog, Guarm.

I've tried meself a few times, and I think I have a plan. If we can get some of the seaweed these kvaldir wear, we might be able to trick the mutt. Guarm's mean, ye see, but not too smart.

What do ye say? Think ye can take on a few kvaldir?
english.progress: Ну что, хватает тебе водорослей для маскировки?
english.completion: Wait... ye killed how many kvaldir? Yer braver than I thought, outsider!$B$BI'm sure Helya will see that neither ye nor I belong here once we get past that dog of hers.

text.title: 另辟蹊径
text.objectives: 在赫达沙尔打败古朗·鳞心，然后爬上塔楼顶部。
text.description:
哎，桥那边行不通了。那把爪钩枪还在你手上吧？

我们似乎可以利用那边的塔楼，从塔顶穿过去。不过首先，我们得搞定坐在前面的那个丑大个儿。

你先上。
text.completion: Well, there's no stopping you, is there?

english.title: Another Way
english.objectives: Defeat Gunnlaug Scaleheart in Hrydshal, then climb to the top of the tower.
english.description:
Well, the bridge option is out. You still got that grapple launcher handy?

It looks like we can get across from the top of that tower over there. First thing's first, though, we'll need to deal with the big ugly sitting out front.

You take point.
english.completion: Well, there's no stopping you, is there?

text.title: 神秘的笔记本
text.objectives: 把笔记本交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。
text.description: 这本书早已变得面目全非。上面除了水渍就是明显的动物啃咬留下的痕迹，但你还是分辨出里面写了某些在铁炉堡拼酒的故事，还提到了一个名叫克罗姆·粗臂的矮人。
text.completion: Oh now, this brings back some memories. Y'didn't look at the scores did you?$B$BThis belonged to ol' Nolan, may he rest in peace. Not a very good explorer, but a helluva drinker.

english.title: Mystery Notebook
english.objectives: Return the notebook to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.
english.description: This book has seen better days. Not much can be made out between the waterlogging and the apparent animal bites, but you can make out some sort of Ironforge-based drinking game scoring system involving a dwarf named Krom Stoutarm.
english.completion: Yeah, it brings back memories. You didn’t look: you looked; by the numbers?$b$bIt belonged to old Nolan, may he rest in peace. He was not the best researcher, but he was strong in hops!

text.title: 集币成狂
text.objectives: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。你可以通过完成每天的第一个《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城来获取德拉诺错币。
text.description:
我也不想显得太过冷酷，但诺兰恐怕不可能完好无缺地回来了，就连能不能找到他的全尸都是个未知数。

诺兰酷爱收集稀有硬币。他常常会为了收集硬币而环游世界，现在还为寻找几枚崭新的德拉诺硬币丢了性命。听着——我可以让你看看这些硬币长什么样，你给我再找几枚来，我打算开个展览来纪念他。
text.progress: How's the coin hunt going?
text.completion: These are in great condition. Nolan would be green with envy.
text.end: 把德拉诺错币交给铁炉堡的克罗姆·粗臂。
text.completed: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

english.title: Numismatics
english.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
english.description:
I hate to be too cynical, but I don't think we're gonna find Nolan in one piece. Or in a lot of pieces.

Nolan was a nut for finding rare coins. He's been from one end of the world to the other finding them, and now he's gone and gotten himself killed looking for more mint condition Draenei coins. Tell you what - let me show you what these coins look like, you bring me a few more of them and I'll set up an exhibit in his honor.
english.progress: How's the coin hunt going?
english.completion: These are in great condition. Nolan would be green with envy.
english.end: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.
english.completed: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

text.title: 集币成狂
text.objectives: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。你可以通过完成每天的第一个《德拉诺之王》随机英雄地下城来获取德拉诺错币。
text.description:
我早就劝他不要犯傻了！他迟早都会为几枚钱币丢掉性命的！现在好了，有的人就是不见棺材不掉泪。

现在我得麻烦你走一趟。你眼光很准对吧？麻烦你行行好，帮我再去弄几枚这样的硬币来好吗？我需要它们来……做研究。
text.progress: Well? Do you have the coins I asked you to find?
text.completion: Excellent work. I knew you'd be useful, sugarplum.$B$BThere's something very unusual about these coins...
text.end: 把德拉诺错币交给幽暗城的艾斯特蕾·根德瑞。
text.completed: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

english.title: Numismatics
english.objectives: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity. Misprinted Draenic Coins can be found when completing your first Random Heroic Draenor dungeon each day.
english.description:
I told him this was a fool's errand. Of course he would get himself killed over a handful of coins! Oh well, there are always new lovers to find.

You'll have to do in the mean time. And you are quite easy on the eyes, aren't you? Be a dear and find me more coins that look like this one? I need them for... research.
english.progress: Well? Do you have the coins I asked you to find?
english.completion: Excellent work. I knew you'd be useful, sugarplum.$B$BThere's something very unusual about these coins...
english.end: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.
english.completed: Bring Misprinted Draenic Coins to Estelle Gendry in Undercity.

text.title: 海草伪装
text.objectives: 使用克瓦迪尔伪装从高姆身边溜过去。
text.description:
好了！伪装完成了！

不要太在意味道，拿着。如果我们闻起来也像克瓦迪尔，伪装效果可能会更好。但是我有预感，等我们离开之后可能得找个牧师才能把这股臭味净化掉。
text.progress: О боги, что это за вонь?! $B$BНу если эта маскировка еще и не сработает!..
text.completion: That was a truly revolting, outsider. Even in death I've never witnessed such a disgusting smell.

english.title: Stealth by Seaweed
english.objectives: Use the Kvaldir Disguise to sneak by Guarm.
english.description:
There! The disguise be complete!

Don't mind the smell, there. It's probably better that we smell like the kvaldir, as well. Though I have a feeling I'll be needin a priest to get this stench out once we're gone.
english.progress: О боги, что это за вонь?! $B$BНу если эта маскировка еще и не сработает!..
english.completion: That was a truly revolting, outsider. Even in death I've never witnessed such a disgusting smell.

text.title: 动感低音
text.objectives: 收集低音炮、镭射读碟器、音效增幅器、S.P.R.K.电容器和古木电线。
text.description:
相对这片战火纷飞、动荡不安的大陆来说，这地方有点太过安静了。

但你运气不错，指挥官！我能改变这个局面，还能让你的士兵们士气大振。

你只要从德拉诺各地帮我找几样东西来，我就能让你的要塞里充满音乐。我甚至愿意贡献出几张私人珍藏的唱碟来帮你开个好头！

这主意怎么样？
text.progress: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
text.completion: This is the best Draenor has to offer? Lucky for you I went to engineering school. One Tune-O-Tron 5000 coming up!

english.title: Bringing the Bass
english.objectives: Collect a Bass Blaster, Laz-Tron Disc Reader, Phonic Amplifier, S.P.R.K. Capacitor, and a Cord of Ancient Wood.
english.description:
It's a bit quiet around here, in between the invasions and all.

You're in luck though, Commander! I can fix that, and boost morale among your troops all at the same time.

All you need to do is bring me a few items from around Draenor, and I'll fill your garrison with music. I'll even throw in a few music rolls from my own collection to get you started!

What do you say?

text.title: 副作用可能包括轻度亡灵化
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个变异熊或变异水手。
text.description: 曝露在这种特殊“副产品”中的后果非常可怕。$B$B细胞的快速衰竭会让主体成为呆滞的躯壳，失去理智和思考能力，并且充满暴力和对温暖生命的强烈憎恶。$B$B和你想象的一样，本地的动物已经被溢出物质感染了。噢，还有大部分的船员……$B$B不管怎么说，祝你好运！
text.completion: The R.A.S. is nothing if not humane.

english.title: Side Effects May Include Mild Undeath
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Volatile Bears or Volatile Sailors.
english.description: Exposure to this particular "byproduct" is quite nasty.$B$BRapid cell degeneration quickly reduces the subject to a shambling husk incapable of any reason or thought beyond a violent, throbbing hatred for the warmth of life.$B$BAs you might imagine, the local fauna have been affected by the spill. Oh, and most of the crew as well...$B$BAnyway, good luck!
english.completion: Королевское фармацевтическое общество выступает исключительно за гуманность.

text.title: 废料密封
text.objectives: 用密封装置收集易爆废料。
text.description: 黑玫瑰号曾是皇家药剂师协会的航海实验室。船上自然有一些不稳定的……“副产品”。$B$B可惜的是，在我们和联盟舰艇的冲突之中，有一种这类物质被泄露了出去。如你所见，它让沿岸损失惨重。$B$B在我们进一步深入内陆之前，协会必须进行补救。$B$B请拿上一个密封装置去收集废料——以便我们稍后进行处理。
text.completion: Wonderful, just put that down anywhere. Careful not to spill it!$B$B<The apothecary snickers.>

english.title: Pump it Up
english.objectives: Fill the Containment Unit with Volatile Waste.
english.description: The Black Rose was a seafaring laboratory for the Royal Apothecary Society. Naturally, we had some volatile... "byproducts" onboard.$B$BRegrettably, one such substance was released during our skirmish with the Alliance gunship. As you can see, it is taking quite a toll on the coast.$B$BThe R.A.S. must remedy this situation before we press further inland.$B$BPlease take a containment unit and fill it with waste - for us to dispose of properly at a later time, of course.
english.completion: Славно. Поставь контейнер куда-нибудь. Только смотри не расплескай!$B$B<Аптекарь мерзко хихикает.>
